notes.title: Get Your First Look at Update 48 & More in a New Preview Livestream
notes.notes:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/09/b83e3ebedd047db84dad4c6d87c97d13.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Get a glimpse at everything the remainder of 2025 has coming to ESO in a special new livestream on Twitch.tv. [/i]
 
Tune in to [url=https://www.twitch.tv/bethesda]Twitch.tv/Bethesda[/url] this [b]Thursday, September 11 at 2PM EDT,[/b] as Community Managers Jessica Folsom and Gina Bruno host a special preview livestream. During the show, our hosts will be joined by Associate Design Director Jason Barnes, Associate Design Director Mike Finnigan, and Combat & PvP Director Brian Wheeler to share more about the next three months of [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i].

 
[b]What: [/b]Q4 & Update 48 Preview Livestream
 
[b]When: [/b]Thursday, September 11 at 2PM EDT
 
[b]Where:[/b] [url=https://www.twitch.tv/bethesda]Twitch.tv/Bethesda[/url]

 
Together, the team will talk about the Update 48 base-game patch and upcoming events, preview the Eastern Solstice zone and [i]Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 2[/i], and reveal details on the next Vengeance PvP test.   
 
If you’re excited to take the fight to the Worm Cult with your fellow players or want to know how the conflict in Cyrodiil is going to change next, this is the show for you! Twitch Drops will be enabled during the livestream, so don’t forget to link your accounts—we’ll see you there!

notes.title: New Elder Scrolls Online update introduces sad Argonians and a giant mouth organ
notes.notes:
If your bedtime reading consists mostly of lusty Argonian maids, this tale may not be for you. Instead of romance, Elder Scrolls Online is telling a tragedy, as the Feast of Shadows update tells the story of the poor denizens of Solstice, whose lives are impacted by the actions of the Worm Cult. We join Seekxilts, a lizard fella whose home was destroyed by the villainous cultists, as he treks to find a hidden entrance to Naj-Caldeesh, a mythical Xanmeer that many do not believe exists. Along the way, you'll battle necromancers and avoid traps as you unravel the mystery of the citadel's legendary power.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Delve Deeper into Update 46’s Base Game Additions with ESO’s Developers
notes.notes:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/06/30005eb49447675ba10f3b307e9d01f6.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]ESO’s Developers discuss some of the big additions included in the Update 46 base-game patch.[/i]
 
The Update 46 base-game patch introduces a huge host of new features and adventures for [i]ESO[/i]’s players. This includes the unlocking of the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/68105]Western Solstice zone[/url] and [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/68079]story[/url] for [i]2025 Content Pass[/i] owners in addition to the new [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/68091]Subclassing system[/url]. However, these are far from the only new features and improvements included in the [b]free update[/b]. A new Furnishing Vault comes to ESO Plus™ to alleviate storage issues, returning players can join the action faster with Hero’s Return, add-ons arrive for console players, and more! 
 [h2]A First Time for the Hero’s Return[/h2] 
If you’ve ever come back to [i]ESO[/i] after a lengthy absence, you might have found getting back into the swing of things took time and energy you’d rather have spent on your adventures. That’s why the Hero’s Return feature was created.
 
“We often see players overwhelmed when deciding what to do first when returning to the bustling land of Tamriel,” says Systems Designer Carlos Ruiz. “With Hero's Return, we guide players across a handful of key activities while helping showcase the fun and value of doing them on their own.” 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/a74c2e20ceb2f724e557b60fa913ec3a.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/a74c2e20ceb2f724e557b60fa913ec3a.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									  
[i]Make your Hero’s  Return[/i]
  
“Many of us have taken a break  from a game and returned to it and asked ourselves, 'What are the controls, how  do I catch up, what can I do currently?'” says Ruiz. “We saw Hero’s Return as  our opportunity to help answer those questions and get players back into the  fun of the game with ease!” 
  
Hero's Return begins with a 10-15 minute quest that  refreshes you on key combat mechanics. Afterward, you receive helpful bonus  login rewards as you keep playing and a series of short Hero's Return Golden  Pursuits designed to get you back into your Tamrielic  groove. It keeps things simple—get reacquainted with the game and receive handy  rewards for doing so!
 
[h2]Unpacking the Furnishing Vault[/h2]  
The Furnishing Vault is a new addition to the ESO Plus benefits. If you have a membership, you can claim the Furnishing Vault for free  in the Crown Store as soon as Update 46 is live on your platform of choice.  Once claimed, it can store up to 500 stacks of furnishing items, freeing up  bank and housing space dramatically.
  
“Player requests and interests over the years for housing  storage were certainly a main motivator for the creation of the Furnishing  Vault,” says Systems Designer Lyndsay Beaver. “We also have a strong desire to  ease inventory pressure where we can, coupled with finding ways to improve the  quality of life for all housing players.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/06/e3fd47ad6ddc7a14ab986553f72e116e.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/06/e3fd47ad6ddc7a14ab986553f72e116e.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Store your spare furnishings easily! [/i]
 
For the team, when designing the vault, they had some clear goals in mind. 
 
“Essentially, we want to make decorating a house, much less multiple houses, a bit more seamless. And again, working to ease inventory bloat for players who have a lot of furnishings,” adds Senior UI Engineer James Sammartino. “No more having to carry furnishings from one place to another in your inventory or having a house that’s just full of unplaced furniture.”
 
As you might expect, this new storage option had its own technical hurdles, too, which in turn led to greater Housing functionality. 
 
“In building the vault, we needed to tackle a particular technical hurdle: providing players with a way to choose where to store retrieved furnishings,” explains Sammartino. “To address this, we have added a new Retrieve To option to the Housing Editor's Retrieve tab, allowing you to choose to send retrieved furnishings to your inventory, bank, storage chests, and, of course, the Furnishing Vault.”

 [h2]Adding Add-Ons on Console[/h2] 
Since [i]ESO[/i]’s initial launch in 2014, players have customized their time in Tamriel with add-ons—on PC at least. Now, the option to customize your game experience through add-ons is [b]coming to consoles (Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5) on June 23[/b]. 
 
“We've wanted console add-ons since we first launched on consoles,” notes Lead UI Engineer Dan Batson. “Originally it was simply something first-party didn't really have a process for. That eventually changed, but things were always moving so fast that the timing was never right to get the resources. Lately, we've had a bigger focus on shoring up player experiences and closing gaps, so we pushed to make console add-ons a priority.” 
 
Of course, the work itself was no simple matter, and it led to some limitations, but also learnings, for the team.
 
“The biggest challenge is that consoles have incredibly strict memory limits,” explains Batson. “This is why we support add-ons only on next gen consoles. Beyond that, we had to provide a built-in process not just for using add-ons but hosting and acquiring them. Caveat emptor still applies as it always has, but being responsible for this part of the process means a heightened level of deliberateness and scrutiny.”
 
As a result, Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5 players can begin downloading and enjoy add-ons when the functionality turns on starting June 23. Even better, if you’re an add-on creator, you can [url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/addon/ESOAddOnUploader.zip]upload your add-ons to the system now.[/url] 

 [h2]Stacking on Convenience for Crafters[/h2] 
How many writs could a master crafter stack, if a master crafter could stack writs? No, that’s not a tongue twister, it’s a question players will soon be able to answer for themselves.* 
 
Master writs have been a vital part of the crafting economy in [i]ESO[/i] for many years now, but they’ve been accompanied by the problem of inventory pressure since their inception. As unique items with similarly unique requirements and reward amounts, getting them to take up less space was a challenge for the team, but also an important need.
 
“With 10 plus years of content, we’re always cognizant of a player’s inventory and how it fills over the course of a game,” says Senior Systems Designer Matthew Bloise. “One of the primary goals of making master writs stackable was to alleviate the bloat in player inventories, so the design needed not to make the problem inadvertently worse down the line. This is why we avoided using something like a container—we know that they don’t stack. So, Engineering had to come up with a way to grant an item, in which the item itself was able to be stacked, while granting a distinct item upon its use.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/06/9807ae6a78141860f64c64cc6c4ee53d.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/06/9807ae6a78141860f64c64cc6c4ee53d.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Receive and complete writs without filling up your inventory[/i]
 
Even better, the team doesn’t want this work to stop at crafting writs alone.
 
“As Rich said in the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/67911]2025 ESO Direct[/url], we’re now looking to see how this can be applied to other areas of the game to further alleviate inventory pain for players.”


These great additions (almost all of them entirely free!) are just the [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/discussion/678310/pc-mac-patch-notes-v11-0-5-update-46]highlights of the Update 46 base-game patch[/url], which also includes map improvements, UI adjustments, and Champion tree changes. Which of these additions are you most excited to try? Let us know via [url=https://bsky.app/profile/elderscrollsonline.com]Bluesky[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]. 
 
[i]*Spoilers, the answer is 200 in a single stack![/i]
 
[i]The free Update 46 base-game patch is live on PC/Mac and arrives on Xbox and PlayStation consoles on June 18, 2025.[/i]

notes.title: Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 1 & Update 46 Now Live on PC/Mac
notes.notes:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/608eb51e5069423f957bada4dfbd7a72.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Explore the mysterious island of Solstice and discover an old foe returned in the Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 1 and Update 46, now live on PC/Mac![/i]
 
[i]The Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 1[/i] is now live on PC/Mac, Steam, and Epic Store. Featuring a brand-new saga and a true sequel to [i]ESO[/i]’s base game questline, [i]Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 1[/i] is set in a land wholly new to the [i]Elder Scrolls [/i]and is included in [i]2025 Content Pass[/i] and [i]2025 Premium Edition[/i], both [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/contentpass]available now[/url].
										      							    							      								      																																																																																				      																															[previewyoutube=DvdEWHAIxpE;full][url=https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/DvdEWHAIxpE?autoplay=1&rel=0]																																														[img]https://i.ytimg.com/vi/DvdEWHAIxpE/maxresdefault.jpg[/img][img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/einstein/yt.png[/img]																						[/url]	[/previewyoutube]																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																														      							    							      								      									 
Also releasing is the free Update 46 base-game patch, which features a host of new additions and fixes, including the Subclassing system, a new system to welcome back returning heroes, and more. 

 [h2]Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 1 [/h2] 
In [i]Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 1[/i], you will delve into the mysterious new land of Solstice and investigate the resurgence of the dreaded Worm Cult. Note that this is only the first part of this adventure, with Part 2 arriving in Q4 of this year. 
 
[b]A True Sequel Story[/b]
 
In this new adventure and story, you will continue the narrative from [i]ESO[/i]’s original main questline as you investigate the resurgence of the infamous Worm Cult. Together with new and returning allies, you must venture into the isle of Solstice, discover the cult’s plans, and uncover the secrets of the mysterious Writhing Wall that divides it.  
										      							    							      								      																																																																																				      																															[previewyoutube=OOfYaCdkGTE;full][url=https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/OOfYaCdkGTE?autoplay=1&rel=0]																																														[img]https://i.ytimg.com/vi/OOfYaCdkGTE/maxresdefault.jpg[/img][img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/einstein/yt.png[/img]																						[/url]		[/previewyoutube]																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																													      							    							      								      									 
Discover more about this new storyline in [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/68079]this deep dive blog[/url]. 
 
[b]Western Solstice Zone[/b]
 
This new release also introduces Solstice, a tropical island paradise never-before-seen in the [i]Elder Scrolls[/i] series. As you explore the Western Solstice zone (with Eastern Solstice arriving later in Q4), a host of new locations and dangers await, including unique World Bosses and Delves, a Public Dungeon, special standalone story quests, and more. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/cb896c02031e151415d1100dc56f7225.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/cb896c02031e151415d1100dc56f7225.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Explore a brand-new zone[/i]
 
You can learn more about the new zone in [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/68105]this deep dive blog[/url]. 
 
[b]Ossein Cage Trial[/b]
 
Tamriel’s PvE players can put their teamwork and skills to the test with Western Solstice’s new Trial, Ossein Cage. This new 12-player challenge, set in Coldharbour but accessible from the new zone, sees teams venture into one of Molag Bal’s most infamous fortresses to capture a dangerous relic. New dangers, mechanics, and rewards await those willing to brave the Ossein Cage—the Fighter’s Guild needs your help! 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/3f8e8ef8332db14a1c96c85048488539.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/3f8e8ef8332db14a1c96c85048488539.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Team up for a new Trial[/i]
 
You can find more information about the new trial [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/68145]in this deep dive[/url]. 
 
[b]Unique Rewards[/b]
 
While adventuring within Solstice, you can earn and unlock a series of new and unique rewards. This includes 16 new Antiquities (with three Mythic items), new item sets (in both the Trial and zone), and a ton of collectibles, ranging from crafting motifs to pets. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/05560b10b145aea499eb8d0fecb91e8e.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/05560b10b145aea499eb8d0fecb91e8e.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Earn unique rewards in Solstice[/i]
 
Even better, all adventurers will receive a 10% experience boost while adventuring in Solstice throughout this entire year!
 
[h2]Purchase Details & Requirements[/h2] 
Access to the [i]Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 1 [/i]is included in two editions of the game, the [i]2025 Content Pass[/i] and [i]2025 Premium Edition[/i]. 
 
Both editions are [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/joinus]available for purchase now[/url] and feature a whole year’s worth of adventure, including:
      [list][*][i]Fallen Banners[/i] dungeon pack (now live)[/*][*][i]Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 1[/i](now live on PC/Mac)[/*][*][i]Feast of Shadows[/i] dungeon pack (arriving Q3)[/*][*]Access to the Writhing Wall event (arriving Q4)[/*][*][i]Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 2[/i] (arriving Q4)[/*][*]A unique mount, pet, and memento[/*][/list]
In addition to the above, the [i]2025 Premium Edition[/i] also includes access to the game and ALL of [i]ESO[/i]’s previous Chapters. For a full breakdown of everything included in both editions, visit the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/contentpass]Content Pass page[/url]. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/f1c83849575efe6ab48c78d1e68dac50.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/f1c83849575efe6ab48c78d1e68dac50.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]2025 Content Pass[/i]
										      							    							      								      				<nav class="button-nav						align-center		">[url=/en-us/joinus]																																																						Buy Now																																																																				[/url]	        																																																																																																																																														</nav>							      							    							      								      									


 
Note that to run [i]ESO[/i] on PC/Mac, your machine needs to meet the game's requirements here: [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/newplayerguide/minspec]PC[/url], [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/newplayerguide/minspec]Mac[/url].

 [h2]Getting Started [/h2] 
Once you have access to [i]Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 1[/i], you can begin your new adventure in the following ways: 
 
[b]Via Wayshrine[/b]
 
You can teleport directly to the zone by accessing your map, selecting Solstice, and then selecting the automatically unlocked Sunport Docks Wayshrine.
 
[b]Via the Seasons of the Worm Cult Main Quest[/b]
 
You can have the game lead you to Western Solstice by picking up the storyline’s first main story quest, “The Stirk Fellowship.” You can find it via your Collections menu by navigating to Stories, then New Releases, and finally selecting Solstice. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/68e19451cf5777fe86b1059f350cb3a4.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/68e19451cf5777fe86b1059f350cb3a4.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Get started in Sunport[/i]
 
Note that while the zone features a sequel story to the [i]ESO[/i] base game, there are no level or story requirements for jumping into your [i]Seasons of the Worm Cult[/i] adventure. You can play with a new or existing character. 

 [h2]Update 46 [/h2] 
Releasing alongside the [i]Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 1[/i] is Update 46. A [b]free base-game patch for all [i]ESO[/i] players[/b], Update 46 introduces a series of new features, improvements, and fixes. 
 
[b]Subclassing System[/b]
 
With the new Subclassing System, you can mix and match up to two different class skill lines with your existing characters, unlocking new realms of customizability for your builds and playstyles. 
										      							    							      								      																																																																																				      																															[previewyoutube=_VUphPv0Y6Y;full][url=https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/_VUphPv0Y6Y?autoplay=1&rel=0]																																														[img]https://i.ytimg.com/vi/_VUphPv0Y6Y/maxresdefault.jpg[/img][img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/einstein/yt.png[/img]																						[/url]	[/previewyoutube]																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																														      							    							      								      									 
To get started with the Subclassing system, all you need is one character at level 50. You can then pick up the short system quest to begin—build a character uniquely you! 
 
You can learn more about the Subclassing system in [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/68091]this deep dive blog[/url]. 
 
[b]Hero’s Return[/b]
 
Been away from Tamriel for a while? The new Hero’s Return system provides tools and guidelines to help get you back into the game and world of [i]ESO[/i] as quickly as possible.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/a74c2e20ceb2f724e557b60fa913ec3a.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/a74c2e20ceb2f724e557b60fa913ec3a.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									  
[i]Welcome back with  Hero’s Return[/i]
  
In addition to a short quest that reminds you of the game’s combat  basics, this system also enables the Hero’s Return Golden Pursuits campaign and  unique Login Rewards. Put your best foot forward when stepping back into  Tamriel’s Second Era! 
  
[b]Furnishing Vault[/b]
  
A new ESO Plus™ benefit, the Furnishing Vault allows you to  store up to 500 unique furnishing stacks in a special vault accessible for any  of your homes in Tamriel.

										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/ba4dea577bb52244d38060a3c82ecd3e.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/05/ba4dea577bb52244d38060a3c82ecd3e.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Store almost anything in the Furnishing Vault![/i]
 
All ESO Plus members can acquire this new collectible for free. You can access the Furnishing Vault via the Housing Editor while home decorating or by interacting directly with the item itself. 
 
[b]Console Add-Ons[/b]
 
When Update 46 arrives on consoles June 18, for the first time, Xbox and PlayStation players will enjoy add-on support previously available only to [i]ESO[/i]’s PC/Mac players. Note that add-on support will be fully [b]enabled on June 23[/b] (the week after launch) and allow players to download add-ons from within the in-game UI on [b]Xbox Series X/S and PlayStation 5 consoles[/b]. Only UI add-ons are available. 
 
If you are a console add-on developer, you are invited to upload your creations [url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/addon/ESOAddOnUploader.zip]using the uploader tool[/url]—we can’t wait to see how the console community reacts to add-on support! 
 
[b]Additional Changes[/b]
 
Finally, Update 46 also introduces a series of tweaks and improvements to the base-game experience. This includes improvements to the in-game map and better tutorials for the game’s Wayshrine system. Master crafters will also be thrilled to discover they are now awarded Master Writs in stackable envelopes—dramatically saving inventory space! 
 
[b]Patch Notes[/b]
 
These are just some of the highlights of the changes and additions coming to [i]ESO[/i] with Update 46. For a full list of absolutely everything you can expect from this base-game patch, check out the [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/discussion/678310]Patch Notes[/url].
										      							    							      								      																																																																																																																																																							      							    							      								      									 

Don’t forget, aside from the Furnishing Vault (which requires ESO Plus membership), the above Update 46 features are [b]free for all base-game players[/b].

 [h2]The War Begins[/h2] 
The dreaded Worm Cult has returned, and the people of Solstice need your help. Explore an island paradise, investigate the cult’s mysterious return, and discover the secrets of the Writhing Wall that now divides it all. Are you ready to begin your [i]Seasons of the Worm Cult[/i] adventure? Perhaps you’re most looking forward to customizing your builds with the Subclassing system? Share your plans with us via [url=https://bsky.app/profile/elderscrollsonline.com]Bluesky[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]—we’ll see you in Tamriel! 
 
[i]The Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 1 and Update 46 are now live on PC/Mac and arrive June 18 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles. Part 1 is part of the 2025 Content Pass and 2025 Premium Edition, now available for purchase on elderscrollsonline.com.[/i]

notes.title: Fallen Banners & Update 45 Now Live on PC/Mac
notes.notes:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/01/1b8ed7104cb38ea5dadd00b4d2fe8630.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Defend an Elder Scroll and experience a host of changes and additions to the game with the Fallen Banners dungeon pack and Update 45 base-game patch. [/i]
 
The [i]Fallen Banners[/i] dungeon pack and free Update 45 base-game patch are now live on PC/Mac and arrives March 26 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles. In this release, you can save Cyrodiil from plunging further into chaos with two new dungeons and experience a host of changes and quality-of-life additions. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/03/6a99ceaf637e19dc2680e92c25db153a.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/03/6a99ceaf637e19dc2680e92c25db153a.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									  
[i]Fallen Banners  dungeon pack[/i]
  
You can get access to the [i]Fallen Banners[/i] dungeon pack  at launch via [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/esoplus]ESO Plus™ membership[/url]. Note that alternative means of acquiring it will be  revealed as part of the upcoming ESO Direct on April 10.

[h2]Fallen Banners[/h2]  
Gather your party for two challenging new PvE dungeon  experiences: Lep Seclusa and Exiled Redoubt. Unlock new achievements and earn  new rewards including item sets, collectibles, and more as you fight to  preserve what little peace remains in the war-torn region of Cyrodiil. 
  
[b]Lep Seclusa[/b]
  
The Moth Priests of Lep Seclusa are besieged, and the  cunning Orpheon the Tactician is set on seizing the power of the Elder Scroll  they safeguard. You must help Sister Chana defend the sanctuary against an army  of deserters, protect its people and secrets, and confront Orpheon before he  can use the power of the scroll to forever change the face of Cyrodiil. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/03/3e890dfac396411246bb61663793e8dc.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/03/3e890dfac396411246bb61663793e8dc.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Defend the Moth Priest sanctuary[/i]
 
To learn more about Lep Seclusa, check out [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/67577]this preview blog[/url]. 
 

[b]Exiled Redoubt[/b]
 
Soldiers of the Alliance War, regardless of their faction, are vanishing, and all trails lead to the Imperial fortress known as the Exiled Redoubt. Team up with the Battlemage Lucilla, infiltrate this mysterious stronghold, and put a stop to the schemes of a once noble Imperial house before its chaos can spread beyond its stone walls and throughout Tamriel. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/03/3c5a1e34a6048948637a9f085afad681.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/03/3c5a1e34a6048948637a9f085afad681.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Battle your way into an Imperial stronghold[/i]
 
To learn more about the Exiled Redoubt, check out [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/67647]this preview blog[/url].  
 

[b]New Dungeon Loot[/b]
 
Those who brave Lep Seclusa and the Exiled Redoubt also have a chance to loot and unlock a host of special rewards, such as new collectibles, item sets, and Achievements. This includes the Tactician’s Gold Lattice Skin, earned by completing both dungeons on veteran difficulty—no easy task!
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/02/be3c94df60cf7ffc72b87d3d7322ca8c.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/02/be3c94df60cf7ffc72b87d3d7322ca8c.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Unlock a new Cyrodiil-inspired skin[/i]
 

[h2]Getting Started[/h2] 
At launch, you can access the [i]Fallen Banners[/i] dungeon pack with an ESO Plus membership. If your ESO Plus membership lapses, you will lose access to the DLC until you renew your membership or acquire it by other means. 
 
Note that while at launch ESO Plus membership is the only way to access the dungeon pack, there will be additional ways to acquire it in the future—stay tuned for more information during the April ESO Direct. 
 
Once you have access to [i]Fallen Banners[/i], you can dive right into the two new dungeons via the following methods: 
   [list][*]By teleporting directly into the two dungeons from your map[/*][*]By using the Dungeon Finder tool [/*][*]By visiting their specific dungeon entrances within the Hew's Bane (Lep Seclusa) and West Weald (Exiled Redoubt) zones[/*][/list]
As a base-game patch, Update 45 will be automatically downloaded by your game clients when it launches. 


 [h2]Update 45 Base-Game Patch[/h2] 
Arriving in tandem with the dungeon pack is the Update 45 base-game patch, a free update for all [i]ESO[/i] players that features additions, bugfixes, and improvements to the game. 
 

[b]Starter Zone Refresh[/b]
 
To help keep [i]ESO[/i] as welcoming to new (and returning) players as possible, the game’s starter zones have received a visual refresh, bringing them closer to the quality of more recent additions. Bleakrock Isle, Bal Foyen, Stros M’kai, Betnikh, and Khenarthi’s Roost have each received improvements to their lighting, enhanced ground and water textures, updated structures, and the addition of more clutter or props. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/03/6f2cd232f72d4e943f714e6005cd0e4f.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/03/6f2cd232f72d4e943f714e6005cd0e4f.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Discover updated starter zones[/i]
 

[b]Cyrodiil Champions PC/Mac Test[/b]
 
[i]ESO[/i]’s Alliance War veterans can help the team test future changes and iterations on the game’s open-world PvP with a PC/Mac-only test called Cyrodiil Champions. With the goal of improving stability and performance in Cyrodiil (and perhaps other environments), look for a special Alliance War campaign called Vengeance to participate from March 24-31, 2025. 
 

[b]General Changes and Improvements [/b]
 
Along with the above, Update 45 also boosts mount starting speed, overhauls the Craft constellation to ease micromanagement, and introduces a general UI cleanup of the in-game map to help improve readability. It also moves the game’s disguises out of the inventory and into your collections and improves the visibility of Mundus Stone boons—phew! 
 
You can discover more about the update’s features in [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/67601]this preview blog[/url]. For everything arriving as part of the base-game patch, check out the [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]Patch Notes on our official forums[/url]. Don’t forget, the Update 45 base-game patch is FREE for all [i]ESO[/i] players and is downloaded automatically at launch.
 

[h2]Delve into the Endless Conflict[/h2] 
Gather your party and prepare to delve into two challenging new PvE experiences with the [i]Fallen Banners[/i] dungeon pack. Are you ready to witness the true cost of the Alliance War? Are you excited to make use of the base-game patch’s various improvements and additions? Let us know via [url=https://bsky.app/profile/elderscrollsonline.com]Bluesky[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url].
 
[i]The Fallen Banners dungeon pack and Update 45 is now live for ESO Plus members on PC/Mac and arrives March 26 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles. Look for more details on additional ways to acquire Fallen Banners during the upcoming April ESO Direct.[/i]

notes.title: Update 45 Preview—Base Game Improvements
notes.notes:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/02/553c67e4c4b009d595179044ed012ac3.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Check out the base game improvements coming with Update 45, including visually refreshed starter zones![/i]
 
The release of Update 45 on live servers is coming soon, occurring March 10 for PC/Mac and March 26 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles. When it hits, players can enjoy a variety of improvements to the base game experience. There’ll be something for everyone, from new players just stepping into Tamriel to [i]ESO v[/i]eterans with an abundance of Champion Points. Check out some of the highlights below.


 [h2]A Fresh Start for Starter Zones[/h2] 
As part of the ongoing commitment to keeping [i]ESO [/i]as modern and welcoming to players as possible, several zones have received a visual refresh to bring them up to more recent standards. 
 
“Moving from the updates to the Wailing Prison in Update 44, the five starter zones represented the very next step in the new player experience,” explains Art Manager Morgan Godat. “Because these zones are smaller, we were able to bundle up the changes and release them together to make sure that all new players would have a first open zone experience closer in visual quality to our newly released zones, regardless of their choices in character creation.”
										      							    							      								      																																																																	[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/02/0a40b4795cfb6a057fa5d2e7c0739f76.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/02/0a40b4795cfb6a057fa5d2e7c0739f76.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																																			[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/02/ad15c4815159892c6ac3eda727c4225e.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/02/ad15c4815159892c6ac3eda727c4225e.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																												      							    							      								      									 
[i]Compare updated starter zones[/i]
 
These zones—Bleakrock Isle, Bal Foyen, Stros M’kai, Betnikh, and Khenarthi’s Roost—have all received visual improvements and now benefit from the team’s long experience. 
 
“The changes are primarily a cosmetic facelift for many assets in the world, using newer parts and tricks we’ve learned over the years since the initial game launch. Things like ground and water textures, grasses and flowers, lighting, and some small prop replacements,” says Principal World Builder Greg Barley. “Certain locations have updated structures, such as the docks or shipwrecks on Khenarthi’s Roost, for example.”


 [h2]Saddle Up for Quality-of-Life Changes[/h2] 
In addition to the starter zone refresh, this base-game patch also includes a host of changes and improvements to the overall experience. 
 
[b]Improved Base Mount Speed[/b]
 
Mounts now start out noticeably faster than they did previously, while still ending up around the same final speed for most. If you fully invest in all possible mount speed improvements, you may even end up going slightly faster than before.
 
"Unlocking a mount is a big moment early in your adventuring career, and it should feel good,” explains Senior Systems Designer Cullen Lee. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/02/d103a4b667d80fdb67872cad6b1f8f0e.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/02/d103a4b667d80fdb67872cad6b1f8f0e.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									  
[i]Get galloping and get going![/i]

However, Lee notes that it hasn’t always been the case. 
  
“Prior to Update 45, it was easy to 'sprint away' from your  first mount experience feeling faster than the mount itself. With the changes  in place, you'll find that mounts feel significantly more useful early in your  journey, while keeping them feeling the same at the top end."
  
[b]Craft Champion Point Improvements[/b]
  
If you’ve reached level 50, you’ll notice some changes to  the way the Craft constellation works. 
  
"In Update 45, the first thing you'll notice about the  Craft, or green, tree is that you probably have some empty slots available now,”  says Lee. “We've taken most of the stars that were a chore to remember to slot  and made them always active. This means that once you unlock a star like  Meticulous Disassembly or Plentiful Harvest, you'll never have to worry about  forgetting to swap your stars around and missing out on rewards ever again!” 
  
With these changes, the team hopes to make some previously  overlooked stars more appealing. 
  
“With so many previously slotted stars changed to always  active, you'll also find that some stars that you might have passed over in the  past are more exciting, since they are no longer competing against some of the  best stars for slots."
  
[b]Tamriel Map Cleanup and Messaging[/b]
  
Update 45 also includes an effort from the UI team to make  the continent map of Tamriel clearer and more usable. Clutter has been reduced,  and zone names now appear on the map as you zoom in.
  
"I think the changes to the Tamriel level of the map  will get noticed pretty quickly,” says Lead UI Designer Bobby Weir. “Previously,  discovered wayshrines could fill up the map to the point of making it difficult  to navigate. We've changed it to only show one wayshrine per zone at that  higher level, so hopefully it won't feel like you're fighting with the map  anymore when trying to use it."
  
[b]Disguise Items Added to Collectibles[/b]
  
Many quests that featured a player disguise now grant that  disguise as a permanent collectible among their completion rewards—no inventory  space required! A large number of the available disguises have been converted  for Update 45, and you’ll unlock the new collectibles on your first post-patch  login with any character who has completed a relevant quest.
  
[b]Mundus Stone Boon Visibility[/b]
  
The power granted by a Mundus Stone is a crucial element of  many character builds, so we have taken steps to better convey its value to new  players. There is now a reminder about Mundus Stones among the Level 10 Level  Up Rewards, clearer and more direct information in the Mundus Stone Help Entry,  and a section for Mundus Stone Boons in the Character and Inventory UI screens.  
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/02/c09e115e654b3429a869f1f61991583e.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/02/c09e115e654b3429a869f1f61991583e.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Enjoy more Mundus Stone help[/i]
 
Additionally, the Mundus Stone Boon area of these screens now turns red if you reach level 20 without an active Boon to remind you to acquire one.

 
These are just some of the many changes and additions coming to [i]ESO [/i]with Update 45. You can experience it all for yourself when the patch arrives on March 10 for PC/Mac and March 26 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles. Are you excited for the base-game improvements coming to Tamriel? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]. 
 
[i]The Update 45 base-game patch arrives March 10 on PC/Mac and March 26 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles.[/i]

notes.title: Update 45 Preview—Fallen Banners
notes.notes:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/01/1b8ed7104cb38ea5dadd00b4d2fe8630.jpg[/img]																											      								      									  
[i]Learn more about the upcoming Update 45 base-game patch  and the new Fallen Banners dungeon DLC. [/i]
  
The Update 45 base-game patch and [i]Fallen Banners[/i] dungeon DLC  arrives March 10 on PC/Mac and March 25 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles. While  the U45 base-game patch is free for all [i]ESO [/i]players, an ESO Plus™ membership is required to access and play the [i]Fallen Banners[/i] dungeon DLC.
  [h2]Fallen Banners[/h2]  
Kicking off the year’s adventures and challenges, [i]Fallen  Banners[/i] introduces two new four-player dungeons for you and your team to  explore. 
  


[b]Exiled Redoubt[/b]
  
As the continent-spanning Alliance War continues to ravage  Tamriel, the Imperial Battlemage Lucilla needs your help investigating the mysterious  disappearances of its soldiers. Join Lucilla in infiltrating the stronghold of  the once-proud House Albus and discover a plot that threatens to condemn the  people of Cyrodiil to endless war. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/01/bcc3c1512bce49e7fadda987c4ece050.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/01/bcc3c1512bce49e7fadda987c4ece050.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Fight for peace in Exiled Redoubt[/i]
 


[b]Lep Seclusa[/b]
 
The Moth Priest sanctuary of Lep Seclusa is besieged, and the Elder Scroll it protects is threatened. You and your allies must defend the Moth Priests and their precious relic from the sinister Orpheon the Tactician and his army of deserters. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/01/e0e72d9c51042407de42892b4b075842.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2025/01/e0e72d9c51042407de42892b4b075842.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Defend the sanctuary of Lep Seclusa[/i]
 
Both dungeons feature their own unique storylines, characters, challenges (including unique boss battles), and secrets. Complete these dungeons and you’ll also discover unique rewards, including item sets, collectibles, and Achievements available only in these encounters. 
 
As mentioned above, if you wish to tackle these two new Alliance War-themed dungeons, you’ll need an active ESO Plus membership. The dungeon DLC will NOT be available for purchase for crowns at launch. 


[h2]Update 45[/h2] 
Arriving in tandem with the dungeon DLC is the Update 45 base-game patch. This free update includes a host of changes and improvements that all [i]ESO [/i]players can enjoy. 
 

[b]Cyrodiil Champions Test Campaign[/b]
 
Update 45 introduces the early stages of the new Cyrodiil Champions test PvP campaign. When playing a Cyrodiil Champions test campaign, you and your fellow players are locked to specific class builds, including abilities, attributes, and items. This test allows us to monitor how the server reacts to simplified abilities, with the goal being to collect data and help us plan for the future of Cyrodiil and abilities.
 
During this test, seven set Cyrodiil Champion classes are available, and access to some features are blocked, including Crown Store provisions, items not included in the class templates, and more. During a Cyrodiil Champions campaign, all competitors are at equal power levels—it all comes down to skill! 
 
Note that with Update 45, we are only just beginning to test the Cyrodiil Champions campaigns. Expect a full rollout with greater options and a more polished experience in the future.
 

[b]Starter Zone Refresh[/b]
 
The starter zones of Betnikh, Stros M’kai, Bleakrock, Bal Foyen, and Khenarthi’s Roost have all undergone a makeover, bringing them more in line visually with the detail of [i]ESO[/i]’s recent additions such as West Weald or the Telvanni Peninsula.
 
These starter zones have received improvements to their terrain transitions, materials and lighting, and atmosphere. Signs and banners have been positioned to better highlight services (such as crafting or banking locations), and lighting has been adjusted to better define important paths and other areas of detail. With the addition of more organic clutter and props, various portions of the zones should feel a little less sparse and a little more lived in—go check them out!
 

[b]Quality-of-Life Improvements[/b]
 
This base-game patch also features a host of quality-of-life improvements to the game. This includes an improvement to the initial mount experience by significantly increasing their starting movement speed value (without dramatically increasing their top end speed). The team has also reworked specific Craft (green) Champion stars so they no longer need to be slotted for you to benefit from their effects. Finally, the team has also increased the visibility of the value of Mundus Stone Boons, including reminders as to when and where you can find them.

This is just the start of a series of general improvements to the player experience in [i]ESO[/i]. Keep an eye out for even more additions and tweaks like the above throughout this year’s updates.

[h2]A Realm in Chaos[/h2] 
Tamriel is besieged on all sides, and the people of Cyrodiil need heroes, no matter what side of the conflict they are on. Are you ready to take up arms and defend the Moth Priests of Lep Seclusa or the forgotten soldiers of the Three Banners War? Are you excited to learn more about the various updates and improvements coming to the overall [i]ESO [/i]experience? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook.[/url]

notes.title: Update 44 Base-Game Patch Now Live on PC/Mac
notes.notes:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/10/c8025a77e15bd60cc886fba25dd47de1.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Find glory in the updated Battlegrounds, recruit new Companions, and develop your mastery of Scribing in the Update 44 base-game patch.[/i]
 
The Update 44 base-game patch is now live on PC/Mac, and it introduces a host of changes, fixes, and additions to [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i]. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/10/cc93cba524ad27b5a90ca696e65ee07d.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/10/cc93cba524ad27b5a90ca696e65ee07d.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 



This update is free for all [i]ESO[/i] players (and will be automatically downloaded and patched by the game), but note that the two new Companions require either ESO Plus™ membership or purchase from the Crown Store to access. Check out the full patch notes for Update 44 on our official forums. [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/discussion/667797]Follow this link for full patch notes[/url]. 
										      							    							      								      							      							    							      								      									 
[h2][u]New Features[/u][/h2] 
The Update 44 base-game patch adds a ton of new features, challenges, and rewards to the game. 
 
[b]Battlegrounds Update[/b]
 
[i]ESO[/i]’s fast-paced PvP experience, Battlegrounds, has undergone a series of dramatic changes designed to make the game mode (originally introduced with the [i]Morrowind[/i] Chapter back in 2017) more competitive and fun for every type of player.
										      							    							      								      																																																																																				      																															
[previewyoutube=VT3Dq5A6LHg;full][/previewyoutube]																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																											      							    							      								      									
Changes include a shift from the original 4v4v4 to the new 4v4 and 8v8-sized matches, the addition of seven brand-new maps of various sizes, new rewards and mechanics, and a unique leaderboard for the 4v4 competitive-styled option.

To jump right into the action, use the Activity Finder, select Battlegrounds, and select your match size. No matter what kind of PvP player you are, you can enjoy the frenetic action of the new-look Battlegrounds—to glory!

[b]New Companions[/b]

Update 44 also introduces two brand-new Companions for you to recruit and adventure with: Tanlorin and Zerith-var. The High Elf outcast Tanlorin mixes Dragonknight and Soul Magic abilities (the first Companion to do so). Zerith-var, on the other hand, is a Khajiit Necromancer from the distant past.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/10/1ac957846eeb4ca1aef76999becc34a1.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/10/1ac957846eeb4ca1aef76999becc34a1.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Tanlorin and Zerith-var[/i]
 
Both Companions have their own passive abilities to unlock along with their own questlines and stories to tell, giving you the opportunity to discover more about these interesting adventuring allies. 
 
Note that to unlock both new allies, you need to find them within the Companions section of the in-game Crown Store. They are listed as free for ESO Plus members or available for purchase with crowns if you don’t currently have an active membership. Once unlocked, you can find Tanlorin just outside Vulkhel Guard in Auridon and Zerith-var near Moonmont in Reaper’s March. 
 
[b]New Grimoire, Scripts, Skill Styles, and More[/b]
 
First introduced with the [i]Gold Road[/i] Chapter and Update 42 in June, the Scribing System also continues to expand with Update 44. This includes a brand-new Grimoire to unlock and customize, called Banner Bearer. Banner Bearer is part of the Support Skill Line and grants you the ability to throw a banner on your back and buff your group’s abilities based on your chosen Focus. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/10/a8e267c3b1340e2c207e38853c1f9371.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/10/a8e267c3b1340e2c207e38853c1f9371.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Master new abilities and styles[/i]
 
In addition to this new ability, 14 existing scripts are now applicable to nine launch Grimoires, and a selection of four new Skill Styles help you stand out on the battlefield. Skill Styles include a molten variant for the Puncture ability, a wildburn variant for Force Shock, and more. 
 
You can acquire the new Banner Bearer Grimoire from Chronicler Firandil within the Scholarium. Check the patch notes for a complete list of Scribing additions. Don’t forget, you need access to the [i]Gold Road[/i] Chapter to begin your Scribing journey. 
 
[b]Golden Pursuits[/b]
 
A new way to earn in-game collectibles, items, and currencies, Golden Pursuits is a new reward system included with Update 44. Highly variable, a Golden Pursuits campaign asks players to complete various tasks as they adventure in Tamriel with a series of rewards granted for specific milestones.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/10/1039ac2c96420cb9d14bcda05b9850ed.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/10/1039ac2c96420cb9d14bcda05b9850ed.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Earn rewards with Golden Pursuits[/i]
 
The first Golden Pursuits campaign won’t be active until the middle of November, so keep an eye out for an official announcement and get ready to earn new in-game rewards. 
 
[b]Imperial City Changes[/b]
 
If you enjoy battling both your fellow players AND invading Daedra in the heart of the empire, the Imperial City has also undergone a few changes within its war-torn streets and sewers. This includes improvements to how Imperial Vaults work. For starters, Imperial City keys and key fragments convert to Imperial Fragments, and vault treasure chests become vendors.
 
In addition, many of the area’s existing vendors have enjoyed upgrades to their wares, including their quality and selection. With Update 44, plundering the capital has never been more rewarding!
 [h2]Additional Features & Improvements[/h2] 
Arriving in tandem with the above new features are a series of improvements, additions, and features that all [i]ESO[/i] players will appreciate. This includes:
        [list][*]An increase of furnishing base materials in regular harvest nodes[/*][*]HDR support for PC players[/*][list][*]Including various new visual settings such as HDR scene brightness and contrast[/*][/list][*]The addition of quest pips for Master Writs[/*][list][*]Including both quest markers and objective tracking[/*][/list][*]The addition of bonus PvP perks for ESO Plus members[/*][list][*]10% boost to Alliance Points earned (the currency), your PvP Skill Line ranks, and Alliance rank (not leaderboards or Rewards of the Worthy grant rate)[/*][*]10% boost to Tel Var Stones gained from killing monsters[/*][/list][/list]
These are just some of the changes and additions coming with Update 44. For more on all of the above and info on the bugfixes and balance tweaks arriving with this new base-game patch, be sure to check out the [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]Patch Notes on our official forums[/url]. 
 [h2]New Battles, Allies, and Rewards[/h2] 
Whether you’re an experienced veteran of [i]ESO[/i]’s fast-paced PvP mode, a humble adventurer seeking new allies, or an explorer of the unknown pursuing new powers and rewards, Update 44 has something for you! Are you ready to rejoin the Battlegrounds? Which Companion will you recruit first? Tell us via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]. 
 
[i]The Update 44 base-game patch is now live on PC/Mac and arrives on Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, and PlayStation 5 on November 13.[/i]

notes.title: Update 44 Preview—Golden Pursuits
notes.notes:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/10/c269ddc478209a5e1f2157fe3f78df00.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]In addition to the [/i][url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/66847][i]Battlegrounds update[/i][/url][i], [/i][url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/66831][i]new Companions[/i][/url][i], and more, Update 44 also introduces Golden Pursuits, a new reward system that allows you to complete activities to earn additional in-game items, currencies, and collectibles. [/i]
 
This new system will arrive when Update 44 goes live on October 28 for PC/Mac and November 13 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles, but note that the first Golden Pursuits campaign won’t be active until later in November—keep an eye out for details! 

[h2]A New Way to Earn Rewards[/h2] 
When designing Golden Pursuits, the team wanted to create new reasons to play and new ways for players to earn in-game rewards. 
 
“Golden Pursuits are intended to give players the opportunity to earn extra rewards for trying out different systems and features,” explains Katie Yu, one of [i]ESO[/i]’s Systems Designers. “They’re meant to highlight specific aspects of the game, or to support an event or theme. We want to ensure that players know exactly what they have the opportunity to earn and that they feel rewarded for completing the Golden Pursuit.”
 
While Daily Login Rewards are set every month, almost every aspect of a Golden Pursuits campaign can vary. This includes its ease or difficulty of activities, volume and quality of rewards, and even when they’re active and duration. 
 
“Unlike many of the systems in [i]ESO[/i], Golden Pursuits don't operate on a regular daily or weekly cadence. There may be anywhere from days, to weeks, to months in between them, and Golden Pursuits will vary in length when they are live. They're meant to be exciting, spontaneous events. But don't worry, they're pretty difficult to miss: Golden Pursuits will always appear on the Announcement Panel and in the Group and Activity Finder when they're active.”

[h2]A Variety of Challenges [/h2] 
As mentioned above, each Golden Pursuits campaign will vary greatly in size and scope, and this variability will be reflected in the activities and rewards each individual campaign may offer. 
 
“Generally, the activities will be very similar to what players have been seeing from Endeavors,” says Yu. “The number can vary—some Golden Pursuits may offer only a few activities, while others may provide more options for players to peruse before deciding how they want to earn their rewards. Broadly, Golden Pursuits activities are meant to highlight different parts of the game, whether that's encouraging players to engage in some friendly PvP, or try out Housing and Home Tours, or even simply explore what the wide world of Tamriel has to offer.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/10/ac34612c32d60aa52569c9f00b0c0567.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/10/ac34612c32d60aa52569c9f00b0c0567.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Pursue new challenges[/i]
 
When it comes to the individual rewards, it was important to the team that Golden Pursuits campaigns varied the kinds of things you can earn. 
 
“Players can expect to see mounts, pets, costumes, furnishings—the list goes on,” explains Yu. “There’s a wide variety of cosmetics, minor utility items such as potions and meals, currencies, and more from Golden Pursuits, and we're really excited to give players new opportunities to earn them.”
 
With this broad selection of reward types in mind, the team worked to ensure that the ideal balance is struck between the effort required to complete a Golden Pursuit and what it awards. 
 
“Each Golden Pursuit is designed to be fully completable within the duration that it's active. To give a peek behind the curtain, Golden Pursuits are typically put together by a multidisciplinary group before launch. We have data gathered from player feedback, and we review the performance of similar systems in [i]ESO [/i]to inform the design and expected level of investment. Our goal is to make sure playing with an active Golden Pursuit is both exciting and rewarding.”

[h2]Golden Opportunities[/h2] 
With Update 44’s Golden Pursuits, the team is adding even more ways for you to earn rewards as you play. Note that at launch, a Golden Pursuits campaign won’t be active, but keep an eye out for an official announcement for the first of its kind around the middle of November. Are you excited to complete your first Golden Pursuit? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url].
 
[i]The Update 44 base-game patch arrives October 28 for PC/Mac and November 13 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles.[/i]

notes.title: Next ESO update gives PvP some love with new battlegrounds and modes
notes.notes:
It's probably fair to say that if you're into PvP in your MMOs, the Elder Scrolls Online isn't your first port of call. Generally players dive into Tamriel for the lore, world, quests, and the weird stuff you find along the way, with PvP being a distant consideration. There is a dedicated core of PvPers, however, and they haven't been eating very well recently. That is all set to change, as update 44 for the game will launch soon and players will be waving goodbye to one PvP mode, and hello to another.

notes.title: Update 44 Preview—Battlegrounds, New Companions, & More!
notes.notes:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/09/9f9c36591da3f78b4e7df29c2cb2059b.jpg[/img]																											      								      									  
[i]Learn about the upcoming Update 44 base-game patch,  including major changes to Battlegrounds, new Companions, and more.[/i]
  
The Update 44 base-game patch arrives October 28 for PC/Mac  and November 13 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles. This new update introduces  new features, changes, and quality-of-life improvements, and it is free for all  existing [i]ESO[/i] players (with the notable exception of the new Companions, who  you can purchase for free with ESO Plus™ membership or with crowns from the  Crown Store…more on them below!). 
  [h2]Major Battlegrounds Update[/h2]  
If you enjoy the fast-paced PvP combat of the Battlegrounds,  Update 44 introduces big changes to the current format. In this update,  Battlegrounds is shifting to [b]two-sided matches[/b], instead of the traditional  three-sided. At launch, there will be two main Battlegrounds match types: 
    [list][*]4v4—a competitive mode between two teams of four [/*][*]8v8—a standard mode featuring powerups and two teams of eight[/*][/list]
The traditional 4v4v4 game mode will no longer be available  for queues; however, it may return in the future for limited times during  special mini-PvP events. This new two-sided format also includes[b] seven  brand-new maps[/b] to battle your fellow players within. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/09/38ce45c859249d7d4cb06d8314a73e6d.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/09/38ce45c859249d7d4cb06d8314a73e6d.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Battle within all-new maps[/i]
 
All the traditional Battlegrounds game modes will remain, including Team Deathmatch, Crazy King, Domination, Chaosball (8v8 mode only), and Capture the Relic (8v8 mode only). In addition, the 8v8 matches will also house four unique powerups that spawn during the game. Powerups can provide temporary boosts to your damage absorption, speed, damage output, and ultimate—everything you and your team need to dominate the match. 
 [h2]New Companions[/h2] 
Update 44 also introduces[b] two brand-new Companions[/b] to [i]ESO[/i]: Tanlorin and Zerith-var. Tanlorin is a scrappy High Elf who mixes Soul Magic with Dragonknight abilities, while the stoic Khajiit Zerith-var utilizes the power of Necromancy.
 
At launch, you can acquire both new allies for free with an active ESO Plus membership or purchased with crowns from the in-game Crown Store. Once acquired, you can find and recruit them within the zones of Auridon (Tanlorin), and Reaper’s March (Zerith-var). 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/09/6565ad019450efd7fff6347ba2ac1040.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/09/6565ad019450efd7fff6347ba2ac1040.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Tanlorin and Zerith-var[/i]
 
Like previous Companions, each will have their own introductory quest that you will need to complete before you can summon them. In addition to being unique new characters (with their own stories, personalities, and quest lines), these two new Companions each also provide a special passive perk when adventuring with them: 
  [list][*]Tanlorin grants “Tanlorin’s Finesse,” which provides an increase to the time it takes to pick a lock, an increased chance to force a lock, and a reduced chance to break a lockpick. [/*][*]Zerith-var grants “Zerith’s Guidance,” which highlights valuable bags of loot found throughout Tamriel.[/*][/list]
While these perks are active when adventuring with each Companion in question, they can be permanently unlocked by completing each ally’s unique Achievement. 
 [h2]Scribing Powers Up (Your Whole Party)[/h2] 
Update 44 also introduces the game’s [b]first brand-new Grimoire[/b] since Update 42’s launch in June: Banner Bearer. The scribes of the Mages Guild, under the leadership of Votary Nahlia, have been studying Ulfsild’s work in the Scholarium at Eyevea. Banner Bearer is their newest creation, the first new Grimoire of the Second Era.
 
Banner Bearer is from the Support Skill Line and allows you to throw a banner on your back, leading the charge with an AoE buff to your group’s abilities that match your chosen Focus. No matter what shape your party takes, this new Grimoire will ensure you can give your allies the support they need! 
 
In addition to Banner Bearer, this patch also adds greater support for nine Grimoires by granting them access to [b]14 additional Focus Scripts[/b], providing more damage options and utility. Check the Patch Notes when they arrive for info on which specific scripts are being added for which Grimoires.
 [h2]Additional Update 44 Changes and Additions [/h2] 
In addition to the above, this base-game patch introduces a host of fixes, changes, and quality-of-life improvements that all [i]ESO[/i] players will appreciate. 
 
[b]Update to the In-Game Tutorial[/b]
 
Update 44 reinstates the first chapter of [i]ESO[/i]’s main questline as the game’s primary tutorial. This means that the old tutorial quest “Gates of Adamant” will be retired (although if you’re still in progress you can complete it as normal) in favor of the original “Soul Shriven in Coldharbour” quest. 
 
In addition to returning, [i]ESO[/i]’s original tutorial quest has undergone a series of changes and improvements. This includes changes to the quest structure, new and additional weapon drops, a more gradual introduction to game systems, and a modernizing of the combat, lockpicking, stealth tutorials, and more. There’s never been a better time for you (or a friend) to adventure in and explore Tamriel’s Second Era. 
 
[b]Imperial City Itemization Improvements[/b]
 
With this update, the heart of the empire also receives a series of itemization improvements, designed to help better reward those brave warriors willing to battle both the Daedra and their fellow players within the city’s streets and sewers. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/09/c62b98fe9b2295365c5729b81d9e3a6a.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/09/c62b98fe9b2295365c5729b81d9e3a6a.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Chase improved rewards in the Imperial City[/i]
 
This includes changes to how the Imperial Vaults work. For example, Imperial City keys and key fragments have been converted to new Imperial Fragments, the key fragment requirement to enter vaults have been removed, treasure chests have been replaced with vendors, and more. 
 
In the sewers, you can find many changes to the existing vendors, improving the quality and selection of wares, including both item sets and collectibles. 
 
[b]Golden Pursuits [/b]
 
Complete challenges, earn rewards! A brand-new [b]activity and rewards system [/b]coming with Update 44, Golden Pursuits are[b] dynamic, one-off campaigns [/b](accessed from the Group & Activity Finder)[b] [/b]that allow you to earn additional rewards during special limited-time windows. When a Golden Pursuit is active, you can complete a batch of curated, unique activities to claim in-game items while working towards a special capstone reward.
 
Rewards will vary but can include collectibles, items, in-game currencies, and more. Keep an eye out for the first Golden Pursuit campaign sometime after Update 44 launch. 
 
[b]New Skill Styles[/b]
 
Helping you stand out in the crowd in this update are four new Skill Styles. To start, both Psijic Order skills Accelerate and Undo (the ultimate) are getting purple variants. Even more dramatically, the One-Hand and Shield skill line’s Puncture ability is getting a molten variant, while the Destruction Staff’s Force Shock ability is getting a wildburn variant. Both Puncture, Lavaburst and Force Shock, Wildburn feature all-new special effects—the first of their kind! 
 
You can acquire these new Skill Styles via new in-game Achievements or with Archival Fortunes, with the exception of the Accelerate, Purple style, which can be rarely found within Psijic Portals. Keep an eye out for specifics on how to get your hands on these exciting new styles at launch!   
 
These are just some of the major changes coming with Update 44, but there’s a host of additional improvements, changes, and features we’re not quite ready to share fully yet. For example, this update also includes [b]an increase of furnishing base materials[/b] in regular harvest nodes, [b]adds HDR support[/b] for PC, and provides [b]quest pips for Master Writs[/b]. Finally, as part of this update, ESO Plus members will also enjoy a [b]10% bonus to Tel Var Stone and Alliance Point gains[/b]—phew![b] [/b]
 
For everything you need to know, keep an eye out for the [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/pts]patch notes[/url] when this base-game update arrives soon! 
 [h2]New Battles, Allies, Powers, and More [/h2] 
We’ve only just begun to delve into what’s coming soon with the Update 44 base-game patch. Keep an eye out for more on [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/]elderscrollsonline.com[/url] in the coming months as we get closer to release. Are you excited to take to the new Battlegrounds? Which new Companion will you recruit first? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url].  
 
[i]The Update 44 base-game patch arrives October 28 for PC/Mac and November 13 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles.[/i]

notes.title: Huge ESO update adds big new challenges to the MMO's roguelike mode

When people talk about the Elder Scrolls Online, it's always the world-building, the quests, and the exploration of areas of Tamriel that haven't been seen in games before that get bigged up. What's often missed off in the list of things it does really well is its player housing and its PvE roguelike mode titled the Infinite Archive. Well, these two features have received some big changes in the most recent ESO update, alongside tons of other new stuff that's hitting the MMO.
