notes.title: Update 43 Base-Game Patch Now Live on PC/Mac
notes.notes:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/08/ac41c359749773197532e468db0d09e4.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Return to the Infinite Archive, receive new visitors with Home Tours, and discover other additions and fixes—all part of the Update 43 base-game patch. [/i]

[previewyoutube=7i8xMctv4ss;full][/previewyoutube]
 
The Update 43 base-game patch is now live on PC/Mac. This update introduces new features, content, and improvements to [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i], completely free for all [i]ESO[/i] players.
 [h2]New Features[/h2] 
Those who enjoy delving deep into the Infinite Archive or showing off their latest home builds will appreciate the two big new features included in Update 43. 
 
[b]Infinite Archive Update[/b]
 
Return to the twisting halls of the Infinite Archive ([i]ESO[/i]’s near-endless PvE arena) and you’ll discover two new unique areas, new monsters, a host of new Visions and Verses, and new rewards. These rewards include new collectibles and seven all-new class sets, not found anywhere else in Tamriel! 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/08/80ebe975c599f3401b74f0d6a176f86a.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/08/80ebe975c599f3401b74f0d6a176f86a.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Discover new challenges and rewards in the Archive[/i]
 
To learn more about the additions coming to the Infinite Archive, check out [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/66519]this preview blog[/url]. 
 
[b]Home Tours[/b]
 
Share and showcase your flair for interior design and decoration with Home Tours, a new feature added to [i]ESO[/i]’s Housing System. With Home Tours, you can search for homes owned and decorated by another player and filter through labels, such as “Cozy” or “Festive.” 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/08/6cc578d8e8c04208c086cff373a71fc1.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/08/6cc578d8e8c04208c086cff373a71fc1.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Share your homes with the rest of the community[/i]
 
You can also browse the top player homes in the Recommended tab, recommend those homes to others, and favorite them to return to later. List your own home and see what people think of your creation! 
 
To learn more about Home Tours, check out [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/66495]this preview blog[/url]. 
 [h2]Additional Improvements[/h2] 
Update 43 also introduces a host of quality-of-life improvements for all [i]ESO[/i] players. This includes six new skill styles (for the Silver Bolts, Roar, Twin Slashes, Momentum, Elemental Storm, and Annulment skills) that can have their fragments dropped from base-game activities or acquired with Archival Fortunes from Infinite Archive. 
 
In addition, item set curation expands to include monster sets acquired via Undaunted Keys (from the Undaunted vendors), weekly Trial coffers, Trial leaderboard coffers, and Imperial City monster mask coffers. Finally, this update also adds improvements to mount previews within the Crown Store, and both Guild Trader and Guild Bank interfaces now remember the last Guild you interacted with.  
 
For a full list of all the changes, new features, and improvements arriving as part of the Update 43 base-game patch, check out the patch notes on [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]the official [i]ESO [/i]forums[/url]. 
 [h2]Free for All[/h2] 
As a base-game patch, Update 43 is free for all current [i]ESO[/i] players—no additional purchases required! Are you excited to share and showcase your home to the rest of [i]ESO[/i]’s housing community? Or perhaps you’re eager to conquer the Infinite Archive’s new stages and claim its new rewards? Let us know what aspects of Update 43 you’re most interested in via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url].

notes.title: Update 43 Preview—Home Tours
notes.notes:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/08/96762437908a5e00882e8c51688ed9db.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Take a tour of ESO’s latest housing feature with the developers as your guides.[/i]
 
The free Update 43 base-game patch brings a variety of new [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/66331]features and quality of life changes[/url] to [i]ESO[/i], including Home Tours. This new feature allows you to share and visit player homes and experience the incredible creativity of the [i]ESO [/i]housing community. This update officially arrives August 19 for PC/Mac and September 4 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles, but you can try out these changes on the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/66365]Public Test Server[/url] right now. 
 [h2]Opening the Door to New Possibilities[/h2] 
“Home Tours is a way for anyone, regardless of where they are in their housing journey, to share that creativity and become inspired,” says Cullen Lee, one of [i]ESO[/i]’s Senior Systems Designers. “We wanted to provide a tool that would help connect folks with a shared interest in housing, introduce folks to what’s possible in housing, and generally help build the housing community with a focus on positivity!”
 
“Home Tours is our next evolution toward building a stronger housing community,” explains James Sammartino, a Senior UI Engineer. “It gives you a way to share your creativity and passion with everyone easily and in one central place.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/08/fade49645b7283c741f990f513cf4e4e.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/08/fade49645b7283c741f990f513cf4e4e.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Make yourself at home and share with the community[/i]
 
So how does the new tool work? In short, it allows you to find, visit, share, and recommend [i]ESO[/i]’s player-made homes. 
 
“Anyone can go into a new section of the Activity Finder and list their homes for folks to tour, and tour homes themselves,” explains Cullen. “You can choose to anonymously recommend a limited number of homes each week, and those recommendations help determine a rotating selection of fantastic homes to visit in the Recommended section of Home Tours. You can also choose to favorite any home (even outside of Home Tours!) and revisit it later. When listing a home, you can include a custom nickname, as well as up to three tags to help communicate the overall vibe or focus of the home."
 [h2]Building a Strong Foundation[/h2] 
“We always start by asking ourselves what we want to accomplish, and by thinking about the people we're building the system for,” says Cullen. “For Home Tours, our two big goals were to make it easier to find amazing homes, and to help grow the housing community in a positive way. By keeping these in mind, we were able to make sure that the system is easy to hop into and keep our focus on creativity and visual variety.”
 
When building this new feature and the way it categorizes houses with tags, the team looked closely at the housing system’s existing player experiences and creations.
 
“As we iterated on our tags, we looked at a whole bunch of houses that the community has shared previously,” says Cullen.  “We practiced tagging them to find which areas we wanted to reinforce with additional tags and which tags could be cut to keep the overall list concise. Once we were happy with our list internally, we asked for community feedback on PTS, and incorporated that feedback. Once the community has had a chance to play further, we plan to continue to evaluate feedback and iterate as needed.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/08/dc1d04e6b8f95ace9ebb8133cf46f269.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/08/dc1d04e6b8f95ace9ebb8133cf46f269.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									  
[i]Be a courteous guest and a gracious host![/i]


Of course, this is only the  beginning of what’s possible with Home Tours.
  
“Home Tours is powered by you, the creator,” explains James.  “If you have homes that you want everyone to check out, then we encourage you  to list them. There is no limit. You could list one home, two homes or even  every home that you own—it's up to you.”
  [h2]Be Welcome in Tamriel with Home Tours[/h2]  
 When the feature goes live, the team is excited to see how players  embrace its potential, visit new homes, and share their own creations. 
  
“I’d love for the folks who are masters of the system to get  more widely recognized for their creations, and to continue to inspire each  other to greater heights,” says Cullen. “I’d love for more people to see what’s  possible in our housing system and eventually get the itch to build some homes  of their own.” 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/08/3ef902f42de3ebd89488e6cc0c0ee430.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/08/3ef902f42de3ebd89488e6cc0c0ee430.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]The housing community is the heart of Home Tours[/i]
 
“Our housing system is one of my absolute favorite features of [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i],” says James.[i] [/i]“As a member of our vibrant housing community, I have had the good fortune to be able to see some truly incredible homes and custom builds created by our players. I cannot tell you how much I am looking forward to giving everyone that plays our game the opportunity to find, enjoy, and share those amazing designs.”
 
“Everyone who tries out housing should be proud of their creations,” says Cullen. “You don’t have to spend 1,000 hours on a home or have a master’s degree in architecture to make something meaningful or cool. We built this system, but it’s your passion and dedication that will bring it to life.”
 
Are you ready to see the housing experience in [i]ESO[/i] expand and evolve with Home Tours? Share your plans (and your favorite builds) with us via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]. 
 
[i]Update 43 is a free base-game patch for all ESO players and arrives August 19 for PC/Mac and September 4 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles.   [/i]

notes.title: Update 43 Preview—Infinite Archive Updates
notes.notes:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/08/bf7d0b70fe3aa43bc44a324a14c65982.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Learn more about the additions coming to Infinite Archive as part of Update 43 with these developer insights.[/i]
 
Update 43 is on its way with a host of [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/66331]quality of life improvements and base-game refinements[/url] free to all [i]ESO[/i] players, including substantial updates to the Infinite Archive. This update officially arrives August 19 for PC/Mac and September 4 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles, but you can try out these changes on the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/66365]Public Test Server[/url] right now. 
 [h2]Refreshing the Infinite [/h2] 
“The goal with Infinite Archive is to give players a changing experience they can jump into and always find new challenges and ways to play,” says Mike Finnigan, [i]ESO[/i]’s Encounters Lead. “It was built from the ground up to be able to be augmented, changed, and added to.”
 
“Infinite Archive is all about variety of experience, and [with Update 43] we wanted to pump up the volume on that variety,” explains Shane Slama, the Dungeon Team Product Owner. “We added new methods of dispatching maligraphies (the arena’s various foes), new maligraphies from all over Tamriel to test your skills, and all-new environments that have their own challenges.”
 
With these goals and features in mind, the team worked hard to create new experiences in the Infinite Archive with the free Update 43 base-game patch. 
 
“The biggest change is the two new arena types you will see,” says Finnigan. “While we maintain the Apocryphal feel of the original, adding new fire and ice elements really gives them a unique feeling.” 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/08/80ebe975c599f3401b74f0d6a176f86a.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/08/80ebe975c599f3401b74f0d6a176f86a.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Survive all-new arenas[/i]
 
“One of the requested features since the launch of Infinite Archive was to diversify the look of the different combat settings,” says Shane Slama. “The fiery reds and icy blues stand out from the Apocrypha greens, while also still having the elements that define the appearance of the Infinite Archive.”
 [h2]New Challenges, New Tricks[/h2] 
To survive this augmented Infinite Archive, you (and your teammate or companion) will need to discover and utilize new strategies and power. 
 
“How players tackle the ice and fire stages will be intriguing, because both arenas play so differently,” says Finnigan. “You might want to move more in the fire arena, while in the ice one, its best to find the safe spots while you fight.”
 
You’ll certainly have to watch your feet while battling within the two new arenas, but to help survive these new challenges, this update also includes a whopping [b]eight new Verses[/b] and [b]10 new Visions[/b].
 
“You’ll see new options when selecting your Verses and Visions which may expand on your particular build and impact the way you approach the upcoming stage,” explains Slama. “For example, depending on your selections, you can block attacks to unleash a devastating explosion with your next Bash via the Reflected Ruin Verse.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/08/0d3bedfc3fd789badc768d7c4bb5fac1.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/08/0d3bedfc3fd789badc768d7c4bb5fac1.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Find new strategies and power[/i]
 
“One of my favorites is the Phalanx Verse, which summons a line of soldiers to block attacks, giving you a damage shield if you stand behind them while they attempt to stagger foes,” says Finnigan.
 
“I also enjoy the Storm Projection Offensive Vision,” says Slama. “It’s unique in that it provides a passive increase to all your Shock damage, but it also functions like a Verse by adding chain lightning to any of your direct attacks.”
 [h2]Claim the Archive’s Relics[/h2] 
New challenges mean new rewards for those venturing into the Infinite Archive, and this update introduces additional collectibles and, most importantly, [b]seven new Class Sets[/b] that can be found only in this specific location. 
 
“Our goal for the new Class Sets were to better represent the aesthetic themes and mechanical gameplay of each skill line while keeping the sets simpler than their previous counterparts,” explains Nadav Pechthold, one of the team’s Combat Designers.
 
“For example, we wanted the Dragonknight wearing Pyrebrand to be a representation of the Ardent Flame skill line, making use of damage over time abilities to build up to a huge payoff. You can become the flame and then the explosive force that comes after.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/08/35ee11d814c6fe297c062e33c093ccd7.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/08/35ee11d814c6fe297c062e33c093ccd7.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
Of course, the additional Class Sets aren’t the only new rewards on offer, and those who delve deep into the Infinite Archive will discover all kinds of goodies up for grabs.
 
“With this update, we have cooked up some new consumable rewards for players,” says Finnigan. “Including a new consumable that allows you to transform into a random avatar without the need for the requisite Visions.”
 
“I really like the new Eye of the Infinite account upgrade Tool, which summons up a shard of Tho’at that hovers up into the air and bursts apart,” says Slama. “It’s a cool effect that may be used anywhere just like a Memento, but if you use it while inside Infinite Archive, a maligraphic Watcher emerges from the burst and joins your group to help bust up Tho’at’s forces.”
 [h2]Challenge the Infinite Archive Anew[/h2] 
The Infinite Archive grows even more vast and dangerous with Update 43. Are you ready to return to the halls of Hermaeus Mora for new arenas, new foes, and most importantly, new rewards? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]. 
 
[i]Update 43 is a free base-game patch for all ESO players and arrives August 19 for PC/Mac and September 4 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles.  [/i]

notes.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Gold Road & Update 42 Now Live on PC/Mac
notes.notes:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/ab7441b3abfa4ddc788528fb315ab9e1.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Uncover the mystery of the Forgotten Prince with the Gold Road Chapter and Update 42 base-game patch, now live on PC/Mac![/i]
 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Gold Road[/i] is now live on PC/Mac, Steam, and Epic Game Store. This new Chapter for [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i] introduces a new zone to explore, West Weald, along with a new system to master called Scribing. It also concludes the story of Ithelia, the Forgotten Prince, which began with 2023’s Shadows Over Morrowind saga.  
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/459638ba6ddd36869757f1ff8004d442.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/459638ba6ddd36869757f1ff8004d442.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]The Forgotten Prince returns[/i]
 
In addition to the Chapter, this release also includes the U42 base-game patch, introducing a host of bug fixes, balance changes, and other improvements free for all [i]ESO [/i]players. You can view the full patch notes for [i]Gold Road[/i] and Update 42 [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]on our official forums[/url]. 
 [h2]Gold Road Chapter[/h2] 
In [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Gold Road[/i] you can venture into the heart of Colovian Imperial culture as you unravel the mystery of the return of a never-before-seen Daedric Prince—Ithelia. While [i]Gold Road[/i] continues (and concludes) the Shadow Over Morrowind narrative that began in 2023, you can experience and enjoy the latest Chapter’s storyline without having to play any of the game’s previous content. 
 
[b]West Weald Zone[/b]
 
Located along Cyrodiil’s southwest border and neighboring Valenwood and the Gold Coast, this new Chapter allows you to [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/66003]explore West Weald[/url], a wealthy Imperial province thrown into chaos. Home to the proud and cosmopolitan Colovians, West Weald has found itself besieged by mysterious unknown Daedra. Even worse, a large part of the region has seemingly overnight become overgrown by the vast jungles of Valenwood, resulting in the migration of local Wood Elves. 

[previewyoutube=znogunEB5V0;full][/previewyoutube]										      							    							      								      																																																																																				      																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																								      							    							      								      									 
Within this new zone, you can explore the city of Skingrad in addition to both the Gold Road region and emergent Dawnwood, where you’ll discover a multitude of new side quests, world bosses, delves, public dungeons, and more. Discover more about the zone in [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/66003]this preview blog[/url]. 
 
[b]Scribing System[/b]
 
An all-new system introduced with [i]Gold Road[/i], Scribing grants you the ability to craft and [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/66057]customize your own handmade abilities[/url]. With Scribing, you can select a base Grimoire and tailor it with scripts to create an ability that perfectly fits your playstyle and build. 

[previewyoutube=_yWOpQ6_T0M;full][/previewyoutube]										      							    							      								      																																																																																				      																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																													      							    							      								      									 
With this new system, you’ll discover a robust questline that has you restore an ancient Scholarium while diving deep into the mysteries of magicka in Tamriel. Whether you’re looking for greater power, versatility, or roleplaying opportunities, Scribing introduces a powerful new way to tailor your builds and play your way. 
 
[b]Group Activities[/b]
 
In addition to the zone’s multiple world bosses, delves, and public dungeons, [i]Gold Road[/i] also introduces two new group activities to challenge you and your allies: the Lucent Citadel and Mirrormoor Incursions. 
 
In the Lucent Citadel Trial, you and your large group (12 players total) must venture into a long-forgotten Daedric vault within the realm of Fargrave, contend with its unique boss encounters, and seek out the mysterious Arcane Knot. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/82f94f90370d384feb55d981391e73aa.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/82f94f90370d384feb55d981391e73aa.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Team up to defend West Weald[/i]
 
Mirrormoor Incursions are a new type of world event plaguing West Weald and threatening to overwhelm the region with the minions of Ithelia. You can discover more about both activities in [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/66085]this preview blog[/url].  
 
[b]New Rewards[/b]
 
In addition to a new zone to explore, stories to experience, and challenges to overcome, the [i]Gold Road[/i] Chapter is full of new Achievements, items, and collectibles for you to loot and earn. 
 
Specifically, West Weald features 10 powerful item sets to loot and craft in addition to three unique Mythic items to uncover using the Antiquities system. Completing Achievements can also earn you a wide range of collectibles, such as style pages for King Nantharion’s Royal Armor or even the Wildburn Lynx mount. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/ad5fa21a49f122ad3b119ca16cf333b5.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/ad5fa21a49f122ad3b119ca16cf333b5.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]New collectibles, styles, and more[/i]
 
Rewards also include fragments for the all-new Tales of Tribute patron and deck, Saint Alessia, in addition to a new type of collectible, called Skill Styles. Skill Styles are cosmetic collectibles that allow you to change the visuals for your existing abilities. With [i]Gold Road[/i] and Update 42, there are 22 Skill Styles for you to unlock and apply from various sources, including quest rewards, public dungeons, and other activities. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/1d948b29fef327a9c9c14a8ce284f2c1.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/1d948b29fef327a9c9c14a8ce284f2c1.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Great challenges lead to great rewards![/i]
 
Finally, [i]Gold Road[/i] and Update 42 also introduces the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/66017]Adventurer Across a Decade[/url] Achievement, celebrating [i]ESO[/i]’s 10-Year Anniversary by granting you the Fractured Glory skin for having completed the game’s story content (including [i]Gold Road[/i]) throughout its long history. 
 [h2]Purchase Details & Requirements[/h2] 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Gold Road[/i] is available [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/joinus]to buy now[/url], with four editions:
    [list][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online Deluxe Collection: Gold Road[/i] [/*][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online Collection: Gold Road[/i] [/*][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online Deluxe Upgrade: Gold Road[/i] [/*][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Upgrade: Gold Road[/i] [/*][/list]
If you are a brand-new or lapsed player, both [i]Collection [/i]editions include the base game, the [i]Gold Road[/i] Chapter, and ALL previous Chapters. If you already own [i]ESO[/i] and its previous Chapters, both [i]Upgrade [/i]editions grant access to the [i]Gold Road[/i] Chapter. Note that to run [i]Gold Road[/i] on PC/Mac, your machine needs to meet the game's requirements here: [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/newplayerguide/minspec]PC[/url], [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/newplayerguide/minspec]Mac[/url].
 
In addition to the game, both versions of [i]Gold Road[/i] are also available in [i]Deluxe[/i] editions, which feature a unique mount, pet, memento, outfit style, and emotes.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/be77a18cfe66c3cfa77b66b9c1e021ca.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/01/be77a18cfe66c3cfa77b66b9c1e021ca.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Gold Road Deluxe Edition items[/i]
 
To find out more about [i]Gold Road[/i] and its editions, [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/65365]check out this blog[/url].
 [h2]Getting Started in Gold Road[/h2] 
Ready to venture into West Weald? You can travel to the new zone and begin your adventure in the following ways: 
 
[b]Via Wayshrine[/b]
 
You can teleport directly to the zone by accessing your map, selecting Gold Road, and then selecting the automatically unlocked Skingrad Vineyards Wayshrine.
 
[b]Via the Gold Road Main Quest[/b]
 
You can have the game lead you to West Weald by picking up the Chapter’s first main story quest, “Paths of Chaos.” You can find it by navigating to your Collections and then viewing Stories, selecting Chapter, and then Gold Road.  
 
[b]Via the Tutorial[/b]
 
You can also travel to West Weald by creating a new character and completing the tutorial. At the end of the tutorial experience, you can select the zone as your destination and begin.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/178df5daaf8d02cd7580ae91c5a6519b.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/05/178df5daaf8d02cd7580ae91c5a6519b.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Adventure awaits in Gold Road[/i]
 
Note that there are no level or story requirements for the [i]Gold Road [/i]Chapter, allowing you to jump right in with any of your characters—existing or brand new! 
 [h2]Update 42 [/h2] 
Launching in tandem with Gold Road is Update 42, a free base-game patch for all [i]ESO[/i] players. Update 42 introduces a series of balance changes, fixes, and additions with no purchase required (beyond access to the game itself). 
 
[b]Improvements to In-game Mail[/b]
 
With Update 42, we’ve made a series of improvements to in-game mail, focusing on its interface and notifications. This includes the addition of categories (player mail, system mail, and system alerts), improved sorting, attachment preview, and inventory space display. 
 
This update also adds a “Delete After Claim” option (helping you keep inboxes under control), a “Take All” function, and notifications for mail with attachments. In addition, messages received from your Hirelings will now be automatically recorded in the Lore Library under “Hireling Correspondence.”
 
Finally, as part of the team’s efforts to improve server performance and stability, Update 42’s mail changes also include reduced expiration times based on the mail types. 
 
[b]Environment Sustainability Features[/b]
 
With this update, we’re joining Team Xbox in reducing our game’s environmental impact with the following new features:
      [list][*]Reduced GPU use during periods of inactivity for PC/Mac, Xbox Series X|S, and PlayStation 5. [/*][list][*]Reducing resolution and imposing a framerate cap during inactivity. [/*][/list][*]Screen dimming during periods of inactivity on PC/Mac. [/*][list][*]Note that this already occurs on consoles.[/*][/list][*]Reduced GPU use in Contextual Menus for Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5. [/*][list][*]When viewing most menus on consoles, the framerate is capped.[/*][/list][/list]
Note that the improvements to Xbox and PlayStation consoles won’t occur until Update 42 launches on those platforms on June 18. 
 
For more on Xbox’s sustainability efforts, [url=https://www.xbox.com/en-US/community/sustainability]visit this page[/url]. 
 
For everything changing and coming with Update 42, be sure to check out the [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]patch notes on the official forums[/url]. 
 [h2]Forgotten No More[/h2] 
The Forgotten Prince walks Tamriel, and chaos follows in her wake. Investigate the emergence of Ithelia and confront her scions, explore the Colovian region of West Weald, and unlock and customize new abilities with the Scribing System in [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Gold Road[/i]. Tell us if you’re excited to dive deep into this new Chapter via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]. 
 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Gold Road is now live on PC/Mac and arrives June 18 for Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, and PlayStation 5.[/i]

notes.title: Scions of Ithelia & Update 41 Now Live on PC/Mac
notes.notes:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/03/35204c162351d7ec78c18a29b0409270.jpg[/img]																											      								      									  
[i]Delve into two new challenging dungeons and begin a story  that will take you to West Weald in the Scions of Ithelia DLC and Update 41  base-game patch. [/i]
  
The [i]Scions of Ithelia[/i] dungeon DLC game pack and free  Update 41 base-game patch are now live on PC/Mac. If you play on Xbox or  PlayStation, don’t worry, the dungeon DLC arrives with the free update on  consoles March 26. 
  
Venture into two new dungeons, Oathsworn Pit and Bedlam  Veil, and prepare for the adventures to come in the upcoming [i]Gold Road[/i]  Chapter. 
										      							    							      								      																																																																																				      																															
[previewyoutube=6V3SSlcry0Q;full][/previewyoutube]
																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																													      							    							      								      									 
You can gain access to [i]Scions of Ithelia[/i] via [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/esoplus]ESO Plus™ membership[/url] or purchase it with crowns from the in-game [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/crownstore]Crown Store[/url].
 
This launch also features the Update 41 base-game patch, providing all [i]ESO[/i] players with a series of free additions and improvements to the game. Check out the patch notes for both [i]Scions of Ithelia [/i]and Update 41 on [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]our official forums[/url].
 [h2]Scions of Ithelia DLC Game Pack[/h2] 
Discover new stories and challenges awaiting you and your strongest allies in two all-new PvE dungeons: [b]Oathsworn Pit[/b] and [b]Bedlam Veil[/b]. Earn unique rewards as you and your party battle your way through these two perilous adventures and uncover the malevolent forces at work in the upcoming [i]Gold Road[/i] Chapter. 
 
[b]Oathsworn Pit[/b]
 
A training ground for Malacath’s most-devoted followers has been invaded, and the God of Curses calls upon you to enact his revenge! Who are the Wood Elf invaders, and what are their plans for the Oathsworn survivors? You and your team must help the Orc Bazrag reclaim the pit’s lodges and free its captives before all are lost.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/03/b819ce9921c2c2be684c7137e4c02c05.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/03/b819ce9921c2c2be684c7137e4c02c05.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Fight on behalf of Malacath[/i]
 
Find out more concerning the Oathsworn Pit in [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/65563]this preview blog[/url].
 
[b]Bedlam Veil[/b] 
 
Located with Fa-Nuit-Hen’s demiplane of Maelstrom, the Bedlam Veil is a storehouse, of sorts, for all manner of weapons, artifacts, and monsters. Now, a mysterious cult has begun looting the Demiprince’s realm, and the “Multiplier of Motions Known” needs your help defending their hold and preventing the raiders from claiming a mysterious prize at its heart. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/03/462275728e42e9f5d29114261ac76f98.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/03/462275728e42e9f5d29114261ac76f98.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Confront mirrored monstrosities[/i]
 
You can discover more about this dungeon in [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/65659]our recent preview[/url].
 
[b]New Challenges and Rewards[/b]
 
You can attempt the Oathsworn Pit and Bedlam Veil dungeons in normal, veteran, and hard mode difficulties. In addition, each hosts its own rewards and Achievements, including six new item sets, two monster sets, and unique collectibles.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/03/f834d82b2a1c41f853e4d209d849b18e.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/03/f834d82b2a1c41f853e4d209d849b18e.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Scions of Ithelia dungeon rewards[/i]
 [h2]Getting Started[/h2] 
You can access the [i]Scions of Ithelia[/i] DLC via ESO Plus membership or by purchasing it from the Crown Store for 1,500 crowns (listed under DLC). If your ESO Plus membership lapses, you will lose access to the DLC until you renew your membership or purchase it with crowns. However, you will not lose any items, Achievements, or other rewards earned prior. 
 
The [i]Scions of Ithelia [/i]Deluxe Bundle is also available for 4,000 crowns and includes access to the DLC game pack, Ashbone Sabre Cat mount, Ashbone Echalette pet, and five Crown Experience Scrolls. You can purchase the Deluxe Bundle from the Featured section of the in-game Crown Store. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/03/dcf04ee0cbc67f136922edb9f4c415ee.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2024/03/dcf04ee0cbc67f136922edb9f4c415ee.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Scions of Ithelia Deluxe Bundle[/i]
 
Note that ALL ESO Plus members can claim the [i]Scions of Ithelia[/i] Deluxe Bundle for [b]free during a two-week window [/b]starting on each specific platform's launch (March 11 for PC/Mac and March 26 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles)—don’t forget to claim it from the Crown Store while it's available!
 
Once you have access to the [i]Scions of Ithelia[/i] dungeons, you can start both PvE challenges by the following methods: 
   [list][*]By teleporting directly into the two dungeons from your map[/*][*]By using the Dungeon Finder tool[/*][*]By walking up to the dungeon entrances within the Reach (Oathsworn Pit) and Wrothgar (Bedlam Veil) [/*][/list][h2]Update 41 Base-Game Patch[/h2] 
Launching at the same time as the [i]Scions of Ithelia[/i] DLC, the Update 41 base-game patch is completely free for all current [i]ESO[/i] players and includes a series of fixes, additions, and improvements to the game’s core experience. 
 
[b]Stackable Siege Weaponry[/b]
 
Helping you lighten the inventory load in Cyrodiil with Update 41 is the addition of stackable siege weaponry. With this update, you can stack up to 20 similar siege weapons if they are at maximum health. When you have siege weapons in your quickslots, it will always use the weapon with the lowest health in your inventory. 
 
[b]New Rewards[/b]
 
This update also introduces some new Rewards for the Worthy PvP item set rewards. This includes the Oakfather’s Retribution light armor set, the Blunted Blades medium armor set, and the Baan Dar’s Blessing heavy armor set. These new item sets are sure to help you on Tamriel’s myriad battlefields, so keep an eye out for them next time you open your Rewards for the Worthy boxes. 
 
Additionally, the Unkindness of Ravens body and face marking is now available by acquiring and using the Runebound Tome: Unkindness of Ravens. You can acquire this tome for 100,000 Tel Var Stones, and it requires 50 Siege of Cyrodiil Merits to use. 
 
In tandem with the new PvP sets is an all-new Mythic item you can acquire via the Antiquities system. The Torc of the Last Ayleid King necklace disables all other item set bonuses while increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage, boosting your Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery, and reducing your total damage taken by 15%.
 
This update also introduces style pages for the various Class Sets found in the Infinite Archive. Now, style pages for your specific class will drop within the archive, with other style pages also dropping once you’ve earned every page for your specific class. 
 
[b]Update to ESO’s PC/Mac Min Spec[/b]
 
Finally, Update 41 also features an update to the game’s min spec for PC and Mac. This change ensures a continued level of performance for older systems that can be maintained in newer content as well. Specifically, with Update 41, [i]ESO[/i] no longer officially supports the Windows 7 operating system for future compatibility. You will still be able to play on Windows 7 machines but note that there’s no guarantee that this will continue to be the case moving forward. 
 
These Update 41 features and changes outlined above are just some of the highlights included in this base-game patch. You can see the full list of everything included in Update 41 by visiting our [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]Patch Notes forum[/url]. As a base-game patch, Update 41 is free for all current [i]ESO [/i]players—enjoy! 
 [h2]Answer the Call to Arms[/h2] 
Defend the demiplane of Maelstrom and enact revenge on behalf of the God of Curses in [i]Scions of Ithelia[/i], an all-new dungeon DLC pack for [i]ESO[/i]’s PvE adventurers. Are you ready to delve into the Oathsworn Pit and Bedlam Veil? Are you excited for all the new rewards coming soon with Update 41? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url].
 
[i]The Scions of Ithelia dungeon DLC pack and Update 41 is now live on PC/Mac, and will arrive March 26 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles.[/i]

notes.title: Infinite Archive & Update 40 Now Live on PC/Mac
notes.notes:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/93b563f90ddef66e9abade33ebe4014a.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Discover the Update 40 base-game patch, featuring the unending battle of the Infinite Archive and more, now live on PC/Mac! [/i]
 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Infinite Archive[/i] and Update 40 are now live on PC/Mac. If you are a console player, don’t worry. Update 40 arrives on November 14 for Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, and PlayStation 5, too! 
 
This base-game patch introduces an all-new PvE activity for Tamriel’s adventurers and a host of new features and quality-of-life improvements—completely free for all [i]ESO [/i]players!   
[previewyoutube=aypqJhUi0eM;full][/previewyoutube]									      							    							      								      																																																																																				      																															
																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																												      							    							      								      									 [h2]Infinite Archive[/h2] 
In the Infinite Archive, you can discover an unending challenge as you battle your way through the shifting libraries and twisting pathways of one of Hermaeus Mora’s most mysterious strongholds.
 
A malignant force is causing chaos within the once solemn archive, and its custodian, Master Malkhest, needs brave explorers to investigate and fight back against the corruption. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/4f5eb2f67d03541aa8697d37debdc896.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/4f5eb2f67d03541aa8697d37debdc896.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Battle through the Archive[/i]
 
[b]Unending Challenge[/b]
 
In this all-new PvE activity, you can team up with a trusted ally or go it solo as you contend with randomly generated stages filled with waves of monsters and perilous boss encounters. 
 
The further you progress into this eternal arena, the more dangerous and numerous your foes become. Fall to the Archive’s dangers three times, and your run ends, plus you have to start over. But don’t let that phase you, as there’s always another expedition into the Infinite Archive waiting, and the greater the dangers, the greater the rewards are in turn! 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esossl-a.akamaihd.net/uploads/Community/Article/Achievement_ELAR_ThoatReplicanum_GlassMantikoraCombat%20%201%20.jpg]																					[img]https://esossl-a.akamaihd.net/uploads/Community/Article/Achievement_ELAR_ThoatReplicanum_GlassMantikoraCombat%20%201%20.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Survive twisted maligraphies[/i]
 
Helping you survive these encounters are two types of boons you can choose along the way: Verses (temporary buffs that last until the end of the next Stage), and Visions (more permanent buffs that last your entire run). The Verses and Visions you choose can have a major impact on your run, so choose wisely! 
 
[b]Infinite Rewards[/b]
 
As you continue your expedition into the Infinite Archive, you can discover and unlock a host of specials rewards, including unique collectibles, item sets, and more—all granted by the Prince of Knowledge himself! 
 
These rewards include class set items, the first of their kind, which provide powerful boons to select Class Skill Lines. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/09/5e802a1ba276c8d61c4afe1758e10e1a.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/09/5e802a1ba276c8d61c4afe1758e10e1a.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Empower class skills with new item sets[/i]
 
However, that’s not all. As you complete expeditions, you also earn a new currency called Archival Fortunes. With Archival Fortunes, you can purchase all manner of helpful items from the vendors within the Infinite Archive’s central hub. This includes one-time use buffs, individual item set items, fragments of collectibles, and even permanent account unlocks that provide boons for future runs! 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/8e6903a91a99738393994927036ff658.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/8e6903a91a99738393994927036ff658.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Endless Archive collectible rewards[/i]
 
Finally, the Infinite Archive also features a host of unique in-game collectibles that you can’t earn anywhere else in Tamriel or Oblivion, including the Maligraphic Mount, Maligraphic Skeever pet, a unique Tales of Tribute deck, and much more. Check out [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/64891]our preview[/url] for more information on the Infinite Archive’s rewards.
 [h2]Getting Started[/h2] 
The Infinite Archive is a [b]free[/b] base-game addition to [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i] and is part of the Update 40 patch. There is no additional purchase necessary, although ESO Plus members will enjoy a bonus to Archival Fortune gains during their expeditions. 
 
You can access the Infinite Archive via two methods:
  [list][*]If you own the Necrom Chapter, you can find the entrance to the Infinite Archive northeast of Cipher's Midden in Apocrypha.[/*][*]If you don’t own the Chapter, select the Infinite Archive icon on your map of Apocrypha to teleport directly there.[/*][/list]							      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/8900c6e9c570f3ec8db144c6e6fce32c.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/8900c6e9c570f3ec8db144c6e6fce32c.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Prepare for adventure[/i]
 
Brave adventurers may wish to dive right in to the archive’s myriad mazelike passages, but you may wish to review these [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/64837]developer tips[/url] before you begin your expedition. Preparation is key—good luck!
 [h2]Update 40 [/h2] 
In addition to the new PvE activity, Update 40 also includes a host of new features and quality-of-life improvements that all of Tamriel’s adventurers can enjoy. 
 
[b]Group Finder[/b]
 
The new Group Finder tool makes it easier than ever to find likeminded players to join you for practically any in-game activity, including typical group challenges such as Trials or Dungeon runs, but also more social activities such as zone explorations, roleplay sessions, or fashion contests! 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/0f2f8e781eacee9f7a7a165c6b2e4019.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/0f2f8e781eacee9f7a7a165c6b2e4019.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Group Finder UI[/i]
 
There are a host of categories you can choose from when finding a group, but the Custom category allows you to create or find fellow players for any unique activity you can dream up! 
 
In addition, the Group Finder allows you to set up requirements for your groups, including roles, CP levels, voice chat, and many more. 
 
[b]Grand Master Crafting Stations[/b]
 
Update 40 also introduces a new type of end-game furnishing for Tamriel’s master crafters: Grand Master Crafting Stations. These special items allow you to consolidate your home’s (likely many) attuned crafting stations into one, severely reducing the amount of housing slots your crafting stations take up AND freeing up space in general. The more attuned crafting stations you “feed” to your Grand Master station, the more visually distinct that specific furnishing will appear as it evolves over time. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/ed2a0be2d781a7eb96a51f70e780978c.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/ed2a0be2d781a7eb96a51f70e780978c.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Grand Master Crafting Stations[/i]
 
You can acquire Grand Master Crafting Stations using Writ Vouchers from the Achievement Mediator, Faustina Curio, with a unique furnishing available for each of Blacksmithing, Jewelry Crafting, Clothing, and Woodworking. 
 
You can dive deeper into both the Group Finder and Grand Master Crafting Stations in [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/64897]this preview blog[/url]. 
 
[b]Jewelry Crafting Rebalance[/b]
 
This patch also establishes a broad rebalancing of Jewelry Crafting to help align its costs with the game’s other crafting disciplines. This includes the removal of Jewelry Crafting grains and conversion into platings in addition to increasing the total boosters needed to upgrade your jewelry. As a result, upgrading rings and amulets is now easier and cheaper than ever before.
 
[b]Quest XP & Gold Standardization[/b]
 
Finally, Update 40 also standardizes the Experience Point and Gold rewards for many of the game’s quests, including those associated with zones, main storylines, prologues, dailies, guild storylines, and more. This will result in more consistent rewards for the game’s various quests based on their complexity or length. 
 
Of course, these are just some of the changes implemented with the base-game patch. Be sure to visit our [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]Patch Notes forum[/url] to review everything coming with this massive update. 
 [h2]Infinite Challenges[/h2] 
In the Update 40 base-game patch, you can discover an all-new challenge for you and your fiercest allies as you delve ever-deeper into the dynamic galleries of a corrupted library. How far will your expedition into the Infinite Archive get? The only limits are your preparation and skills! Tell us if you’ll be venturing into the free Infinite Archive PvE activity via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url]—good luck!
 
[i]The Update 40 base-game patch and Infinite Archive are now live on PC/Mac and arrive November 14 for Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, and PlayStation 5. [/i]

notes.title: ESO Devs Talk Update 40’s Group Finder and Grand Master Crafting Station
notes.notes:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/75f24f34ef071fbace0b19f56124674c.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Learn more about two of the big new additions arriving as part of the Update 40 base-game patch.[/i]
 
Dive deep into [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/64689]Update 40[/url]’s two major base-game additions with two members of the development team responsible for the upcoming Group Finder tool and Grand Master Crafting Stations. These changes, along with everything else coming in Update 40, will be free for all players!
 [h2]Group Finder Tool[/h2] 
“Group content can be difficult to break into when you don't have a social circle or are just stepping into it,” says Bobby Weir, [i]ESO[/i]’s Lead UI Designer. “We aimed to create a tool that would help bridge that gap and make it easier for folks to meet others with similar goals. This is especially true for content that requires a group but doesn't have an easy way to find one.” 
 
Arriving in Update 40, the new Group Finder tool allows you to quickly jump into [i]ESO[/i]’s various activities, from Trial or Dungeon runs, World Boss zone tours, or social events like roleplaying or fashion contests.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/67df998dd2e392b1d75921537c6677a2.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/67df998dd2e392b1d75921537c6677a2.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Group up to take on almost any challenge[/i]
 
To ensure the Group Finder covered as many needs as possible, the team started with major content categories that typically require a group, such as Dungeons and Trials, but they did not stop there. They also included content where players generally group together, even if it’s not required. 
 
“Cyrodiil and the Imperial City are good examples of activities where there's safety in numbers, as are the game’s world bosses and world events,” explains Bobby. “We also looked at activities that may have only small gameplay benefits while grouped, but potentially strong social benefits. You may not strictly need someone to quest or explore with for example, but it can be more enjoyable with a friend. We also added a Custom category to fill in any of the gaps.”
 
Because the tool needed to cover these many different activities, the development of the Group Finder proved to be a complex process for the team. 
 
“It can be difficult to strike a balance between usability and a wide variety of functionality,” says Bobby. “With most new features, we look back at similar things we've done in the past, either for learnings or to leverage UI paradigms from it. Guild Finder was a common reference point for this feature, since a lot of components are similar. With our UI, we focus on consistency across features so that if you learn it in one place, you have a good idea of how it'll work in this new place.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/0f2f8e781eacee9f7a7a165c6b2e4019.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/0f2f8e781eacee9f7a7a165c6b2e4019.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Group Finder helps you find like-minded adventurers[/i]
 
“The trickiest part was finding ways to fit all of the niche requirements for each content category together in a way that flowed well,” explains Bobby. “The UI design consisted of over 260 mockup screenshots!” 
 
All that hard work has translated into a new tool for players to come together and explore Tamriel in any way they choose.
 [h2]Grand Master Crafting Stations[/h2] 
Since their introduction in 2017, Attunable Crafting Stations have been highly sought-after by Tamriel’s master crafters. Perhaps even [b]too [/b]sought after—as new sets have been added to the game over time, the space required for a full set of these desirable furnishings has ballooned. Now, with Update 40, a new feature resolves the issue for good. 
 
“Grand Master Crafting Stations build on our prior Attunable Crafting Stations and help to solve a fundamental problem with the way they expand over time,” says Senior Systems Designer Cullen Lee. “If you’ve got 75+ sets for four different professions, that’s 300+ crafting stations to organize. They also eat up a huge chunk of your home’s furnishing budget, and that problem gets bigger with every zone. With Grand Master Crafting Stations, you can squish all those sets down into a single station per trade skill, so instead of 300+ stations, it’s just four, forever.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/ed2a0be2d781a7eb96a51f70e780978c.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/ed2a0be2d781a7eb96a51f70e780978c.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Grand Master Crafting Stations distill the essence of a craft[/i]
 
Players can feed their Attunable Crafting Stations to Grand Master Crafting Stations, giving them access to the function of any consumed station. Of course, getting your hands on these new stations won’t be easy, as they require the Unsurpassed Crafter Achievement* and significant resources.  
 
“Grand Master Crafting Stations represent the top end of crafting mastery. As such, they have a significant cost associated with them while still making up a relatively small fraction of the overall cost of building a collection of set stations,” Cullen notes. “These are something really special, and they’re not something most folks should feel pressured to spend Vouchers on early in their Master Writ career.”
 
For those who do make the journey as a Grand Master crafter, the new stations appear visually distinct from regular Attunable ones.  
 
“We wanted people with a large collection of set stations to feel proud when they looked at their station,” says Cullen. “After some iteration, we landed on a design where the station grows physically more complex at certain thresholds as you add sets. There's also a visual projection of the tradeskill symbol above the station once you’ve unlocked every set.”
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/45437f689ab857e601ca2d1ce5e31714.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/10/45437f689ab857e601ca2d1ce5e31714.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Refined designs for refined work[/i]
 
These exciting new features should be a great boon to the [i]ESO [/i]community, with one assisting in forging new bonds in battle, and the other with forging new gear with which to undertake those challenges! Which Update 40 feature are you looking forward to the most? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url]!
 
[i]Update 40 arrives free for all players on October 30 for PC/Mac and November 14 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles.[/i]
 
[i]*Requiring the completion of 100 Master Writs to unlock—no easy task![/i]

notes.title: Update 40 Brings All-New Improvements to Tamriel’s Adventurers
notes.notes:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/09/884ff6f8d40a995420d6fcfd1f78be27224025.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Learn about some of the key additions and changes arriving with the free Update 40 base-game patch. [/i]
 
The Update 40 base-game patch arrives October 30 on PC/Mac and November 14 on Xbox and PlayStation consoles. In addition to the [b]Infinite Archive PvE activity[/b], this update also introduces a host of new features and additions completely free for all existing [i]ESO [/i]players, no additional purchases required. 
 [h2]New Grouping Tool[/h2] 
If you enjoy teaming up with your fellow adventures, the new Group Finder allows you to create parties for almost any group activity in [i]ESO[/i]. This includes dungeons, arenas, the upcoming Infinite  Archive, trials, PvP, and more. 
 
You can choose to make a listing to find players to fill out your existing group (even when starting solo), or you can search for a group that already exists and wants to do the same content that you do. This new tool also allows you to tune the criteria your group members must meet, including these examples:
    [list][*]Player CP levels[/*][*]Whether they use in-game voice chat[/*][*]Their playstyle[/*][*]A desired group role composition [/*][/list]							      							    							      								      																																																														
 
With the new Group Finder, teaming up with your fellow adventurers should be as easy as ever! 
 [h2]Grand Master Crafting Stations[/h2] 
Update 40 also introduces Grand Master Crafting Stations, allowing you to consolidate all your home’s attuned crafting stations for a crafting skill line into a single furnishing. If your base of operations is packed full of attuned crafting stations supporting many of [i]ESO[/i]’s myriad item sets, these new consolidated stations will go a long way to improving the amount of housing slots spent without giving up any of the functionality you enjoyed previously.
										      							    							      								      									
You can acquire Grand Master Crafting Stations using Writ Vouchers from the Achievement Mediator, Faustina Curio. There will be a consolidated station for Blacksmithing, Jewelry Crafting, Clothing, and Woodworking—happy crafting!
 [h2]Assorted Additional Improvements [/h2] 
[b]Jewelry Crafting Rebalance[/b]
 
Also included in Update 40 is a rebalance of Jewelry Crafting to help bring its costs more in line with the game’s other crafting disciplines. This includes [b]completely removing[/b] Jewelry Crafting grains and [b]converting them into platings[/b]! However, to ensure that Jewelry Crafting’s costs line up with the other crafting types, we’ve also increased the total boosters needed to upgrade your jewelry, too. But don't worry, upgrading your rings and amulets in Update 40 will be easier and cheaper when compared to how it is currently. 
 
[b]Quest XP & Gold Standardization[/b]
 
With Update 40, we conducted a broad audit and standardization of the Experience Point and Gold rewards for many of the game’s quests. This includes those for quests and questlines associated with zones, main storylines, prologues, dailies, guild storylines, and many more. Now, you should receive more consistent rewards for the game’s various quests based on their complexity or length. In addition, the daily quest rewards for Mages Guild, Fighters Guild, and Undaunted have received a general boost. 
 
These are just some of the many changes and additions coming to [i]ESO [/i]with the Update 40 base-game patch. You can experience them (and the Infinite Archive) for yourself when the update arrives on the PC/Mac Public Test Server in a few days  (Monday, September 18) or when it all arrives on October 30 for PC/Mac and November 14 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles. Are you excited for the Update 40 base-game patch? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url].

notes.title: Update 39 Base-Game Patch Now Live on PC/Mac
notes.notes:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/08/2e966846125f5b8145838f4247202990.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Discover the host of additions and improvements arriving with the free Update 39 base-game patch. [/i]
 
The Update 39 base-game patch is now live on PC/Mac and introduces a series of long-awaited improvements and additions to [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i], completely free of charge for all existing [i]ESO[/i] players. If you’re a console player, don’t worry: Update 39 arrives September 5 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles, too! 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/08/2aae9b31906a3c66e2128b4d1cf5b7d1.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/08/2aae9b31906a3c66e2128b4d1cf5b7d1.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Update 39 Base Game Improvements[/i]
 
As a base-game patch, Update 39 includes a wide array of bug fixes, but also features a series of long-awaited improvements to your in-game experience. 
 
[b]Quest & Content Improvements for New Players[/b]
 
If you’re a new player feeling overwhelmed when first entering Tamriel, you can enjoy a series of changes that [b]reduce the volume and frequency of quests [/b]offered to your low-level characters. This includes quests from NPCs for the main story, Fighters Guild, Mages Guild, Battlegrounds, Undaunted, and others. Instead, these quests are now delivered more gradually as you level up, helping your journal stay in a manageable state for longer!
 
Tamriel’s navigator NPCs that can transport your characters between destinations have also received some improvements with this update. Now, these navigators [b]indicate whether they can transport you to a location for one of your tracked quests[/b] (active or inactive.) When exploring, you now see the “door” pin above relevant navigator NPCs, indicating that they can help you in your journey. In addition, appropriate dialog lines with those same NPCs have similar pins, ensuring you make the right choice and go where you need to go—happy travels! 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/08/71d1ea150e994d1d9a33e1959bbe5942.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/08/71d1ea150e994d1d9a33e1959bbe5942.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Taking your first steps into Tamriel is daunting[/i]
 
[b]Inventory Management Improvements[/b]
 
If you’re struggling with an overburdened Inventory, Update 39 also includes changes to key item types to help improve management and reduce clutter. Some (but not all) similar Crown Store items that came from separate sources (such as Tri-Restoration Potions) can now all be [b]stacked together using the “Stack All Items” option[/b]. Also, this patch adds [b]better communication regarding which items in your Inventory can or cannot be sold[/b], helping you identify and clear out unwanted items and make a little gold in the process!
 
[b]PvP Additions & New Rewards [/b]
 
This update adds new rewards for Tamriel’s PvP victors in the form of [b]three new monster mask sets[/b]: Jerall Mountains Warchief, Nibenay Bay Battlereeve, and Colovian Highlands General. Each grants unique and powerful boons, and you can trade Alliance Points for these new masks with Cyrodiil Elite Gear Vendors within the Eastern Elsweyr Gate, Southern High Rock Gate, and Northern Morrowind Gate. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/07/02adb5389ad204fbd8e6c9ce6240f7d4.png]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/07/02adb5389ad204fbd8e6c9ce6240f7d4.png[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Chase down new PvP rewards[/i]
 
In addition, you can now claim [b]new Unfeathered Battle Body and Face Markings[/b] from Gladiator’s Rucksacks (earned by completing Cyrodiil Conquest Mission Board daily quests), and the Imperial City’s hapless [b]Treasure Scamps now[/b] [b]drop even better loot [/b]when hunted down. In particular, Cunning Scamps drop more Tel Var Stones and Trove Scamps drop tradable pieces of Imperial City gear sets. 
 
Finally, while battling in Cyrodiil, the Imperial City, and Battlegrounds, you can now see [b]new death notifications[/b] that help you plan your next move (or avoid that incoming zerg!).
 
[b]Home Editor Improvements[/b]
 
With Update 39, this patch gives you the ability to [b]place a furnishing directly from your Inventory or Collectibles UI [/b]while in your home. You can now find a “Place” option when viewing the specific furnishings. In addition, you can [b]preview Crown Store furnishings[/b] in your home before you buy, helping you determine how a new item might look when placed. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/08/1c12c700d99b7f15c2d3bffeba283673.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/08/1c12c700d99b7f15c2d3bffeba283673.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Place furnishings from Inventory and Collectibles[/i]
 
Of course, these are just some of the changes and additions that arrive with Update 39. To see a complete list of everything this new base-game patch introduces to [i]ESO[/i], visit our [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/discussion/641025/pc-mac-patch-notes-v9-1-5-update-39]Patch Notes forum[/url].
										      							    							      								      				
																																			[h1][url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/discussion/641025/pc-mac-patch-notes-v9-1-5-update-39]Patch Notes[/url][/h1]																																	
				      								      									
[h2]Getting Started in Update 39[/h2]
As a base-game update, your version of [i]ESO[/i] automatically updates on PC/Mac via the [i]ESO [/i]Launcher. Note that to run [i]ESO[/i] on PC/Mac, your machine needs to meet the game's requirements here: [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/newplayerguide/minspec]PC[/url], [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/newplayerguide/minspec]Mac[/url]. Don’t forget, Update 39 arrives on consoles September 5.

As mentioned above, this is a free base-game update for all [i]ESO[/i] players. Anybody with access to the game can download and enjoy these new additions and changes. There is no previous purchase required (aside from the game itself).
[h2]Tamriel Evolves[/h2]
With the free Update 39 base-game patch, you can enjoy the above improvements and more to help you get the most out of your time in Tamriel. Which of the above changes and additions are you most excited to experience? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url].

[i]The Update 39 base-game patch is now live PC/Mac and arrives September 5 for Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, and PlayStation 5 consoles.[/i]
