notes.title: Update 39 Preview—Base Game Improvements and Additions
notes.notes:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/07/5765884d53498ed201a23cdcb4dc84ed.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Learn about some of the key changes and additions coming with the Update 39 free base-game patch. [/i]
 
During the [i]ESO [/i]Global Reveal back in January, we announced that we were taking the time during this development cycle to focus on polishing in-game systems and addressing some of the community’s longstanding requests. We are happy to announce that the first round of these changes, in addition to a host of various bug fixes, will be arriving August 21 on PC/Mac and September 5 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles in the Update 39 base-game patch. As a base-game update, Update 39 is free for all existing [i]ESO[/i] players, with no additional purchase required. Discover some of the changes coming with Update 39 below!
 [h2]General Improvements[/h2] 
[b]Quest & Content Improvements for New Players[/b]
 
To help new players who are feeling overwhelmed upon first entering Tamriel, the team has implemented a host of changes designed to reduce the volume and frequency of quest choices presented to players in early content. Specifically, this update changes when certain quest bestowers appear and how fervent they are in chasing you down. This includes quests bestowers for the main story, Fighters Guild, Mages Guild, Battlegrounds, Undaunted, and other questlines. With Update 39, as you level up and explore, these quests will more gradually become available for you to pick up—keeping that journal in a more manageable state! 
 
[b]Navigator Quest Pins[/b]
 
This update also introduces a new system that utilizes Tamriel’s navigators: NPCs that transport players between critical destinations for free. Tracked quests (active or inactive) will now indicate whether these navigators can take you where you need to go. When approaching a navigator NPC, you’ll see a “door” pin indicating that they can help you in your journey. When conversing with these NPCs, the appropriate dialog line will also have the same pin next to it, ensuring you’re sent to the right location to continue your quest. 
 
[b]New[/b] [b]Endeavor Activity Types[/b]
 
Update 39 also includes the addition of new types of weekly and daily Endeavors, giving you a greater variety of ways to earn your Seals of Endeavor. Examples include Endeavors that ask you to complete Tales of Tribute matches; capture Farms, Keeps, or Towns in Cyrodiil; and complete Trials with guildmates. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/07/d395155906ddeec4b35afdfbbcc2a688.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/07/d395155906ddeec4b35afdfbbcc2a688.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Earn more Seals of Endeavors in Cyrodiil[/i]
 
[b]Item Management Improvements[/b]
 
In addition, this patch features changes that help you better understand and manage your inventory’s various items. With Update 39, certain Crown Store items that appear the same but come from different sources will all stack together, freeing up valuable inventory space. Additionally, to help clear up what items can and cannot be sold, unsellable items will now be listed as worth zero gold in your inventory. Previous zero gold items that [b]can now[/b] be sold will be valued at one gold. This includes items such as low-level gear, some crafting materials, low-level provisions, lockpicks, and tutorial items.
 [h2]PvP Additions[/h2] 
[b]PvP Death Notifications[/b]
 
With Update 39, a new death notification system has been added during your PvP clashes in Cyrodiil, the Imperial City, and Battlegrounds. This new chat feature alerts you as to who defeated whom, tells you around what area the death occurred, and displays the Alliance ranks of those in the battle. Furthermore, you can find more information on the “Crossed Swords” map icons, showing who’s currently winning a specific battle in Cyrodiil or the Imperial City.
 
[b]New PvP Rewards[/b]
 
Update 39 also introduces various new items for players to spend their Alliance Points on including three Cyrodiil-based Monster Masks: Jerall Mountains Warchief, Nibenay Bay Battlereeve, and Colovian Highlands General. These new Monster Masks each provide unique boons to Tamriel’s PvP warriors. For example, the Nibenay Bay Battlereeve mask automatically generates a damage shield for you whenever you are forcefully moved via a pull, knockback, or teleport ability. You can acquire these new Monster Masks from Cyrodiil Elite Gear Vendors located at the Eastern Elsweyr Gate, Southern High Rock Gate and Northern Morrowind Gate by trading Alliance Points.
 
Additionally, you can adorn yourself with the new Unfeathered Battle Body and Face Markings, revealing your warrior spirit. You can obtain these Markings from Gladiator's Rucksacks after completing Cyrodiil Conquest Mission Board daily quests.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/07/02adb5389ad204fbd8e6c9ce6240f7d4.png]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/07/02adb5389ad204fbd8e6c9ce6240f7d4.png[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Earn new Monster Masks for your Scamp hunts![/i]
 
[b]Treasure Scamp Drop Boosts[/b]
 
The Imperial City’s Treasure Scamps have also received a buff* in Update 39 to the number of rewards they drop when defeated. Cunning Scamps will now drop a much greater quantity of Tel Var Stones, and Trove Scamps will now drop a tradable piece of Imperial City Gear. Even more reasons to chase the hapless Daedra down should you see them—happy hunting!
 [h2]Home Editor Improvements[/h2] 
[b]Preview Crown Furnishings[/b]
 
For Housing aficionados, Update 39 includes the ability to preview the placement of Crown Furnishings (furnishings you buy from the in-game Crown Store) before making a purchase. This allows you to see exactly how a furnishing might fit into your home before committing. 
 
[b]Inventory Furnishing Placement[/b]
 
This new update also introduces the ability to place furnishings directly from your Inventory and Collectibles UI while in your home. To do so, simply find the item in your Inventory or Collectibles UI, select it, and select the “Place” option—easy!
 
These are just some highlights from the upcoming base-game patch. If you’d like to see the complete list of fixes, improvements, and additions, check out the patch notes on our [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/pts]official forums here[/url] and be sure to keep an eye out more regarding Update 39 in the near future. 
 
You can try out the update for yourself right now by logging into our [url=https://help.elderscrollsonline.com/#en/answer/20663]PC/Mac Public Test Server[/url]. Be sure to let us know what you think and don’t forget that this update is completely free for all existing [i]ESO[/i] players. Are you looking forward to Update 39? Let us know what you’re most excited for via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url]!
 
[i]*Although the scamps themselves might not see it that way![/i]

notes.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Necrom & Update 38 Now Live on PC/Mac
notes.notes:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/b0cd0751b407e6cab9fb794b55f8ba71.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Uncover the Shadow Over Morrowind with The Elder Scrolls Online: Necrom and the Update 38 base-game patch, now live on PC/Mac![/i]
 
This new Chapter in [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i] saga introduces two new zones to explore, a brand-new class to master, and a sinister plot to uncover that threatens reality itself. If you play on consoles, don’t worry. You can dive into [i]Necrom[/i] on Xbox One, Xbox Series S|X, PlayStation 4, and PlayStation 5 on June 20. 
										      							    							      								      																																																																																				      																															
[previewyoutube=AI9J2INfbEE;full][/previewyoutube]
																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																												      							    							      								      									 
This release also includes the free Update 38 base-game patch, introducing new fixes, additions, balance changes, and improvements. 
 [h2]Necrom Chapter[/h2] 
In [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Necrom[/i], you can delve deeper into the Shadow Over Morrowind adventure, explore the Telvanni Peninsula and Apocrypha zones, and master an all-new class, the Arcanist. [i]Necrom[/i] continues the story that began with March’s [i]Scribes of Fate[/i] DLC, but you do not need to have completed the previous DLC to experience everything this Chapter has to offer. 
 
[b]Telvanni Peninsula and Apocrypha[/b]
 
Home to the cunning mages of House Telvanni and the city of Necrom, the Telvanni Peninsula’s towering mushroom forests might feel familiar to those who have ventured to other parts of Morrowind. However, in addition to the city itself, this new zone contains a host of unique encounters for you to discover in your explorations, including new side quests, world bosses, delves, public dungeons, and more. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/5278ce4949e28def0dcd8f7f41d83b40.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/5278ce4949e28def0dcd8f7f41d83b40.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Necrom city[/i]
 
[i]Necrom[/i] also allows you to explore Hermaeus Mora’s realm of Apocrypha. While this mysterious part of Oblivion contains knowledge untold, be warned—many mortals have lost their souls while navigating its endless libraries. 
										      							    							      								      																																																																																				      																															
[previewyoutube=Q4zewvOHlL4;full][/previewyoutube]
																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																														      							    							      								      									 
In this Chapter, you can explore an all-new part of Aprocypha called Chroma Incognito, a region comprised of fates that never came to pass. This new area is unlike anything you have experienced before, including myriad hazards and secrets for you to discover. Learn more about [i]Necrom[/i]’s two zones [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/64097]in this preview[/url]. 
 
[b]The Arcanist[/b]
 
Helping you tackle these new worlds is the all-new Arcanist class. The first new class added to [i]ESO[/i] since the [i]Elsweyr[/i] Chapter’s Necromancer in 2019, the Arcanist wields the forbidden powers of Apocrypha to deal damage, absorb incoming blows, and heal yourself or your allies. 
										      							    							      								      																																																																																				      																															
[previewyoutube=5Bxo6SA1GGg;full][/previewyoutube]
																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																														      							    							      								      									 
In addition to three skill lines that allow the class to perform any role, the Arcanist introduces a new combat mechanic: Crux. When activating specific Arcanist abilities, you generate Crux, which you can then spend to empower other abilities. How you utilize this unique resource in combat can have a major impact on your effectiveness as an Arcanist. You can read more about the Arcanist class [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/64201]in this preview[/url]—use these new powers wisely! 
 
[b]Group Challenges[/b]
 
If you’re looking for a challenge, [i]Necrom[/i] also introduces new group activities. [b]Sanity’s Edge[/b] is a 12-player trial which tasks you and your allies with defending the fractured mind of a stricken member of the Mages Guild. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/d05768762d119b2bf235744d10e1f7fd.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/d05768762d119b2bf235744d10e1f7fd.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Sanity’s Edge trial[/i]
 
In addition,[b] Bastion Nymic[/b] is a new kind of world event where groups of up to four can help the Prince of Fate reclaim one of his lost fortresses from mysterious invaders. However, even getting access to this hidden part of Apocrypha requires special items found only on roaming Seekers. Read more about these [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/64113]two PvE activities here[/url].
 
[b]New Companions & Rewards[/b]
 
As you venture throughout both zones, you can encounter new allies including two unique Companions, [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/64107]Sharp-as-Night[/url] and [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/64159]Azandar al-Cybiades[/url]. Both Companions can be recruited, leveled up, and equipped in this new Chapter, and each brings their own stories, combat skills, and questlines for you to unlock. 
 
[i]Necrom[/i] also features a host of in-game rewards you can earn as you explore and complete the game’s various quests and Achievements. This includes a series of new item sets (via crafting or earned from monster drops) and unique collectibles (such as the Berylglow Nix-Ox Steed mount or the Shroomtender’s Garb style). 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/94f8c14979e1f3d40c10f1f6a1888553.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/94f8c14979e1f3d40c10f1f6a1888553.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Necrom zone rewards[/i]
 
You can also dig up new Antiquities throughout both zones (including three mythic items) and unlock a Tales of Tribute deck (Almalexia) that introduces an all-new patron ability and cards. 
 [h2]Purchase Details & Requirements[/h2] 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Necrom[/i] is available [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/joinus]to buy now[/url] in four editions: 
    [list][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online Deluxe Collection: Necrom[/i][/*][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online Collection: Necrom[/i][/*][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online Deluxe Upgrade: Necrom[/i][/*][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Upgrade: Necrom[/i][/*][/list]
If you are a brand-new or lapsed player, both [i]Collection [/i]editions include the base game, the [i]Necrom[/i] Chapter, and ALL previous Chapters. If you already own [i]ESO[/i] and its previous Chapters, both [i]Upgrade [/i]editions grant you access to the [i]Necrom[/i] Chapter. Note that to run [i]Necrom[/i] on PC/Mac, your machine needs to meet the game's requirements here: [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/newplayerguide/minspec]PC[/url], [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/newplayerguide/minspec]Mac[/url].
 
In addition to the game, both versions of [i]Necrom[/i] are also available in [i]Deluxe[/i] editions, which feature a unique mount, pet, memento, outfit style, and emotes. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/a5724b8c52ed004fa4f3273297844327.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/05/a5724b8c52ed004fa4f3273297844327.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Necrom Deluxe Edition items[/i]
 
To find out more about [i]Necrom[/i] and its editions, [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/63499]check out this blog[/url]. 
 [h2]Getting Started in Necrom[/h2] 
Once you have access to the [i]Necrom[/i] Chapter, you can travel to the new zone and continue your Shadow Over Morrowind adventure in the following ways: 
 
[b]Via Wayshrine[/b]
 
You can teleport directly to the Telvanni Peninsula by opening your map, selecting the Necrom zone, and then selecting the Necrom Outskirts Wayshrine icon (the only one active in the zone). 
 
[b]Via the Necrom Main Quest[/b]
 
You can acquire the [i]Necrom[/i] main quest by navigating to your Collections UI, selecting Stories, and then Chapters. From there, you can select [i]Necrom[/i] and pick up the first quest, titled “Fate's Proxy” to begin. The quest points you toward where you need to go to travel to the zone. 
 
[b]Via the Tutorial[/b]
 
You can also travel to the Telvanni Peninsula by creating a new character and completing the tutorial. At the end of the tutorial experience, you can select Telvanni Peninsula as your destination and begin. 
 
[b]Getting to Apocrypha[/b]
 
You can find portals to Apocrypha's two regions, the Endless Library and Chroma Incognito, in Leramil's base of operations in the Necrom Bindery. Travel east from the Necrom interior wayshrine and find the entrance past the guild trader's plaza. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/54ce8aa652f15647fce47fb725d32b83.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/06/54ce8aa652f15647fce47fb725d32b83.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Jump straight into the Necrom story[/i]
 
Don’t forget, there are no level requirements for any PvE zone in [i]ESO[/i], allowing you to immediately jump into the new content with any of your existing or new characters—have fun! 
 [h2]Update 38[/h2] 
Launching at the same time as the new Chapter is Update 38, a free base-game patch for all [i]ESO[/i] players that adds quality-of-life improvements, fixes, and new features to the game. 
 
[b]Collectible Favorites[/b]
 
With Update 38, you can now designate favorites among your collectibles, moving them to the top of your Collections UI. You can choose up to 100 various collectibles with no limit on mounts, but some categories do not support this functionality at this time. 
 
[b]Random[/b] [b]Mounts[/b]
 
Update 38 also allows you to set your active mount to either “Random Favorite Mount” or “Random Mount.” When either one of these options is toggled, activating your mount in the world then summons a mount from either your selected favorites or from your entire collection—mix it up!
 
[b]Filleting Multiple Stacks of Fish[/b]
 
Tamriel’s many fishers can now fillet multiple fish simultaneously with Update 38. This can be done by visiting any Provisioning Station and selecting the new tab. You can still fillet fish one at a time from your inventory, but if you’ve got a huge catch, you will be casting more lines in no time. 
 
[b]New PvP Keep Messaging[/b]
 
Finally, Update 38 also introduces improved messaging for when a keep and its resources are claimed. If your guild owns a keep, the owner will be notified when its resource guards are killed. 
 
These are just some of the new features and changes coming with the new base-game update. You might notice changes to the reset timers for Cyrodiil and Tales of Tribute campaigns and that the indomitable Stuga is less fanatical when it comes to chasing you down in the streets of Daggerfall, Davon’s Watch, and Vulkhel Guard. To review everything coming with this base-game patch, be sure to check out the [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]patch notes on our official forums[/url]. 
 [h2]Become an Agent of Mora [/h2] 
The Prince of Knowledge is under siege and needs your help defending a long-held secret. Become an Arcanist and master the power of Apocrypha, explore two new zones, recruit new allies, uncover unique rewards, and continue your Shadow Over Morrowind saga in [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Necrom[/i]. Are you willing to become an agent of Hermaeus Mora? Reality itself stands on the precipice! Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url]. 
 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Necrom is part of the Shadow Over Morrowind adventure and is now live on PC/Mac and arrives on June 20, 2023, for Xbox and PlayStation consoles. [/i]

notes.title: Scribes of Fate & Update 37 Now Live On PC/Mac
notes.notes:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/03/c35885c86b4446dd587aad711c9eb3ea.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Begin your Shadow Over Morrowind adventure with the Scribes of Fate dungeon DLC and Update 37 base-game patch. [/i]
 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Scribes of Fate[/i] DLC game pack and free Update 37 base-game patch are both now live on PC/Mac. If you play on Xbox or PlayStation, don’t worry because this dungeon DLC and update will arrive on consoles March 28. 
 
Challenge yourself and your team with two exciting new dungeons, Bal Sunnar and Scrivener’s Hall, and commence your Shadow Over Morrowind saga. 

[previewyoutube=_B1-fgKZZdI;full][/previewyoutube]
										      							    							      								      																																																																																				      																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																      							    							      								      									 
You can access the DLC via [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/esoplus]ESO Plus™ membership[/url] or purchase it with crowns from the in-game [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/crownstore]Crown Store[/url].
 
This release also includes the free Update 37 base-game patch, which provides all [i]ESO[/i] players with a series of additions and improvements to the game, completely free. Check out the patch notes for both Scribes of Fate and Update 37 on [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]our official forums[/url].
 [h2]Scribes of Fate DLC Game Pack[/h2] 
Gather your allies and venture into brand-new four-player PvE dungeons: Bal Sunnar and Scrivener’s Hall. In these dungeons, you discover two unique stories that kick off the larger Shadow Over Morrowind adventure, leading into the upcoming [i]Necrom [/i]Prologue and [i]Necrom[/i] Chapter release later this year. 
 
[b]Bal Sunnar[/b]
 
The Telvanni township of Bal Sunnar has begun emanating mysterious temporal magics, and the Psijic Order needs your help investigating this dangerous phenomenon. However, House Telvanni is not fond of outsiders meddling in its business and stand ready to defend its secrets at any cost.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/02/e54ae1e4500629789c93d312eb457b49.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/02/e54ae1e4500629789c93d312eb457b49.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Bal Sunnar[/i]
 
In Bal Sunnar, you and your allies must battle through time itself as you race to uncover the truth behind the temporal anomaly before its chaotic influence can spread to all of Morrowind. Learn more about this dungeon’s setting, challenges, and rewards in [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/63745]our recent preview[/url]. 
 
[b]Scrivener’s Hall[/b]
 
The Scribes of Mora were once a peaceful organization dedicated to the collection of information on behalf of the Lord of Knowledge, Hermaeus Mora. However, a sinister new leader has usurped control over the cult and threatens to lead the Scribes of Mora down a dangerous path. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/03/89c20c3e2a2a2204261ada6c957c896c.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/03/89c20c3e2a2a2204261ada6c957c896c.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Scrivener’s Hall[/i]
 
Team up with the Scribes of Mora’s former leader, Keshargo, and travel between realms as he seeks a powerful relic that is key to reclaiming his position as Magnastylus. As you do this, you also need to stop the ambitious Valinna before she can forever damn the souls of her followers. Discover more about Scrivener’s Hall’s dangers, settings, and rewards [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/63775]in this preview[/url].
 
You can also attempt both dungeons in normal, veteran, and hard mode difficulties. Each mode features unique rewards and Achievements, including six new item sets, two monster sets, and a host of collectibles including a new skin, emotes, and more—good luck!
 [h2]Getting Started with Scribes of Fate[/h2] 
You can access [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Scribes of Fate[/i] DLC game pack via [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/esoplus]ESO Plus membership[/url] or purchase it for 1,500 crowns from the in-game [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/crownstore]Crown Store[/url] (listed under DLC). Note that if your ESO Plus membership lapses, you will lose access to the DLC until you renew your membership or purchase it with crowns, but you won’t lose any items, Achievements, or other rewards you earned while you had access.
 
The Scribes of Fate Collector’s Bundle is also available for 4,000 crowns and includes access to the DLC game pack, the Antecedent Scholar’s Guar mount, the Blightlord’s Skeever pet, and five Crown Experience Scrolls. You can purchase the Collector’s Bundle from the Featured section of the in-game Crown Store.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/03/c5ef13a1db262eaa6a14911b50387a5b.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/03/c5ef13a1db262eaa6a14911b50387a5b.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Scribes of Fate Collector’s Bundle[/i]
 
With access to the [i]Scribes of Fate[/i] DLC, you can begin your Shadow Over Morrowind adventure by the following methods:
   [list][*]By teleporting directly into the two dungeons from your map[/*][*]By using the Dungeon Finder tool[/*][*]By walking up to the dungeon entrances within Stonefalls (Bal Sunnar) and The Rift (Scrivener’s Hall)[/*][/list]
Finally, simply by entering either of these two new dungeons, you receive the Lost emote! 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/02/8eb41d9093f79f387397c2cceea780da.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/02/8eb41d9093f79f387397c2cceea780da.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]The Lost emote and other dungeon rewards[/i]
 [h2]Update 37 Base-Game Patch[/h2] 
In addition to the dungeon DLC, this launch also includes the Update 37 base-game patch. This new patch is completely free for all existing [i]ESO[/i] players and introduces a host of fixes, additions, and improvements to the game. 
 
[b]Screen Narration[/b]
 
With Update 37, we’ve added an all-new accessibility feature: screen narration. With screen narration turned on, the majority (but not all) of the game’s menus are narrated. You can enable this new setting in the Accessibility menu under Settings. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/02/51a1a8919ad6ccb3a8a64b84704f5ef6.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/02/51a1a8919ad6ccb3a8a64b84704f5ef6.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Screen Narration[/i]
 
With this setting enabled, you can choose between a masculine or feminine voice and set the volume and speed of the narration. It is available in English, French, German, Spanish, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese.
 
[b]Hide Shoulders[/b]
 
This new patch also introduces a new cosmetic tool: Hide Shoulders. Available for Event Tickets from the Impresario event vendor, Hide Shoulders works like Hide Helm and allows you to hide this part of your outfit when customizing your look in an Outfit Station. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/02/49174c63171d68ff1d61225c3e211058.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/02/49174c63171d68ff1d61225c3e211058.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Hide Shoulders[/i]
 
Look for future event announcements to find out when you’ll have your first opportunity to acquire this new outfit option.
 
[b]Housing Improvements[/b]
 
Finally, Update 37 also includes a host of quality-of-life improvements for the Housing System, including new filters for the editor’s placement and retrieval tabs, the ability to reset training dummies, and the ability to see a full list of furnishings when shopping both furnished and unfurnished homes. 
 
These are just some of the free additions and improvements coming to the game, so be sure to check out the [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]patch notes on our official forums[/url] to discover more! 
 [h2]Your Fate Beckons [/h2] 
The Shadow Over Morrowind saga kicks off with Update 37 and [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Scribes of Fate[/i] dungeon DLC. Are you ready to explore Bal Sunnar and Scrivener’s Hall? A whole new adventure beginsone that will take you and your fellow adventurers to the Telvanni Peninsula and realms beyond! Tell us if you’ll be tempting fate and delving into these challenging two dungeons via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url]—have fun!
 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Scribes of Fate DLC game pack and free Update 37 base-game patch are now live on PC/Mac and arrives on March 28 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles.[/i]

notes.title: Update 37 Preview—Screen Narration, Hide Shoulders, & More
notes.notes:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/02/b7c5728ab43064c315e6dac7117909a2.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Learn about some of the new features everybody who plays ESO can enjoy with the Update 37 base-game patch. [/i]
 
Arriving in tandem with the [i]Scribes of Fate[/i] DLC pack on March 13 for PC/Mac and March 28 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles, the Update 37 base-game patch is a free update for all [i]ESO[/i] players—no additional purchase required. This patch introduces a series of balance changes, bug fixes, and new features. 
 [h2]Screen Narration[/h2] 
The latest in [i]ESO[/i]’s ongoing accessibility-focused improvements, Update 37 introduces Screen Narration, allowing you to have the majority of the game’s menus (with some exceptions) narrated to you as you navigate. 
 
This option becomes available for everybody who enables Accessibility Mode in the game’s settings menu (navigate to Settings, then Accessibility), and it allows you to choose between a masculine or feminine voice and set both the speed and volume of the narration.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/02/51a1a8919ad6ccb3a8a64b84704f5ef6.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/02/51a1a8919ad6ccb3a8a64b84704f5ef6.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]The Screen Narration option[/i]
 
The narration is computer generated in the language you choose to play in (English, French, German, Spanish, Japanese, or Simplified Chinese). 
 
Note that some menus and UI elements are not supported by Screen Narration at this time, including Scrying, Excavating, Tales of Tribute, lockpicking, and certain fishing and Champion Point screens. In addition, some gameplay elements, such as combat, in-world navigation, and interactable objects are not narrated in addition to interactions with NPCs and character dialog (to ensure it does not conflict with the voice acting).
 
We plan to integrate additional menus into screen narration in the future, and we hope this new addition to our Accessibility Mode options helps our players get the most out of the game. 
 [h2]Hide Shoulders[/h2] 
Also arriving as part of Update 37 is Hide Shoulders, a new cosmetic Collectible that allows you to, well, hide whatever shoulder gear your character is currently wearing. Like Hide Helm, this option can be enabled when customizing your look in the Outfit Station. Simply navigate to Armor Styles, select Shoulders, and then select the Hide Shoulders “style.” 
 
To enable Hide Shoulders, you must first acquire it by spending Event Tickets at the Impresario during any of [i]ESO[/i]’s upcoming in-game events. Keep an eye out on [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/]elderscrollsonline.com[/url] for information on when the next event arrives—hint: it’s a silly one! 
										      							    							      								      																																																																	[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/02/f944eba367ce20bf6c4aef74b0f42eaa.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/02/f944eba367ce20bf6c4aef74b0f42eaa.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																																			[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/02/49174c63171d68ff1d61225c3e211058.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2023/02/49174c63171d68ff1d61225c3e211058.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																												      							    							      								      									 
[i]Before and after using Hide Shoulders[/i]
 
We know the community has been asking for the ability to free their shoulders (without losing gear bonuses) for a long time now, and we can’t wait to see the stylish-AND-functional new looks that come with it! 
 [h2]Housing Improvements[/h2] 
Finally, we squeezed in some new quality-of-life improvements for the Housing System. This includes a set of new filters for the Housing Editor’s placement and retrieval tabs, allowing you to place items specifically from your bank, inventory, house storage, or collectibles, items that are bound or unbound, and items by the furnishing limit type they fall under.
 
We also added the ability to reset training dummies you're in combat with (making it easier to restart a parse) and improved your ability to see and manage who is in your home from the Housing Editor’s Settings menu. This includes real-time notifications when guests arrive and depart, plus an option to kick occupants out if they’re getting too rowdy! 
 
In addition, when shopping for a new house, you can see a full list of the furnishings that come with both the furnished and unfurnished versions before you buy. If you’re a Housing aficionado, look for these new features and more soon!
 [h2]Update 37 For All[/h2] 
These are just some of the highlights you can enjoy with the Update 37 base-game patch, and a host of further changes, additions, and improvements are not mentioned above. This includes updates to target markers (improving enemy player targeting and adding new settings) and a realignment of daily and weekly reset timers (10AM UTC for NA servers and 3AM UTC for EU servers) for daily quests, daily Enlightenment bonuses, daily writs, and more. 
 
Update 37 arrives on March 13 for PC/Mac, and on March 28 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles. Don’t forget, as a base-game patch, this update is [b]free for all[/b] existing [i]ESO[/i] players, with no purchase required! You can check out everything coming in Update 37 in the patch notes found in our [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/pts]Public Test Server forum right now[/url], or check out the [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]live patch notes forum[/url] when it arrives in March!
 
Are you excited to dig into the changes and improvements coming with Update 37? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]! 
 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Scribes of Fate and Update 37 arrives on March 13 for PC/Mac, and on March 28 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles.[/i]

notes.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Firesong & Update 36 Now Live on PC/Mac
notes.notes:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/11/4d4e6816f31e84c0e13b65e170059659.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Protect the Legacy of the Bretons and bring your year-long adventure to its conclusion in The Elder Scrolls Online: Firesong and Update 36. [/i]
 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Firesong[/i] and Update 36 base game patch is now live on PC/Mac and arrives on Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, and PlayStation 5 consoles November 15. 
 
Explore an all-new zone, discover the ancient lore of the druids of the Systres, and confront the Ascendant Lord in this final part of the year-long Legacy of the Bretons adventure. 
										      							    							      								      																																																																																				      																															
[previewyoutube=mfbTtfyb7Fk;full][/previewyoutube]																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																												      							    							      								      									 [h2]The Elder Scrolls Online: Firesong[/h2] 
The untamed island of Galen, home to the druidic circles of the Systres Archipelago, is mired in chaos. The Breton city of Vastyr suffers unrelenting raids from Dreadsail pirates, while the Firesong Circle has started a war between the druids of the Systres. 
 
In this new story DLC, you will venture into the heart of a primeval new zone, assist the noble Society of the Steadfast and House Mornard, and uncover the forces and motives behind the chaos that has engulfed the island before it encompasses all the Systres. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/09/2076660611d3aed5215287b697cda001.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/09/2076660611d3aed5215287b697cda001.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Face the Ascendant Lord[/i]
 
This new DLC also includes bonus quests that you can unlock only by completing the [i]Firesong[/i] AND [i]High Isle[/i] Chapter main questlines. In these additional adventures, you’ll bring a final close to the year-long Legacy of the Bretons saga and confront the Ascendant Lord once and for all. 
 
[b]Explore Wild Galen[/b]
 
Primeval and wild, Galen has been home to the druids of the Systres for an age. In this new zone, you will have an opportunity to explore a world apart from those you’ve already experienced in the [i]High Isle[/i] Chapter and get lost within the mysterious island’s dense jungles and perilous lava rivers. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/10/4a76830bb61fde86da3e693ee47a343f.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/10/4a76830bb61fde86da3e693ee47a343f.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Explore an all-new zone[/i]
 
In the new zone, you’ll have an opportunity to dive deep into the druids of the Systres and their connection to the Bretons of High Isle and Tamriel. From the city of Vastyr, a bastion of “civilization” in an otherwise untamed land, you’ll set out into the deep wilds and discover a host of new challenges, including new delves, roaming world bosses, volcanic vents, and stand-alone quests and storylines. Learn more about the new zone [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/63087]in this preview[/url]. 
 
[b]Uncover Unique Rewards[/b]
 
As you venture into Galen, you’ll have an opportunity to earn unique rewards equal to the zone’s dangers, including new item sets, titles, Achievements, and collectibles. This includes the Firesong Obsidian Mask (a free adornment earned simply by entering the new zone), the Phoenix Moth pet (one of many quest rewards), a host of special styles earned via the Antiquities system and Tales of Tribute, and much more. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/11/86c91038e846ed1edc2dfad29024eb03.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/11/86c91038e846ed1edc2dfad29024eb03.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Receive unique rewards[/i]
 
In addition to the above, [i]Firesong[/i] also introduces a brand-new Tales of Tribute patron: the Druid King. Unlocked by completing various zone activities, the Druid King patron and deck rewards those who carefully set up combos, and it can set up big swings in both the mid and late game. Learn more about the new patron and deck [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/63009]in our preview[/url]. Don’t forget, you’ll need both [i]Firesong[/i] and the [i]High Isle[/i] Chapter to unlock and play this new Tales of Tribute deck. 
 [h2]Getting Started in Firesong[/h2] 
The [i]Firesong[/i] DLC is free for all ESO Plus™ members and available for purchase for 2,000 crowns from the in-game Crown Store (listed under DLC). Note that if your ESO Plus membership lapses, you will lose access to the DLC until you renew or purchase the DLC with crowns, but you won’t lose any items or progress you earned while you had access.
 
If you acquired access to [i]Firesong[/i] via the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/63067]Heroes of High Isle Reward Bundle[/url], the DLC will be waiting for you in your collections and you can jump right in. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/11/f491aad23e3a7469ff2bc68eb58bdb9e.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/11/f491aad23e3a7469ff2bc68eb58bdb9e.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Firesong Collector’s Bundle[/i]
 
Releasing in tandem with the base DLC, the [i]Firesong Collector’s Bundle[/i] is also available in the in-game Crown Store for 4,000 crowns and includes Cinderstone Kagouti mount, the Companion's Wolf Pup pet, and Crown Experience Scrolls. You can find the [i]Firesong Collector’s Bundle[/i] in the Featured section of the Crown Store.
 
Once you have access to the [i]Firesong[/i] DLC, you can begin your exploration of this volatile part of Oblivion by the following methods:
 [list][*]By teleporting directly to the Vastyr Outskirts Wayshrine from      your map[/*]  [*]By using the DLC tab of your Collections UI and accepting      the “A Sea of Troubles” quest from the Zone DLC section[/*] [/list]
When you arrive in Galen, you can discover the new zone, begin the DLC’s storyline, or simply explore—it’s up to you! The first time you enter the zone, you’ll receive the Firesong Obsidian Mask collectible completely free as a bonus collectible reward.
 [h2]Update 36-Base Game Patch[/h2] 
Releasing in tandem with the [i]Firesong [/i]DLC, the Update 36 base-game patch is a free update for all [i]ESO[/i] players that introduces Simplified Chinese localization to the game’s text along with a host of balance changes, bug fixes, and new features. These new additions include the ability to place unique target markers on enemies (allowing you to better coordinate with your allies), a text-to-speech accessibility option, the option to hide class pets within cities and towns (no longer will your crafting station be blocked by an unwelcome bear butt!), and a series of improvements to the Housing system.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/11/62961f94f19a4b06735848c05a50a591.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/11/62961f94f19a4b06735848c05a50a591.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									  
In particular, the Housing improvements feature the ability  to create chat links within your homes, provides greater visibility as to whose  house you’re currently visiting and how many people are currently present, grants  the ability to see a full list of furnishings within a home, allows you to  cycle through items with the Tab key, and implements improved placement  alignments for hundreds of different wall-hanging furnishings. We can’t wait to  see how the Housing community makes use of these new features and improvements! 

For everything related to [i]Firesong [/i]and Update 36, check out the [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]Patch Notes on our official forums[/url].


  [h2]Conclude Your Legacy[/h2]  
Explore an untamed world, dive deep into the lives and  culture of the druids, and fight to defend Galen from threats within and  without. In the [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Firesong[/i], you’ll finally be  able to confront the Ascendant Lord and bring your Legacy of the Bretons  year-long adventure to its epic conclusion. Are you ready to venture deep into  the perilous wilds of Galen? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url]!
  
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Firesong and Update 36 base  game patch is now live on PC/Mac and arrives on Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S,  PlayStation 4, and PlayStation 5 consoles on November 15. [/i]

notes.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Firesong & Update 36 Preview
notes.notes:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/09/872d50bcad8fc4350901804d4812ff7b.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Delve into the mysteries of the druids and get an early look at the final phase of the Legacy of the Bretons year-long adventure. [/i]
 [h2]The Elder Scrolls Online: Firesong[/h2] 
Arriving November 1 on PC/Mac and Stadia, and November 15 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles, [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Firesong[/i] will continue and expand upon the ongoing Legacy of the Bretons saga and provide bonus quests concluding the year-long adventure. This story DLC allows you to explore the island of Galen, dive deep into the culture and histories of Tamriel’s druids, and bring an end to a larger narrative that began back in February with the [i]Ascending Tide[/i] dungeon DLC and continued throughout all of 2022. 
 
[b]Explore the Home of the Druids[/b]
 
In [i]Firesong[/i], you can explore Galen, one of the four islands of the Systres Archipelago. Abundant and fertile, this isolated isle northwest of High Isle has long served the druid circles of the Systres. Galen features overgrown forests, inhospitable jungles, snaking lava rivers, woodland spirits, and creatures unique to this part of Tamriel. It’s not only the druids who call this island home, however, as House Mornard and their southern port city of Vastyr provides a lone bastion of civilization (at least as far the Bretons of High Isle see it) among the untamed wilds. 
										      							    							      								      																																																																	[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/09/0c1c4dc693e58a0c02bc12f6eba9c897.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/09/0c1c4dc693e58a0c02bc12f6eba9c897.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																																			[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/09/7ac126444a70471608ad46ac1b638187.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/09/7ac126444a70471608ad46ac1b638187.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																												      							    							      								      																																																																	[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/09/acdb504bd99a88abf3cc4ff76cd6b31f.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/09/acdb504bd99a88abf3cc4ff76cd6b31f.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																																			[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/09/2527841a7e12d9487794c188344e0732.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/09/2527841a7e12d9487794c188344e0732.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																												      							    							      								      									 
[i]Galen concept art[/i]
 
While you explore and dive deep into lore of the druids and Galen, you’ll encounter no shortage of challenges, including new world bosses, delves, volcanic vents, and standalone quests, too. A whole new island of adventure awaits!
 
[b]A War Among Circles[/b]
 
Despite its shared legacy as a home to all druids, Galen’s people find themselves mired in conflict. The Firesong Circle (first encountered within the [i]Lost Depths[/i] DLC) have attacked their fellow Stonelore and Eldertide druids, while House Mornard simultaneously suffers relentless raids from Sea Elf pirates. In the face of these two growing threats, you must defend the people of Galen, investigate the motives behind these attacks, and put a stop to them before their chaos can spread to the rest of the Systres. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/09/c87fea2cb7591eb246e9212956276f71.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/09/c87fea2cb7591eb246e9212956276f71.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]New enemies, challenges, and allies await[/i]
 
[b]Save the Systres (and Tamriel)[/b]
 
While [i]Firesong[/i] features a standalone story, should you complete the main questlines for both this DLC and the [i]High Isle[/i] Chapter, you’ll unlock additional bonus quests that bring the Legacy of the Bretons year-long saga to its conclusion. Throughout your journeys in Galen, you will piece together the events of all of 2022’s DLC and Chapter content to finally uncover and confront the Ascendant Lord himself. Do not fear, for you’ll be joined by familiar and new allies in this final adventure that will take you deep into the very heart of the volcanic isle of Y’ffelon!
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/09/2076660611d3aed5215287b697cda001.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/09/2076660611d3aed5215287b697cda001.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Conclude your Legacy of the Bretons adventure[/i]
 [h2]New Patron Deck[/h2] 
Also arriving as part of the [i]Firesong[/i] DLC is the newest Tales of Tribute patron—the Druid King! This all-new patron rewards you for achieving hefty combos with their deck, and the order by which you play your cards is vital to ensure you get the best possible result. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/09/c09c9381e58612ed61b244512a91f2f7.png]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/09/c09c9381e58612ed61b244512a91f2f7.png[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]The Druid King Patron[/i]
 
You’ll unlock fragments of the Druid King Patron deck by completing a wide range of activities within Galen, but note that to the unlock the ability to play Tales of Tribute (and your new patron) you’ll need access to the [i]High Isle[/i] Chapter, too. 
 [h2]Update 36[/h2] 
Releasing alongside [i]Firesong[/i], the Update 36 base-game patch will bring balance changes, bug fixes, and features completely free for all of [i]ESO[/i]’s players! These additions include a tool that allows you to place target markers on enemies, a text-to-speech accessibility option, the ability to hide class pets in towns (no more bears crowding crafting stations!), and a number of changes to make it easier to share and visit homes. 
 
These Housing improvements include the ability to create chat links to your homes, improved visibility in whose house you're visiting as well as how many people are present in a home, the ability to see the list of furnishings in a home that you are visiting, and improved placement alignment for hundreds of furnishings that commonly hang on walls—phew! 
 [h2]Coming to the PTS![/h2] 
If you’d like to experience [i]Firesong[/i] and Update 36’s new content and improvements early, you can help us improve the release AND get a hands-on look at everything by logging into the Public Test Server starting Monday, September 19! To play on the PTS, enable the playtesting build from the Settings menu within the PC/Mac ESO launcher by toggling the “Show Public Test Environment” option. Then, you will be able to download and access the test environment once it is live. Be sure to leave feedback and report any bugs you come across by typing “/feedback” or “/bug” in chat.
 [h2]A Legacy Concludes[/h2] 
An untamed new island to explore, dangerous new foes and challenges to confront, a new Patron deck to master and much more is coming with [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Firesong[/i] and Update 36. We’ve only just begun to tease what’s in store for the Systres Archipelago and the Legacy of the Breton’s final adventure for 2022, so keep an eye on elderscrollsonline.com for more between now and [i]Firesong[/i]’s launch. What are you most looking forward to in this new DLC and Update? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url]!
 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Firesong and Update 36 arrives November 1 on PC/Mac and Stadia, and November 15 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles.[/i]

notes.title: Lost Depths DLC & Update 35 Now Live on PC/Mac
notes.notes:
[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/08/dff36d042cc3e387b71669c5a32cc81d.jpg[/img]																											      								      									 
[i]Continue your Legacy of the Bretons year-long adventure with the Lost Depths dungeon DLC pack and Update 35 base-game patch.[/i]
 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Lost Depths[/i] is now live on PC/Mac and Stadia*, and arrives September 6 for Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, and PlayStation 5 consoles. This new DLC game pack introduces two dungeons to challenge four-player PvE groups, Graven Deep and Earthen Root Enclave, and expands upon the ongoing Legacy of the Bretons year-long adventure.
										      							    							      								      																																																																																				      																															
[previewyoutube=EY_MrLbxpC4;full][/previewyoutube]																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																												      							    							      								      									
You can access the DLC via ESO Plus™ membership or purchase it with crowns from the in-game Crown Store.

This release also includes the free Update 35 base-game patch, which provides all [i]ESO[/i] players with a series of additions and improvements to the game. Check out the patch notes for both [i]Lost Depths[/i] and Update 35 on our official forums.
[h2]Lost Depths DLC Game Pack[/h2]
Delve into two challenging new four-player dungeons, Graven Deep and Earthen Root Enclave, and set up the adventure to come with two stand-alone stories that lead into the events of this year’s final zone DLC, [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Firesong[/i].

[b]Graven Deep[/b]

Explore a mysterious uncharted island and help Dhulef of the Mages Guild delve into a vast underwater Dwarven facility. But be warned. The isle you and your party have landed upon is home to all manner of deadly beasts. Additionally, within the depths of the enormous undersea complex, the lost souls of sailors protect an ancient secret.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/08/d2a18eb223a4dcb592bea946798042e4.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/08/d2a18eb223a4dcb592bea946798042e4.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]The dead protect the deep[/i]
 
Together, you and your allies can uncover the mysteries of Graven Deep, put a stop to the storms that plague the sailors of the Abecean Sea, and discover new lore surrounding the legendary Druid King and his journey to the Systres Archipelago. You can learn more about this delve into the deep in our recent [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/62673]preview blog[/url]. 
 
[b]Earthen Root Enclave[/b]
 
Once a sanctuary for all the druids of the Systres, Earthen Root Enclave has come under attack from the vicious Firesong Circle. Learn more about the Archipelago’s unique druid factions as you contend with Firesong warriors, powerful constructs, and even corrupted spirits that seek to plunder the sacred haven.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/08/bd47b0660ab041ecd500ebbd49bee227.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/08/bd47b0660ab041ecd500ebbd49bee227.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Fight to defend Earthen Root Enclave[/i]
 
You and your party must help [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/62577]Druid Laurel[/url] defend the enclave from the marauders, protect the site’s most revered relics, and confront a new danger that threatens to bring ash and ruin to Tamriel. Learn more about Earthen Root Enclave, its setting, and challenges in [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/62583]our preview blog[/url].
 
By completing both dungeons in Normal, Veteran, and Hard Mode difficulties, you can uncover unique challenges and rewards (including item sets and collectibles) specific to this DLC. As part of the Legacy of the Bretons adventure, what you discover in these two new PvE experiences will have ramifications for both the people of the Systres Archipelago and the larger year-long saga. 
 [h2]Getting Started with Lost Depths[/h2] 
You can[b] [/b]access [i]The Elder Scrolls Online:[/i] [i]Lost Depths[/i] DLC game pack via ESO Plus membership or purchase it for 1,500 crowns from the in-game Crown Store (listed under DLC). Note that if your ESO Plus membership lapses, you will lose access to the DLC until you renew your membership or purchase it with crowns, but you won’t lose any items, Achievements, or other rewards you earned while you had access.
 
The [i]Lost Depths Collector’s Bundle[/i] is also available for 4,000 crowns and includes access to the DLC game pack, the Turquoise War Pangrit mount, the Pangrit Nymphling pet, and five Crown Experience Scrolls. You can purchase the Collector’s Bundle from the Featured section of the in-game Crown Store.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/08/dbbb8f75378d2441084eacb816b0cbff.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/08/dbbb8f75378d2441084eacb816b0cbff.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]The Lost Depths Collector’s Bundle[/i]
 
With access to the [i]Lost Depths[/i] DLC, you can begin your Legacy of the Bretons adventure by the following methods:
   [list][*]By teleporting directly into the two dungeons from your map[/*][*]By using the Dungeon Finder tool[/*][*]By walking up to the dungeon entrances within High Isle (Earthen Root Enclave) and Amenos (Graven Deep)[/*][/list]
Finally, simply by entering either of these two new dungeons, you receive the Mulberry Hermit Crab pet!
										      							    							      								      																																																														[url=https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/07/c711071e4883c90e177e375902a5b7a2.jpg]																					[img]https://esosslfiles-a.akamaihd.net/ape/uploads/2022/07/c711071e4883c90e177e375902a5b7a2.jpg[/img]																[/url]																																															      							    							      								      									 
[i]Get this free pet when you enter either new dungeon[/i]
 [h2]Update 35 Base-Game Patch[/h2] 
Also releasing at the same time as the Lost Depths DLC is the Update 35 base-game patch. This free update is available for all [i]ESO[/i] players, no purchase required, and includes a host of balance and bug fixes, combat changes, the introduction of special Battlegrounds weekends, and boosts to XP gains when engaging in PvP activities in general. To see a complete list of all the changes coming as part of Update 35, visit the [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]Patch Notes section[/url] of our official forums. 
 [h2]Delve into the Lost Depths[/h2] 
The Legacy of the Bretons year-long adventure continues with [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Lost Depths[/i] DLC and challenges you and your party to delve into two new exciting dungeons. New stories, characters, and dangers await those willing to confront the Firesong Circle or investigate the lore of the Druid King—good luck! Let us know if you’re excited to explore the [i]Lost Depths[/i] DLC via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url]!
 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Lost Depths DLC game pack and free Update 35 base-game patch is now live on PC/Mac and Stadia*, and arrives on Xbox and PlayStation consoles September 6, 2022.[/i]
 
[i]*Available only in limited territories.[/i]
