notes.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: High Isle & Update 34 Now Live on PC/Mac
notes.notes:
[i]Defend the Legacy of the Bretons with The Elder Scrolls Online: High Isle and the Update 34 base-game patch, available now on PC/Mac.[/i]
 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: High Isle[/i] is now live on PC/Mac, Steam, and Stadia*. This new Chapter allows you to explore a never-before-seen part of Tamriel, the island home of the Breton elite, and uncover an ascending threat from within a noble chivalric society. If you’re a console player, don’t worry, [i]ESO: High Isle[/i] will be available June 21 for Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, and PlayStation 5 consoles. 

[previewyoutube=XaI-EOVpDvo;full][/previewyoutube]										      							    							      								      																																																																																				      																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																					      							    							      								      									 
This release also includes the free Update 34 base-game patch, providing all [i]ESO[/i] players with a host of fixes, additions, and improvements to the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/e3980ddbe5a6c17fd150f73f5dde5d17890aee90.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/30ab774d4cdf36a6f949877b40cd2d7271c1154c.jpg[/img]																																				      							    							      								      									 [h2]High Isle Chapter[/h2] 
In this new [i]Elder Scrolls Online[/i] Chapter, you can continue (or begin) your Legacy of the Bretons adventure by journeying to the faraway Systres Archipelago. As part of the year-long saga, [i]High Isle[/i] progresses the story that began with the [i]Ascending Tide[/i] DLC in February and will continue throughout the rest of 2022. This Chapter also provides a new zone to explore, new ways to play, and a bounty of unique rewards and Achievements to earn. [b] [/b]
 
[b]High Isle Zone[/b]
 
A home away from home for the Breton elite, the Systres Archipelago has long enjoyed a kind of neutrality from the ongoing Three Banners War. While High Isle itself is an idyllic paradise frequented by the Breton court and its noble houses, the Chapter also features a second location to explore called Amenos, an inhospitable penal island for political prisoners, criminals, and malcontents. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/7aaa0ef337bf5196a520208ff59db8360d5dfc15.jpg[/img]										      							    							      								      																																																																																																									      							    							      								      									 
[i]Explore the regions of High Isle and Amenos[/i]
 
As you journey throughout the Systres, you have an opportunity to venture into each island and discover the true nature of this ancient-but-mysterious land, including both its indisputable wonders and hidden dangers.
 
[b]An Ascending Threat[/b]
 
In the [i]High Isle[/i] Chapter, you dive headfirst into a tale of political intrigue and strife, as the nobles of the Systres find themselves threatened by the mysterious Ascendant Order. This covert organization has infiltrated nearly every level of Breton society and has, behind the scenes, begun to push High Isle towards the brink of disaster. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/61b829fe0bc4798961c074bc5200230408d99100.jpg[/img]																																												      							    							      								      									 
[i]The Ascendant Order works from the shadows[/i]
 
What you uncover in your investigations within this troubled land will have consequences for both the Bretons of High Isle and the mainland, and while [i]High Isle[/i] provides a standalone story experience, the events of this new Chapter will continue and set up the story for the Legacy of the Bretons saga to come. 
 
[b]Tales of Tribute[/b]
 
A new way to play, Tales of Tribute is a unique game system you can enjoy with your fellow players and NPCs in almost any tavern in Tamriel. A deck-building card game that challenges you to gain Prestige points while also garnering the favor of the patrons, Tales of Tribute is a fast-paced, strategic experience that anybody who owns [i]High Isle[/i] can pick up and play. 
										      							    							      								      																																																																	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/a9c73c906284feea97b4492662b2802dd750e1d8.png[/img]	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/23df603c92a3ad560d84526e74e91f57a710072a.jpg[/img]																																						      							    							      								      									 
Discover a new game within the game
 
With its own leaderboards, questline, and rewards (including unique collectibles and Achievements), whether you’re a competitive or casual player, there’s plenty of reasons to play a hand of Tribute. 
 
[b]New Companions[/b]
 
As you venture into the [i]High Isle[/i] Chapter, you also have an opportunity to recruit two new Companions to your cause: Ember the Khajiit and Isobel Veloise the Breton Knight. Once enlisted, these very-different allies accompany you on your journeys throughout the Systres and beyond, and they even have their own unique questlines and stories that you can unlock as you adventure with them. 
 
[b]New Challenges & Rewards[/b]
 
As you might expect, High Isle is home to no shortage of dangers, but you can also find ample rewards for your troubles in this new land, too. New world events, called Volcanic Vents, have begun to erupt across both High Isle and Amenos, requiring a team to shut them down before they permanently scar the idyllic isles. The Dreadsail Reef 12-player Trial is a new challenge for large groups that pits your team against the fearsome Dreadsail pirates. Finally, this new zone also features a host of new delves, public dungeons, and world bosses to challenge your skills and teamwork.
										      							    							      								      																																																														
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/3906b2f72be21600982f6d631da6b14a4f5d73f7.jpg[/img]																																												      							    							      								      									 
[i]Unlock new collectibles, item sets, styles, and more[/i]
 
All these experiences feature their own rewards, including unique item sets, collectibles, and Achievements not found anywhere else in Tamriel. 
 
To review everything coming with this new Chapter and update, check out the [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]patch notes on our official forums[/url] and [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/category/highisle]previews on our official website[/url]. 
 [h2]Purchase Details & Requirements[/h2] 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: High Isle [/i]is available in four editions, including:
    [list][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online Collection: High Isle[/i][/*][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online Collection: High Isle Collector’s Edition[/i][/*][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online: High Isle Upgrade[/i][/*][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online: High Isle Upgrade Collector’s Edition[/i][/*][/list]
If you are a brand-new player, the[i] ESO Collection: High Isle [/i]includes the base game, [i]High Isle[/i] Chapter, and all previous Chapters. If you already own [i]ESO[/i] and its previous Chapters, the [i]ESO: High Isle Upgrade[/i] grants you access to the new Chapter. Note that to run [i]High Isle[/i] on PC/Mac, your machine needs to meet the game's requirements here: [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/newplayerguide/minspec]PC[/url], [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/newplayerguide/minspec]Mac[/url].
 
In addition to the Chapter itself, the [i]Collector’s Editions[/i] also include a selection of unique in-game items, including a pet, mount, outfit style, and more.
										      							    							      								      																																																														
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/f984fe0a30fd18a587b4bf0e8c064539662994d9.jpg[/img]																																												      							    							      								      									 
[i]High Isle Collector’s Edition Items[/i]
 
For everything on [i]High Isle’s[/i] editions, [i]Collector’s Edition[/i] items, and more, [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/61499]check out this article[/url].
 [h2]Getting Started in High Isle[/h2] 
Once you have access to the [i]High Isle[/i] Chapter, you can travel to the new zone and begin your adventure in the following ways:
 
[b]By Wayshrine[/b]
 
If you’d like to explore High Isle with an existing character, you can teleport to the new zone directly via the Westbay Wayshrine. To do so, simply open your map, select the High Isle zone, and then select the Westbay Wayshine icon (it should be the only one active in the zone).
 
[b]Via the High Isle Main Quest[/b]
 
You can acquire the [i]High Isle[/i] main quest by navigating to your Collections UI, selecting Stories, and then Chapters. From there, you can select [i]High Isle[/i] and pick up the first quest, titled “Of Knights and Knaves,” to begin. The quest will point you toward where you need to go to make your way to the zone.
 
[b]Via the Tutorial[/b]
 
You can also travel to High Isle by creating a new character and completing the new tutorial. At the end of the tutorial experience, you can select High Isle as your destination zone and get started.
 
Of course, because there’s no level requirements for any PvE zone in [i]ESO[/i], you can explore High Isle with an existing or brand-new character—have fun! 
 [h2]Update 34[/h2] 
Also launching in tandem with the [i]High Isle[/i] Chapter is the Update 34 base-game patch. This update includes a host of new features, quality-of-life improvements, and fixes, completely free for all current [i]ESO[/i] players with no Chapter purchase required. 
 
[b]Spanish Language Support[/b]
 
With Update 34, our growing Spanish-language community from all over the world can now experience a completely translated Tamriel. This update provides Spanish-language translations for all in-game texts and subtitles, including menus, and dialog.
										      							    							      								      																																																														[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/a1e2c0b708202a53c9b673be8b80ff380631abd7.jpg[/img]																																												      							    							      								      									 
[i]Enjoy Spanish-language support in game[/i]
 
Note that English voice-overs remain with Spanish subtitles. You can enable Spanish-language text in game by selecting your language from the PC/Mac launcher (within the Settings menu) if playing on PC/Mac, or by ensuring your console’s system settings are set to Spanish if playing on console.
 
[b]Quality-of-Life Improvements[/b]
 
This update also introduces two player-requested improvements to the base game. With U34, the Armory System now supports the addition of specific Mundus Stone selections, allowing you to set and select different boons for individual builds. Note that when you first log into the game, your current Mundus Stone selection on your character is automatically applied to [b]all[/b] your Armory builds, so you may need to make some edits when you first get in. 
 
In addition to the Armory System update, we’ve also made some improvements to the Quick Select Wheel on PC/Mac, allowing you to place items within primary or secondary wheels, so you can focus your combat-oriented items up front while still giving you quick access to other types of items such as mementos, emotes, or tools. 
										      							    							      								      																																																														
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/5f28175a82b9378d4e27c9220e75b2e12a10f3c3.jpg[/img]																																						      							    							      								      									 
[i]U34 improves the Quick Select Wheel[/i]
 
These are, of course, just some of the improvements coming with Update 34, so be sure to check out everything arriving as part of this base-game patch by checking out the [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]patch notes on our official forums[/url]. 
 [h2]Defend the Legacy of the Bretons[/h2] 
In [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: High Isle,[/i] a darkness looms over the Systres Archipelago, and an ascending threat rises from the Breton elites’ island paradise. Explore a faraway land never-before-seen in the [i]Elder Scrolls[/i] series, uncover a deadly conspiracy at the heart of Breton society, play a hand of a new deck-building card game, and defend the Legacy of the Bretons before the chaos of war engulfs both High Isle and all of Tamriel. Are you excited to begin your journey to High Isle? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]!
 
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: High Isle is now live for PC/Mac and Stadia* and arrives for Xbox and PlayStation consoles on June 21. [/i]
 
[i]*Available only in limited territories.[/i]

notes.title: Ascending Tide DLC & Update 33 Now Live on PC/Mac
notes.notes:
[i]Your Legacy of the Bretons year-long adventure sets sail with the Ascending Tide dungeon DLC pack and Update 33 base-game patch.[/i]

The [i]Elder Scrolls Online: Ascending Tide[/i] DLC game pack is now live on PC/Mac and Stadia* (Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, and PlayStation 5 DLC launch will follow on March 29). It introduces two new dungeons to challenge your group and begins an adventure that takes you to the distant shores of High Isle and the chivalric Bretons who call it home**.

[previewyoutube=jwmfzVAdZMM;full][/previewyoutube]

This release also includes the free Update 33 base-game patch, which provides all ESO players with a series of additions and improvements to the game.

You can access the DLC via ESO Plus™ membership or purchase it with crowns from the in-game Crown Store. Additionally, check out the patch notes for both Ascending Tide and Update 33 on our official forums.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/94071d42fd8e747e6e1a029d385f6934fd93fc85.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/bf8347191f69d8dfb665ef4696e8805da998d810.jpg[/img]

[h2]Ascending Tide DLC Game Pack[/h2]
Experience two new daring adventures with your PvE crew in the Coral Aerie and Shipwright’s Regret. Both four-player dungeons feature unique stand-alone stories while also kicking off your Legacy of the Bretons year-long epic adventure.

[h3]Coral Aerie[/h3]
Invade a secret hideout of the mysterious Ascendant Order and rescue the dashing rogue Jakarn beneath the island home of the High Elves in Coral Aerie. Team up with Captain Kaleen and explore the site’s stunning coral formations and Elven ruins as you battle your way through both the cave’s new residents and monstrous local inhabitants.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/7f8db83c306b41bc770b97d2b3f9d59f68a9e7a7.jpg[/img]
[i]Expose the secretive Ascendant Order[/i]

You can learn more about Coral Aerie in our preview.
[b]
Shipwright’s Regret[/b]
Believed to be one of the shipyards for the legendary All Flags Navy, the dilapidated docks and rotted work halls of Shipwright’s Regret is now home to the uneasy dead, wrathful spirits, and Dreadsail pirates. Of course, that won’t stop the ever-enterprising Khajiit Captain Za’ji from entering the cursed site in search of upgrades for his beloved ship, the Perfect Pounce!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/63d5f6a3535d327814c0e5af50ce5ce74bac1646.jpg[/img]
[i]Survive the haunted remnants of Shipwright’s Regret[/i]

Help the swashbuckling captain as he searches for a special kind of treasure amongst ancient history and the dead. Learn more about Shipwright’s Regret in this preview.

Both dungeons can be completed in Normal, Veteran, and Hard Mode difficulties, plus feature unique challenges and rewards not found anywhere else in Tamriel. The characters and forces you encounter and the stories you uncover in Ascending Tide set the scene for the upcoming High Isle* Chapter and Legacy of the Bretons year-long saga—get ready to set sail for a new adventure!

[h1]Getting Started[/h1]
You can access The Elder Scrolls Online: Ascending Tide DLC game pack via ESO Plus membership or purchase it for 1,500 crowns from the in-game Crown Store (listed under DLC). Note that if your ESO Plus membership lapses, you will lose access to the DLC until you renew your membership or purchase it with crowns, but you won’t lose any items, Achievements, or other rewards you earned while you had access.

The Ascending Tide Collector’s Bundle is also available for 4,000 crowns and includes access to the DLC game pack, the Dreadsail Howler mount, the Iliac Bay Crab pet, and five Crown Experience Scrolls. You can purchase the Collector’s Bundle from the Featured section of the in-game Crown Store.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/bf4e4476d5ce903034025427d0a29833e8a2b154.jpg[/img]
[i]Ascending Tide Collector’s Bundle[/i]

With access to the Ascending Tide DLC, you can begin your Legacy of the Bretons adventure by the following methods:

[list]
[*] By teleporting directly into the two dungeons from your map
[*] By using the Dungeon Finder tool
[*] By walking up to the dungeon entrances within Summerset (Coral Aerie) and Rivenspire (Shipwright’s Regret)
[/list]
Finally, simply by entering either of these two new dungeons, you receive the Abyssal Embrace face markings!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/b6d130ff88893ec74b20ccd817ed2cff2a3eaf36.jpg[/img]
[i]Unlock new rewards in Ascending Tide[/i]

[h1]Update 33 Base-Game Patch[/h1]
Also launching in tandem with Ascending Tide is the Update 33 base-game patch, a free update that introduces new bug fixes, balance changes, performance improvements, and features.

[h2]Account-Wide Achievements[/h2]

To ensure ESO’s performance remains stable as new content continues to be added to the game, most in-game achievements become account-wide with Update 33. As a result, when you earn a new achievement with one of your characters, that same achievement could count as being earned by all others. This change also alters how the Undaunted skill line advances, and your rank now increases as you complete quests within dungeons and finish Undaunted dailies. Read more about this big change to how achievement works in our preview article and forum Q&A.

[h2]New PvP Rewards
[/h2]
Update 33 also introduces powerful new item sets that you can earn when receiving your Rewards for the Worthy PvP loot. These three new sets (Rallying Cry, Hew and Sunder, and Enervating Aura) create new ways to play for your characters when battling in the Battlegrounds, Cyrodiil, and Imperial City. In addition to this, all PvP players can also receive style pages for the Dragonguard Berserker armor by trading in Tel Var Stones to the Tel Var merchants in the Imperial City Sewers (Alliance Rank 20 required). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/6e7beb0150a08b391c42f17a89e14fc3a68744f6.jpg[/img]

[i]The Dragonguard Berserker style[/i]

These are just some of the changes and additions coming with the free Update 33 base-game patch, so be sure to check out the full patch notes on our official forums for everything.

[h1]Your Legacy Begins[/h1]
Two swashbuckling adventures await in [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Ascending Tide[/i]! Explore Coral Aerie and Shipwright’s Regret, challenge your crew with a host of dangerous monsters and bosses, and uncover powerful and unique new rewards found only in this DLC. Are you excited to set sail on your Legacy of the Bretons journey? Tell us via Twitter, Instagram, and Facebook.

[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Ascending Tide is now live on PC/Mac and Stadia*, and arrives on Xbox and PlayStation consoles March 29. You can get access to this new dungeon DLC via ESO Plus™ membership or via purchase with crowns from the in-game Crown Store.

*Available only in limited territories.

**The Elder Scrolls Online: High Isle arrives on PC/Mac and Stadia* June 6 and Xbox and PlayStation consoles June 21.[/i]

notes.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Deadlands & Update 32 Now Live on PC/Mac
notes.notes:
[i]Experience the cataclysmic conclusion to the Gates of Oblivion adventure in The Elder Scrolls Online: Deadlands and Update 32. [/i]

[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Deadlands[/i] and Update 32 base game patch are now live on PC/Mac and Stadia. If you’re a console player, don’t fear. [i]Deadlands[/i] arrives on Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, and PlayStation 5 consoles on November 16. 

[previewyoutube=GAWh5dt9z-A;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
									      						    						      						        																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																					      						    						      						        [h2]The Elder Scrolls Online: Deadlands[/h2]
Mehrunes Dagon’s plans for Nirn in the [i]Blackwood[/i] Chapter were not thwarted, only delayed, and now Tamriel’s heroes must face the Daedric Prince of Destruction within his own realm. The final part of the year-long Gates of Oblivion adventure, [i]Deadlands[/i] concludes the exciting saga of ambition and destruction that began with the [i]Flames of Ambition[/i] DLC in February. 

[b]A Gates of Oblivion Story[/b]

In this story DLC, you can explore Dagon’s plane of Oblivion and the mysterious city of Fargrave while unraveling the Daedric Prince’s ultimate plans for Nirn and the people of Tamriel. In your adventures, you’ll experience tales and locations that showcase the life and society of those who call Oblivion home and be challenged by all-new encounters and threats. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/200fbed23b481ed96bbd2a4f946e23bd0025052c.jpg[/img]									      						    						      						        																																																		      						    						      						        
[i]The Daedric Prince of Destruction awaits[/i]

While featuring a unique, standalone storyline, [i]Deadlands[/i] also contains three bonus quests that are only unlocked if you complete the [i]Blackwood[/i] and [i]Deadlands[/i] main questlines first. During these exclusive quests, you’ll finally have your opportunity to confront Mehrunes Dagon himself and put a stop to his dread plans … for now. 

[b]Deadlands Zone & Fargrave[/b]

Chaotic, perilous, and unrelenting, Dagon’s realm of Oblivion is a dangerous world where only the strong survive. In this new zone, you can venture into the regions known as the Burn and Sever, two equally volatile aspects of the Daedric Prince made manifest. 
									      						    						      						        																												[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/8dc21481644111bfa10557479e6d632f20e47df3.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/e672ace80e2f04817f6030f79e294475ad0db5cf.jpg[/img]																							      						    						      						        
[i]Explore two unique biomes in the Deadlands[/i]

When exploring the Deadlands, you’ll encounter the vicious followers of Dagon and those few who’ve eked out an existence in this hellscape. With new delves to investigate, world bosses to vanquish, and a host of stories to experience, the Deadlands is a world unlike any other in [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i]. Luckily for you, you can find refuge beyond Dagon’s reach. 

A player hub and “safe haven” in a realm between realms, the mysterious city of Fargrave is home to both mortal and Daedric residents alike, living and working in relative harmony. This bizarre city serves as the base of your operations as you explore and continue your adventures. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/633ef67d6e78ab6987fc0a25c2573463bfc7a679.jpg[/img]									      						    						      						        																																																						      						    						      						        
[i]Fargrave, home to mortals and Daedra alike[/i]

In Fargrave, you’ll encounter new allies, such as the heroic Anchorite or mysterious Madam Whim, and learn more about those who call Oblivion home. Check out our recent previews on the[i] [/i][url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/61117]zone[/url] and [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/61141]stories[/url] for more on the kind of experience waiting for you in the Deadlands. 

[b]New Challenges and Rewards[/b]

As you quest and explore in both the Deadlands zone and Fargrave, you’ll find no shortage of new challenges to overcome, including the patrolling Havocrel Executioners, hulking giants who walk Dagon’s realm in search of outsiders and require large groups to vanquish. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/ceaa3a85810d6052fdc08a94abcdda32bb1de261.jpg[/img]									      						    						      						        																																																														      						    						      						        			  
[i]Dagon’s most-fearsome warriors guard his realm[/i]
  
This zone also includes a host of stand-alone quests to  complete, memorable characters to encounter, and a series of unique rewards that  include item sets (three crafted and three zone), Oblivion-touched  collectibles, and Achievements—a bounty of loot and glory for those willing to  set foot in Dagon’s realm.

  [h2]How Do I Get the Deadlands?[/h2]  
The [i]Deadlands[/i] DLC is free for all ESO Plus™ members and  available for purchase for 2,000 crowns from the in-game Crown Store (listed  under DLC). Note that if your ESO Plus membership lapses, you will lose access  to the DLC until you renew or purchase the DLC with crowns, but you won’t lose  any items or progress you earned while you had access.
									      						    						      						        																												[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/7e12d4075faf4aa692eee3f4952b66804c99589b.jpg[/img]																															      						    						      						        
[i]The Deadlands Collector’s Bundle[/i]

Releasing in tandem with the base DLC, the [i]Deadlands Collector’s Bundle[/i] is also available in the in-game Crown Store for 4,000 crowns and includes the Nightmare Bear mount, the Deadlands Bantam Guar pet, and Crown Experience Scrolls. You can find the [i]Deadlands Collector’s Bundle[/i] in the Featured section of the Crown Store. 
[h2]Getting Started in the Deadlands[/h2]
When you have access to the [i]Deadlands[/i] DLC, you can begin your exploration of this volatile part of Oblivion by the following methods:
[list][*]By teleporting directly to the Fargrave Outskirts wayshrine from your map[/*][*]By using the DLC tab of your Collections UI and accepting the “The Celestial Palanquin” quest from the Zone DLC section[/*][/list]
Once you set foot in Dagon’s realm, you can explore the new zone (including Fargrave), begin the DLC’s storyline, or simply explore—it’s up to you! The first time you enter the zone, you’ll receive the Oblivion Explorer’s Headwrap collectible completely free as a bonus reward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/c97c9f3be40b61ac973fd4edbb59089153cc41e1.jpg[/img]									      						    						      						        																																																												      						    						      						        
[i]Prepare to explore Oblivion[/i]
[h2]Update 32 Base-Game Patch[/h2]
Also releasing alongside the DLC is the Update 32 base-game patch. This free update for all existing [i]ESO[/i] players includes a host of new features, bug fixes, and improvements. 

[b]Armory System[/b]

Designed to help you effortlessly switch builds, the new Armory System allows you to quickly swap a character’s attributes, abilities, items, Champion Points, and more. With the Armory Station (free from the in-game Crown Store) you can set, equip, and organize your character’s builds from the comfort of your home. 									      						    						      						        																											

With this system, you can engage in different activities more-easily and reduce the amount of time spent re-customizing your character. In addition to the free Armory Station, you can also acquire an Armory Assistant from the in-game Crown Store for crowns and purchase additional Armory Slots, too (you always start with two for free). 

[b]Curated Item Set Drops[/b]

Part of an ongoing effort to reduce the amount of grind required to collect [i]ESO[/i]’s many powerful sets, Update 32 also introduces a curation system that changes the way items drop. Now, when you defeat a monster, the system attempts to drop set items that you don’t already have in your collection. 

With this change, you can more quickly complete your set collections and perfect your builds, dramatically reducing the amount of frustration that comes when hunting specific item set rewards. Note that some drops will remain completely randomized (such as those found in dungeon chests or items tied to specific bosses). You can find more on curated drops and the Armory System in our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/61131]preview article[/url]—happy item hunting!

For everything arriving with Update 32, check out the patch notes section on our [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]official forums[/url]. 

[h2]Bring Destruction to the Deadlands[/h2]
The Gates of Oblivion year-long saga ends in fire with [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Deadlands[/i], and it’s time to take the fight to Mehrunes Dagon himself and explore one of the most inhospitable and dangerous realms of Oblivion. Are you ready and willing to battle the Prince of Destruction’s forces on his home turf? Are you looking forward to the incredible new features arriving free as part of Update 32? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url].

[i]The Gates of Oblivion epic concludes with the Deadlands DLC game pack and Update 32, now available for PC/Mac and Stadia* and coming November 16 for Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation®4, and PlayStation®5.[/i]

notes.title: Waking Flame DLC & Update 31 Now Live on PC/Mac
notes.notes:
[i]Continue your Gates of Oblivion adventure with the Waking Flame dungeon DLC and Update 31 base-game patch. [/i]

[i]The Elder Scrolls Online:[/i] [i]Waking Flame [/i]DLC game pack is now live on PC/Mac and Stadia, and it challenges players with two new dungeons, each with their own unique Gates of Oblivion stories. If you play on console, don’t fret—[i]Waking Flame[/i] arrives on Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, and PlayStation 5 on [b]September 8[/b]. 

This release also includes the free Update 31 base-game patch, which provides all [i]ESO[/i] players with a series of additions and improvements to the game. 

[previewyoutube=EeGZQS4ebxE;full][/previewyoutube]									      						    						      						        																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																			      						    						      						        
You can access the DLC via [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/esoplus]ESO Plus™ membership[/url] or purchase it with crowns from the in-game Crown Store. Additionally, check out the patch notes for both [i]Waking Flame[/i] and Update 31 on our [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]official forums[/url].

[h2]Waking Flame DLC Game Pack[/h2]
Uncover evils in [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Waking Flame[/i] with two amazing new dungeons: Red Petal Bastion and the Dread Cellar. While both PvE challenges explore unique stand-alone stories, they also expand upon the year-long Gates of Oblivion adventure and set up the events of the upcoming [i]Deadlands[/i] DLC (arriving later in 2021). 

[b]Red Petal Bastion[/b]

For centuries, the noble Knights of the Silver Rose had protected the people from Tamriel from the forces of Oblivion, but recently, the order has begun indiscriminately looting nearby shrines to collect holy relics, which they add to their fortress, the Red Petal Bastion. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/db38f8e1d9374c0f9a5386bc74f11118f4a8a3d2.jpg[/img]																												      						    						      						        
A devotee of Azura needs your help to confront this once-noble order, reclaim his stolen artifacts, and discover the secret behind the order’s sudden and violent turn. 

[b]The Dread Cellar[/b]

Whispered to be one of the Empire’s most-feared prisons, the Dread Cellar, long thought abandoned, has begun emanating mysterious magical energies. Now home to the cultists of the Waking Flame and their Daedric minions, this once-feared site holds new evils for any would-be adventurers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/6de42719eff5d82a8de5b3d3b161933b01403ef5.jpg[/img]																																	      						    						      						        
A pair of Imperial Battlemages needs your assistance in their investigation of the prison’s activity, but what role does the Dread Cellar’s own past have in the cultists’ fiendish plans? And to what lengths might the Battlespire go to protect the Empire’s secrets? 

Both dungeons are filled with a host of challenging boss battles to overcome and mysteries to uncover, and both are available in Normal, Veteran, and Hard Mode difficulties for groups seeking difficult opposition. Finally, each dungeon also holds a series unique item sets, Achievements, and collectibles for you to loot and earn, ensuring the rewards are equal to the risks—good luck!   

[h2]Getting Started[/h2]
You can[b] [/b]access [i]The Elder Scrolls Online:[/i] [i]Waking Flame[/i] DLC game pack via ESO Plus membership or purchase it for 1,500 crowns from the in-game Crown Store (listed under DLC). Note that if your ESO Plus membership lapses, you will lose access to the DLC until you renew your membership or purchase it with crowns, but you won’t lose any items, Achievements, or other rewards you earned while you had access.

The [i]Waking Flame Collector’s Bundle[/i] is also available for 4,000 crowns and includes access to the DLC game pack, the Silver Rose Senche-Serval mount, the Ironclad Senche-Serval Kitten pet, and five Crown Experience Scrolls. You can purchase the Collector’s Bundle from the Featured section of the in-game Crown Store.
									      						    						      						        																												[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/e4e1ae723cd0cbf5235987fdd030bea342269da0.jpg[/img]																																			      						    						      						        
With access to the [i]Waking Flame[/i] DLC, you can continue your Gates of Oblivion adventure by the following methods:
[list][*]By teleporting directly into the two dungeons from your map[/*][*]By using the Dungeon Finder tool[/*][*]By walking up to the dungeon entrances within Blackwood (Dread Cellar) and within Glenumbra (Red Petal Bastion)[/*][/list]
Finally, simply by entering either of these two new dungeons, you’ll receive the Scorion Pyreling pet!
									      						    						      						        																												
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/f3283e541ff048af5dd90e7127b9170514d97ce4.jpg[/img]																																			      						    						      						        [h2]Update 31[/h2]
In addition to [i]Waking Flame[/i], the Update 31 base-game patch will arrive in tandem with the DLC as a free update for all [i]ESO[/i] players. This update includes assorted bug fixes, balance changes, performance improvements, and a series of quality-of-life additions.

This includes the ability to toggle between HDR modes on consoles in your Settings menu, the addition of Dynamic Resolution Scaling (creating a more responsive framerate experience and providing generally higher resolutions when running in Performance Mode on Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5), a beta for Multithreaded Rendering on PC (potentially improving framerates), and a Reply function for your in-game mail. In addition to this, an assortment of new houses, furnishings, and houseguests will arrive in in-game Crown store in the coming months.  

For more on the graphical improvements arriving with Update 31, check out [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/60649]this article[/url], and be sure to visit our official forums to review the complete [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/discussion/584299/pc-mac-patch-notes-v7-1-5-waking-flame-update-31]patch notes[/url] for both [i]Waking Flame[/i] and Update 31 to get the whole picture.

[h2]The Waking Flame Rises[/h2]
With two exciting dungeons that expand upon the Gates of Oblivion adventures and a slew of graphical enhancements and changes, the [i]Waking Flame[/i] DLC and Update 31 base-game patch bring new challenges, rewards, and improvements for all of Tamriel’s adventurers. Are you ready to continue the fight against the forces of Mehrunes Dagon? Tell us via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url].

notes.title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Blackwood & Update 30 Now Live on PC/Mac
notes.notes:
[i]Experience a world on the brink of destruction in The Elder Scrolls Online: Blackwood, a new Chapter in the Elder Scrolls Online saga. [/i]

We are happy to announce that [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Blackwood[/i] and Update 30 are both now live on PC/Mac and Stadia. This new Chapter and update will launch on PlayStation 4 and Xbox One on June 8, with Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5 also available via backwards compatibility.

[previewyoutube=s36tayDTjTs;full][/previewyoutube]									      						    						      						        																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																						      						    						      						        [h2]Blackwood Chapter [/h2]
The Daedric Prince of Destruction, Mehrunes Dagon, has dire plans for the people of Tamriel, and they begin in the lush marshlands of Blackwood. This new adventure features a complex tale of ambition and revolution that is part of the larger Gates of Oblivion year-long saga that began with the [i]Flames of Ambition [/i]DLC in February and continues throughout all of 2021. 

In the [i]Blackwood[/i] Chapter, you can experience: 
[list][*]A massive new zone to explore: Blackwood[/*][*]A mysterious new main storyline to unravel of Daedric ambitions and schemes[/*][*]A new system: Companions[/*][*]A new 12-player Trial: Rockgrove[/*][*]A new type of world event: Oblivion Portals[/*][*]A host of new and unique side quests, stories, characters, and challenges[/*][*]A selection of new item sets, collectibles, and Achievements [/*][/list]
[b]Blackwood Zone[/b]

In this new Chapter, you can explore the region of Blackwood, nestled among the swamps of the Black Marsh, the warm sands of Elsweyr, and the rolling hills of Cyrodiil. With a local population made up of Imperials, Argonians, and Khajiit, Blackwood is a unique melting pot of different cultures and peoples. Beyond the high walls of the cities of Leyawiin and Gideon, you’ll experience an untamed wilderness filled with ancient sites of long-forgotten empires, dangerous and diverse local creatures, and the rising Daedric threat from realms beyond. 

[previewyoutube=tnnVb1Bd_B4;full][/previewyoutube]									      						    						      						        																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																														      						    						      						        
[b]A New Storyline[/b]

In the [i]Blackwood[/i] Chapter, you must uncover the truth behind the emerging Daedric threat and its connection to the Longhouse Emperors. In this tale of Imperial and Daedric ambitions, what you discover in your adventures in Blackwood will have dire consequences for the people of Tamriel and set up the story for the rest of the year-long Gates of Oblivion saga. 

[previewyoutube=Zv4y-LDyMqA;full][/previewyoutube]																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																									      						    						      						        
[b]Companions System[/b]

With the new Companions system, you’ll never have to explore Tamriel alone again. Recruit, equip, and fight with one of two new Companions available with this Chapter and take them to almost every corner of Tamriel. As you battle beside your new Companions, they’ll level up and gain new unique skills. In addition, you can increase (or lower) your rapport with your Companions by engaging with them and performing certain actions, allowing you to unlock unique quests and other rewards. 

[previewyoutube=s0XcDi9ZrBc;full][/previewyoutube]																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																				      						    						      						        
[b]Oblivion Portals[/b]

New world events unique to the Chapter, portals to the Deadlands have begun to appear within the wilds of Blackwood. From these doorways to Oblivion, you and your allies can invade Mehrunes Dagon’s realm and confront the Daedric hordes that now prepare for war. 

[b]Rockgrove Trial[/b]

Gather your allies for a new 12-player Trial and defend Rockgrove against the invading Daedric cultists. Contend with the empowered devotees of Mehrunes Dagon and battle your way through the city and into the Deadlands itself. New gear, Achievements, and collectibles await those willing to stand against the forces of the Prince of Destruction! 

You can discover and read more about [i]Blackwood[/i] on [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/category/blackwood]our official site[/url].

[h2]Purchase Details & Requirements[/h2]
[i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Blackwood[/i] is available in four editions, including: 
[list][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online Collection: Blackwood[/i][/*][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online Collection: Blackwood Collector’s Edition[/i][/*][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Blackwood Upgrade[/i][/*][*][i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Blackwood Upgrade Collector’s Edition[/i][/*][/list]
If you are a brand-new player, the[i] ESO Collection: Blackwood [/i]includes the base game, [i]Blackwood[/i] Chapter, and all previous Chapters. If you already own [i]ESO[/i] and its previous Chapters, the [i]ESO: Blackwood Upgrade[/i] grants you access to the new Chapter. Note that to run [i]Blackwood[/i] on PC/Mac, your machine needs to meet the game's requirements here: [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/newplayerguide/minspec]PC[/url], [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/newplayerguide/minspec]Mac[/url].

In addition to the Chapter itself, the Collector’s Editions also include a selection of unique in-game items, including a pet, mount, outfit style, and more. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/19dfb67c718a5321aba9a45cbe4707e0399229e3.jpg[/img]																																	      						    						      						        
[i]Collector’s Edition Items[/i]

For everything on [i]Blackwood[/i]’s editions, Collector’s Edition items, and more, [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/59473]check out this article[/url]. 

[h2]Getting Started in Blackwood[/h2]
Once you have access to the [i]Blackwood[/i] Chapter, you can travel to the new zone and begin your adventure in the following ways: 

[b]By Wayshrine[/b]

If you’d like to explore Blackwood with an existing character, you can teleport to the new zone directly via the Leyawiin Outskirts Wayshrine. To do so, simply open your map, select the Blackwood zone, and then select the Leyawiin Outskirts Wayshine icon (it should be the only one active in the zone). 

[b]Via the Blackwood Main Quest[/b]

You can acquire the Blackwood main quest by navigating to your Collections UI, selecting Stories, and then Chapters. From there, you can select Blackwood and pick up the first quest, titled “A Deadly Secret,” to begin. The quest will point you toward where you need to go to make your way to the zone. 

[b]Via the Tutorial[/b]

You can also travel to Blackwood by creating a new character and completing the new tutorial. At the end of the tutorial experience, you can select Blackwood as your destination zone and get started. 

Of course, you can explore Blackwood with an existing or brand-new character, regardless of their level (there’s no level requirements for any PvE zone). Adventure awaits!

[h2]Update 30[/h2]
Releasing in tandem with the [i]Blackwood[/i] Chapter, Update 30 is a free base-game patch for all [i]ESO[/i] players that includes a host of new features, quality-of-life improvements, and fixes—no additional purchase needed! 

[b]Endeavors System [/b]

With the new Endeavors system, going live later this month, you can complete daily and weekly tasks to earn a new type of currency, called Seals of Endeavor, used to acquire Crown Crate items. Previously, the only way to own these rare items was by either opening Crown Crates or by spending gems, but with this new system, you can acquire them simply by playing the game. The daily and weekly Endeavors includes all kinds of regular [i]ESO[/i] activities such as combat, exploration, questing, crafting, etc., and rewards variable amounts of Seals each day. 
									      						    						      						        																												[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/e94947fcc6773d1c1c4c13c40b71e95472704035.jpg[/img]																					      						    						      						        
[i]View current Endeavors in your Activity Finder[/i]

This new system arrives with Update 30, but it won’t be active until later in June. Keep an eye out for more information on Endeavors later this month and read more about the new system in this [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/59925]announcement article.[/url] 

[b]New Tutorial System[/b]

Update 30 introduces a brand-new default Tutorial for all [i]ESO[/i] players and all versions of the game. Within the mysterious Isle of Balfiera, you must help the mage Norianwe navigate ancient Direnni ruins and investigate the emergence of mysterious portals. Upon completion of the tutorial quest, you can choose where you wish to begin your adventures in Tamriel via a portal room granting access to the starting locations of any of the Chapters you own or any of the starting locations for the three base-game Alliances. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/942dc6247c41e320dbaa28a9519a577e51f0f813.jpg[/img]																																	      						    						      						        
[i]Choose your starting location in the new tutorial experience[/i]

Be warned, once you’ve selected your starting location and entered the portal, you can’t go back! For more on the new Tutorial, see [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-gb/news/post/60151]this preview article[/url]. 

[b]Ability Bar Timers[/b]

A new addition to your Combat Settings menu, Ability Bar Timers allow you to see a timer over an ability’s icon that indicates the remaining duration of its effect. You can enable this timer for both your front and back bars, helping you stay on top of things during [i]ESO[/i]’s fast-paced combat. These options are set to “off” by default, but you can enable them for both Keyboard and Gamepad within your Settings. 

These are, of course, just some of the most notable features coming with Update 30, but you can discover a host of other additions and improvements with this patch, including new Monster Masks, bankable Outfit Style pages, and Master Writ quest assistance. Read all about this and more in our [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]official patch notes[/url]. 

[h2]Oblivion Threatens Tamriel[/h2]
In [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Blackwood[/i], the Prince of Destruction has plans for the people of Tamriel, and the minions of Mehrunes Dagon work tirelessly to enact his dread schemes. Explore this wild and dangerous region, investigate the rising Daedric threat, and take on Oblivion itself as you contend with mortal ambitions and otherworldly monsters alike. 

To help you face these new challenges, from now until June 10 on PC/Mac and from June 8 until June 22 on consoles, you’ll be able respec your Champion Points at no cost! Are you excited to continue or begin your Gates of Oblivion adventure with the [i]Blackwood[/i] Chapter? Let us know via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]!

notes.title: Flames of Ambition DLC & Update 29 Now Live on PC/Mac
notes.notes:
[i]Your Gates of Oblivion year-long adventure begins with the Flames of Ambition DLC and Update 29 base-game patch, now live on PC/Mac![/i]

The [i]Flames of Ambition[/i] DLC game pack is now live on PC/Mac and brings two new dungeons to the adventurers of Tamriel. This release also includes Update 29, a free base-game patch for all [i]ESO[/i] players that introduces a host of changes and improvements. If you play on Xbox One or PlayStation®4, don’t worry, this DLC and update will also arrive on consoles March 16.
									      						    						      						        						      						    						      						        
Within the DLC and free base-game patch, you will find:

[list][*]Two new dungeons: Black Drake Villa and the Cauldron[/*][*]The beginnings of the Gates of Oblivion storyline[/*][*]New rewards, including item sets, Achievements, and collectibles[/*][*]Update to the Champion System[/*][*]New quality-of-life improvements[/*][*]And more![/*][/list]
You can access this DLC via [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/esoplus]ESO Plus™ membership[/url] or purchase it with crowns from the in-game Crown Store. Additionally, check out the patch notes for both [i]Flames of Ambition[/i] and Update 29 on our [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]official forums[/url].

[h2]Flames of Ambition DLC Game Pack[/h2]
The Gates of Oblivion year-long adventure begins in fire with the [i]Flames of Ambition[/i] DLC game pack and two exciting new dungeons, the Cauldron and Black Drake Villa. While both dungeons are exciting stand-alone stories in their own right, both also set up the events of the upcoming [i]Blackwood[/i] Chapter and beyond.

[b]Black Drake Villa[/b]

Team up with the adventurous Wood Elf scout [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/59603]Eveli Sharp-Arrow[/url] and search the hidden archives of the Black Drake Villa before the mercenaries of the True-Sworn put it to the torch. Take note, while the once-proud mansion is now home to monsters and arsonists, it contains many puzzling secrets and pathways just waiting to be uncovered by eagle-eyed adventurers. You can discover more about Black Drake Villa [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/59623]in our preview[/url]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/ce4780b87d5f49ee4eed6e6a3dd3cf0d8a94a4e7.jpg[/img]																														      						    						      						        
[i]Confront the flame-wielding True-Sworn[/i]

[b]The Cauldron[/b]

The cult of the Waking Flame has enslaved the local townsfolk and now excavates sinister ruins deep within a long-forgotten mine. With the help of the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/59587]Dremora Lyranth[/url], you must enter the Cauldron, battle your way through Daedric beasts and cultists, free the captives, and put a stop to their plans before they can complete their dread work. You can preview more of the Cauldron in [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/59559]this article[/url]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/a43b6493014072c045616bb32f75abae9d5c9f0c.jpg[/img]																																	      						    						      						        
[i]Uncover the Waking Flame’s plans in the Cauldron[/i]

These new dungeons provide two very different experiences for would-be adventures, and they come packed with a host of unique rewards, including powerful gear sets, Achievements, and collectibles. You can attempt to complete both dungeons in Normal and Veteran difficulties, and Black Drake Villa has an optional Hard Mode for each of its three bosses—just in case you and your team want a true challenge!

[h2]How to Get Flames of Ambition[/h2]
Access the [i]Flames of Ambition[/i] DLC game pack via ESO Plus™ membership or purchase it for 1,500 crowns from the in-game Crown Store (listed under DLC). Note that if your ESO Plus membership lapses, you will lose access to the DLC until you renew your membership or purchase it with crowns, but you won’t lose any items, Achievements, or other rewards you earned while you had access. 

[b]Flames of Ambition Collector’s Bundle[/b]

The [i]Flames of Ambition Collector’s Bundle[/i] is also available for 4,000 crowns and includes access to the DLC game pack, the Falinesti’s Faithful Totem Elk mount, the Clearspring Striped Fawn pet, and five Crown Experience Scrolls. You can purchase the Collector’s Bundle from the Featured section of the in-game Crown Store. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/f7cb52d426b37c1187be77a7441674bc23a18ab5.jpg[/img]																																		      						    						      						        
[i]The Flames of Ambition Collector’s Bundle[/i]

[h2]Explore Flames of Ambition & Get a Unique Weapon Style[/h2]
Once you get access to the [i]Flames of Ambition[/i] DLC dungeons, you can begin your Gates of Oblivion adventure by the following methods: 
[list][*]By teleporting directly into the two dungeons from your map[/*][*]By using the Dungeon Finder tool[/*][*]By walking up to the dungeon entrances within the Gold Coast (Black Drake Villa) and within Deshaan (the Cauldron)[/*][/list]
Simply by entering either of these two new dungeons, you’ll receive the Fire-Forged Maul outfit style (as seen below on the left)! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/2068b43cc4298a89ea403cdd8442b2e57d1e7e67.jpg[/img]																																	      						    						      						        
[i]Flames of Ambition Loot & Rewards[/i]

[h2]Update 29[/h2]
Releasing in tandem with the [i]Flames of Ambition[/i] DLC, Update 29 is a free base-game patch that brings new features and improvements for all [i]ESO[/i] players. 

[b]Champion System Redesign[/b]

With the redesigned Champion System, you can better tailor your characters and their playstyles based on the way you want to play. This updated system now uses three constellation groups that reflect [i]ESO[/i]’s gameplay and provides more options for creative and unique builds. These changes also introduce a champion bar, allowing you to slot up to four powerful passive boons for each constellation, ensuring that every decision you make with regards to how you spend your Champion Points is an impactful one. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/645f6d9721f24742345209e16f4afcb4f2c7891d.jpg[/img]									      						    						      						        																																				      						    						      						        
[i]Customize your characters with the updated Champion System[/i]

For more on the update to the Champion System, check out [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/59651]our preview[/url]. 

[b]Improved Character Sheet[/b]

In addition to the Champion System redesign, the team has also updated the character sheet to include additional advanced stats that were previously obscured or missing. With these additions, you can better see how changes to your character (be it via Champion Points, abilities, gear, or attributes) change its effectiveness—now get out there and craft your perfect build!  

For everything coming with the Update 29 base-game patch, check out our [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]Patch Notes forum[/url]. 
[h2]The Gates of Oblivion Beckon[/h2]
Delve into the [i]Flames of Ambition’[/i]s two new dungeons and you’ll kick off an adventure that continues with the [i]Blackwood[/i] Chapter and beyond. The Prince of Destruction has plans for the people of Tamriel, and you can glimpse his terrible schemes within the Cauldron and Black Drake Villa. Are you ready to battle the minions of Mehrunes Dagon in these two new dungeons? Tell us via @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url].

[i]The Gates of Oblivion year-long saga begins with the Flames of Ambition DLC game pack, now live on PC/Mac and Stadia*, and coming March 16 for Xbox One and PlayStation®4. This update releases in tandem with Update 29, a free base-game patch for all ESO players. [/i]

[i]*Available only in limited territories.[/i]

notes.title: Update on Twitch Drops for The Elder Scrolls Online
notes.notes:
[i]We’ve updated the way you can earn Twitch Drops when watching your favorite ESO streams. Find everything you need to know to keep earning Drops here![/i]

With Twitch’s changes to the way Drops are now earned and delivered, there are some things you need to do to ensure that you continue (or begin!) to earn Drops when watching a Drops-enabled [i]ESO [/i]stream. 

For starters, you still need to [url=https://help.elderscrollsonline.com/app/answers/detail/a_id/41809/]link your [i]ESO[/i] and Twitch accounts[/url]. This process hasn’t changed:
[olist][*]Log into your [url=https://account.elderscrollsonline.com][i]ESO[/i] account[/url] [/*][*]Click “Linked Accounts” on the left of the page[/*][/olist][list][*]Note that if you don’t know your account info, you can reset your email and activate your account via the additional [url=https://help.elderscrollsonline.com/app/answers/detail/a_id/48788]steps found here[/url]. [/*][/list][*]Click “Link Twitch Account” [/*][*]A Twitch window will appear[/*][list][*]If you are logged into your Twitch account already, you'll be asked to authorize [i]Elder Scrolls Online[/i] - Live to use your Twitch account[/*][*]If you are not logged into your Twitch account, you'll be prompted to log in[/*][/list][*]Click “Authorize” to link your [i]ESO[/i] account to your Twitch account[/*]
Once you’re sure your accounts are linked, there’s a few things you need to be aware of to ensure you get your goodies:
[list][*]When a stream is Drops-enabled, you’ll get a notification popup letting you know they are live, in addition to a tag on the streamer’s page [/*][*]Per Twitch’s guidelines, you [b]must[/b] watch a Drops-enabled stream for at [b]least 15 cumulative minutes[/b][/*][list][*]You can track your progress on earning a Twitch Drop via [url=https://www.twitch.tv/drops/inventory]https://www.twitch.tv/drops/inventory[/url][/*][/list][*]You are [b]guaranteed[/b] a Drop once you meet the 15 minute requirement[/*][*]Once you earn a Drop, a chat notification will appear that you [b]must select[/b] to claim the Drop[/*][list][*]Alternatively, you can claim the Drop via [url=https://www.twitch.tv/drops/inventory]https://www.twitch.tv/drops/inventory[/url] [/*][*]Note that if watching on console, you will need to swap to PC or Mobile to visit this page and claim your rewards[/*][*][b]Important[/b]: In some cases you may have a limited time to claim your Drops, so be sure to grab them as soon as you see the notification[/*][/list][*]Once claimed, the Drops will be added to your account and you can find them in game as usual[/*][/list]
Drops for [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i] can include Ouroboros Crown Crates, which contain a random selection of in-game consumables such as Crown Poisons, Mimic Stones, Riding Lessons, or Experience Scrolls. They also have an extremely rare chance to contain an exclusive Senche of Scarlet Regret mount or Senche Cub of Scarlet Regret pet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/16af16ee643221863f94f924d689a6f033f72235.jpg[/img]																															      						    						      						        
[i]The Senche of Scarlet Regret mount and Senche Cub of Scarlet Regret pet[/i]

During special events or streams, there might be additional drops rewards, too! 

That’s it! Make sure you’re linked, watch a stream, then claim your Drops—easy. Be sure to keep your eye on the Twitch Drops Schedule at the bottom of our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/streamers]Streamers page[/url] for upcoming scheduled Twitch Drops and pay attention to the latest news on [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/]elderscrollsonline.com[/url].

notes.title: Markarth & Update 28 Now Live on PC/Mac
notes.notes:
[i]The Dark Heart of Skyrim epic concludes with Markarth,  our newest DLC game pack for The Elder Scrolls Online. Learn all about the new  DLC and Update 28 base-game patch in this launch article. [/i]
  
The [i]Markarth[/i] DLC game pack and Update 28 are now  available on PC/Mac and Stadia*, taking you to the wilds of the Reach and  bringing the year-long Dark Heart of Skyrim storyline to its epic conclusion. If  you play on Xbox One or PlayStation®4, don’t worry—[i]Markarth[/i] will release  on consoles November 10!
  
Within the DLC and free base-game patch, you will find:
                [list][*]Two new zones to explore: the Reach and Arkthzand Caverns[/*][list][*]Packed full of new quests, characters, and challenges[/*][/list][*]The conclusion to the Dark Heart of Skyrim storyline[/*][*]New rewards, including item sets, Achievements, and collectibles[/*][*]A new solo arenaVateshran Hollows[/*][*]The new Item Set Collection system[/*][*]New quality-of-life improvements[/*][*]And more![/*][/list]

[previewyoutube=GrFpFbwH4K4;full][/previewyoutube]
						      						    						      						        																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																																					      						    						      						        
This DLC is free for all current [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/esoplus]ESO Plus™ members[/url] or available for purchase with crowns from the in-game Crown Store. You can read the patch notes for both [i]Markarth[/i] and Update 28 on our [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]official forums[/url]. 

[h2]Markarth DLC Game Pack[/h2]
The Reach is under siege, and the dark forces of the Gray Host prey on the land’s beleaguered tribes from deep beneath the city of Markarth. In [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Markarth[/i], you can explore two new zones, discover the proud tribes of Reachfolk, and conclude the year-long Dark Heart of Skyrim adventure. 

[b]Explore the Reach & Arkthzand Caverns[/b]

For the first time in [i]The Elder Scrolls Online[/i], you can explore the unforgiving wilds of the Reach and the underworld beneath it. Filled with new stories, characters, and challenges, as you venture into this perilous part of Skyrim, you’ll encounter a people both stalwart and resilient, struggling to defend their home against the Gray Host. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/1420634848f02794518156637d3603ba90113ecf.jpg[/img]																																	      						    						      						        
[i]Explore Markarth under Reach control[/i]

In addition to the Reach, you can also venture into the area of Blackreach known as the Arkthzand Caverns, the world beneath the city of Markarth. Filled with new quests, delves, world bosses, Harrowstorms, and more, these two zones will challenge even the strongest adventurers and doom those foolhardy enough to go it alone or unprepared. For more, check out [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/58893]our preview[/url]. 

[b]The Dark Heart of Skyrim Concludes[/b]

In the [i]Markarth[/i] storyline, you’ll join forces with the local Reachfolk to confront the Gray Host. As you stand with the “Despot of Markarth” Ard Caddach and other Reach allies, you’ll unravel the terrible schemes of the Vampire Lord Rada al-Saran, and battle your way into the darkest depths of Blackreach to stop him. 

While the [i]Markarth[/i] storyline is a complete tale from start to finish, should you have already completed the [i]Greymoor[/i] Chapter’s AND the [i]Markarth[/i] DLC’s main storyline, you’ll unlock additional quests that bring the year-long Dark Heart of Skyrim adventure to its final epic conclusion. 

[b]Vateshran Hollows Arena[/b]

Test your mettle and discover if you’re strong enough to call the Reach home in Vateshran Hollows, a new solo arena designed to push even Skyrim’s strongest warriors to the limits of their skill and courage. Within this [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/59049]new single-player challenge[/url], you’ll have the opportunity to choose your paths as you enter three realms touched by Oblivion and defeat the dangers within.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/15283ee931bd7066f3bfa69a486f783440c6f9ed.jpg[/img]																																		      						    						      						        
[i]Choose your path in Vateshran Hollows[/i]

Filled with challenging boss battles and no shortage of secrets, you’ll earn rewards and honors for completing this new arena, including special item sets, Achievements, and collectibles. Get ready to claim the title of Spiritblood Champion—glory awaits! 

[b]The Reach’s Bounty[/b]

As you explore both the Reach and the world beneath, you’ll uncover and earn rewards unique to the new zone and DLC, such as powerful item sets (three zone sets and three crafted sets), exclusive collectibles, and Achievements. It won’t be easy, but the bounty of the Reach is there for those strong enough to take it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/c2b9b380e059318a6d34c41ab4594cf13c036bc5.jpg[/img]																												      						    						      						        
[i]Earn all-new rewards in Markarth[/i]

[h2]How Do I Get Markarth?[/h2]
The [i]Markarth[/i] DLC game pack is free for all ESO Plus members and available for purchase for 2,000 crowns from the in-game Crown Store (listed under DLC). Note that if your ESO Plus membership lapses, you will lose access to the DLC until you renew or purchase the DLC with crowns. You won’t lose any items or rewards you earned while you had access.

In addition to the base DLC, the [i]Markarth Collector’s Bundle[/i] is also available for 4,000 crowns. This includes access to the DLC game pack, the Chaurus Egg Chaser’s Horse mount, the Teacup Chaurus Chitterling pet, and Crown Experience Scrolls. You can find and purchase the [i]Markarth Collector’s Bundle[/i] from the Featured section of the in-game Crown Store.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/096212e212b410d7b9e3c7415a9fd7382dbf2383.jpg[/img]																															      						    						      						        
[i]The Markarth Collector’s Bundle[/i]

[h2]Getting Started in Markarth[/h2]
With access to the [i]Markarth[/i] DLC, you can venture into the wilds of the Reach by the following methods: 
[list][*]By teleporting directly to the North Markarth wayshrine from your map[/*][*]By using the DLC tab of your Collections UI and accepting the “The Despot of Markarth” quest from the Zone DLC section[/*][/list]
Once you’ve entered the Reach, you can explore the new zone, begin the DLC’s storyline, discover its many delves, world bosses, and Harrowstorm locations, or encounter any of the local Reachfolk—it’s up to you!

Finally, the first time you set foot in the Reach, you’ll receive the Arkthzand Anfractuosity Shroud completely free. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/e8874fa1377a16d1265d5e6bc7c35908879e86e7.jpg[/img]																																      						    						      						        
[i]Get this unique hat when you first enter the Markarth DLC content[/i]

[h2]Update 28 Base-Game Patch[/h2]
Releasing at the same time as the [i]Markarth[/i] DLC game pack, the Update 28 base-game patch brings a host of new features and bug fixes for all [i]ESO[/i] players, completely free. 

[b]Item Set Collection system[/b]

With Update 28, you can now add hundreds of [i]ESO[/i]’s item sets to your Collections UI and reconstruct them at a cost of Transmutation Crystals from any Transmutation Station (such as the one found in Clockwork City). You can find your collected sets within your Collections UI under the new “Sets” section. This new system will allow you to free up much-needed inventory, bank, or coffer space since almost every set in Tamriel (with the exception of crafted ones) can now be safely “stored” in Collections. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/543d3f00859cc0b4fd8a20f2dc7b2ecc637c0e33.jpg[/img]																																	      						    						      						        
[i]Collect Tamriel’s item sets[/i]

Don’t go deconstructing everything yet! Check out our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/59011]preview and FAQ[/url] for everything you need to know about this new system. 

[b]Crafting Writ UI improvements[/b]

Also included in this update are improvements to the way you complete Crafting Writs. With this patch, if you have any Crafting Writ “quests” relevant to a crafting station you’re currently using, it’ll display appropriate details, including what materials or selections need to be picked to complete the quest. No longer will you activate a crafting station only to discover that you’ve forgotten what you need to craft for your writs! 

For everything coming as part of Update 28, check out the patch notes section on [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]our official forums[/url]. 
[h2]The Dark Heart of Skyrim Ends Here![/h2]
With the launch of the [i]Markarth[/i] DLC, the year-long Dark Heart of Skyrim adventure comes to its thrilling conclusion. Explore the perilous Reach, challenge yourself in Vateshran Hollows, confront the Gray Host, and uncover the dread secrets found beneath the stone city of Markarth—all of Skyrim hangs in the balance! Tell us if you’re planning to venture into Skyrim’s dark heart and conclude your year-long epic via [url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/elderscrollsonline]Facebook[/url]. 

[i]The Dark Heart of Skyrim epic concludes with the Markarth DLC game pack and Update 28, now available for PC/Mac and Stadia* and arriving November 10 for Xbox One and PlayStation®4.[/i]

*Available only in limited territories.

[url=https://youtube.com/embed/Dd-htqMMF44?autoplay=1&rel=0]"> [/url] [h2]Stonethorn DLC Game Pack[/h2] The threat of the Gray Host did not end with the events of [i]Greymoor[/i], and new dangers arise from ancient holds and deep, hidden places. In [i]The Elder Scrolls Online: Stonethorn[/i], you can challenge yourself and your team with two exciting new dungeons: Castle Thorn and Stone Garden. As part of the Dark Heart of Skyrim, [i]Stonethorn[/i] leads into the events of the upcoming Q4 DLC and final part of this year-long adventure! [b]Stone Garden[/b] What horrifying new evils is the [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/58533]mad alchemist Arkasis[/url] crafting within the hidden laboratory of Stone Garden? Venture into Blackreach, discover the terrible creations of this twisted genius, battle your way through his empowered minions, and put a stop to his dread experiments before he births a new terror for the people of Western Skyrim. Check out our [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/58659]Stone Garden preview[/url] for more. [i]Battle your way through empowered beasts in Stone Garden[/i] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/e17bd003627225eefeb13841f730dfa4b88133e6.jpg[/img] [b]Castle Thorn[/b] Isolated within the mountains of Western Skyrim, [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/58495]Lady Thorn[/url] raises a fearsome new vampire army behind the strong walls of her keep and prepares to march on Tamriel. You must infiltrate Castle Thorn, seek out the horrifying secret behind this rising force, and confront the ancient Vampire Lord at its heart. Discover more about Castle Thorn in [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/58513]our preview[/url]. These two new dungeons will challenge your team in exciting ways and provide rewards in the form of unique gear sets, monster masks, collectibles, and Achievements. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/6018bec2520b6cfaa631b399822df2054fc966a5.jpg[/img] [i]Earn brand-new rewards[/i] Both can be completed in Normal and Veteran Difficulties, and should you truly wish to challenge your party’s skills and teamwork, Stone Garden allows you to attempt a Hard Mode version of each of its three bosses—good luck! [h2]How to Get Stonethorn[/h2] The [i]Stonethorn [/i]DLC game pack is free for all ESO Plus members and available for purchase for 1,500 crowns from the in-game Crown Store (listed under DLC). Note that if your ESO Plus membership lapses, you lose access to the DLC dungeons until you renew or purchase the DLC with crowns. You won’t lose any items or rewards you earned while you had access. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/c0a9f666359a8decf3cc2ad562213f80b001d248.jpg[/img] [b]Stonethorn Collector’s Bundle[/b] The [i]Stonethorn Collector’s Bundle[/i] is also available for 4,000 crowns. This includes access to the DLC game pack, the Frostborn Durzog Mangler mount, the Snowsnarl Durzog pet, and five Crown Experience Scrolls. You can find and purchase the [i]Stonethorn Collector’s Bundle[/i] from the Featured section of the in-game Crown Store. [i]The Stonethorn Collector’s Bundle[/i] [h2]Take on Stonethorn & Get a Unique Pet[/h2] Once you have access to the Stonethorn dungeons, you can continue your Dark Heart of Skyrim adventure by the following methods: [list][*]By teleporting directly into the two dungeons from your map[/*][*]By using the Dungeon Finder tool[/*][*]By walking up to the dungeon entrances in Western Skyrim (Castle Thorn) and Blackreach (Stone Garden)[/*][/list] By simply entering these two new dungeons, you receive the Energetic Dwarven Shock-Spider pet! [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6349516/78ef35e73c7058d8510d43794664da7335784b68.jpg[/img] [i]The perfect companion for Tamriel’s adventurers![/i] [h2]Update 27[/h2] Releasing with [i]Stonethorn[/i], Update 27 brings new features and improvements for all [i]ESO[/i] players, free! [b]Character Pathing[/b] With the new Character Pathing tool added to the Homestead System, you can now give your pets, mounts, and assistants unique paths for them to follow throughout your home, helping it feel more alive than ever. By simply assigning your companions nodes, you can have them move all around your home along a set path. You can even define speed, set wait times, and choose whether you want them to return along the same path or loop. For more on this new tool, check out [url=https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/58669]our preview[/url]. [i]Create unique paths for your pets, mounts, and assistants[/i] [b]Performance Improvements[/b] The team has been working hard on various performance improvements in this update. These include improvements to how persistent AoEs work (starting with the Dragonknight Standard), an item set scripting update, new Critical Memory systems, physic engine improvements, server load handling improvements, database caching, and some intermittent load screen fixes—phew! With these updates, you’ll see fewer crashes, improvements to overall server stability/performance, and fewer random load screens. For everything arriving in Update 27, check out the Patch Notes section on our [url=https://forums.elderscrollsonline.com/en/categories/patch-notes]official forums[/url]. [h2]Delve into Skyrim’s Dark Heart[/h2] Continue your Dark Heart of Skyrim adventure with [i]Stonethorn[/i] and put a stop to two deadly new threats before they are unleashed upon the Nords of Western Skyrim. Shut down a terrible experiment and defeat an unholy army with two exciting and challenging dungeons that expand upon the year-long narrative that began with [i]Harrowstorm[/i] and will continue throughout the rest of 2020! Are you excited to enter Castle Thorn or the Stone Garden? Tell us via @[url=https://twitter.com/TESOnline]TESOnline[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/elderscrollsonline/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ElderScrollsOnline]Facebook[/url]. [i]Part of the Dark Heart of Skyrim year-long adventure, the Stonethorn DLC game pack is now live for PC/Mac and Stadia* and arrives September 1 for Xbox One and PlayStation®4.
